title: Sr. Partner Success Manager, Strategic Accounts, eero
descriptionHtml:
At eero, we pride ourselves on dedication to customers. We are growing eero's B2B partnerships — bringing our networking solutions to strategic accounts at scale — and we need a Senior Partner Success Manager to help us define and scale how we serve these customers.

In this role, you'll be a founding member of a team that is charting new territory for eero's B2B partnerships. You'll manage the full partner lifecycle for strategic accounts — from initial onboarding through ongoing optimization — while simultaneously helping us build the frameworks, processes, and playbooks that will scale our partner success function as the business grows. Along the way, you'll review partner requests, ensure eero teams are aligned on requirements, and coordinate cross-functional efforts to meet external commitments. Once new partners have completed their initial deployment, you'll continue partnering with them exploring expansion opportunities, offering support and insights to ensure they're making the most of their eero experience. This is a highly hands-on role: you'll work directly with B2B customers in the field, roll up your sleeves to solve complex deployment challenges, gather voice-of-customer insights, and drive measurable outcomes.

You'll thrive here if you're energized by ambiguity, comfortable building the plane while flying it, and excited to shape something new rather than maintain the status quo.


Key job responsibilities
Partner Development & Strategic Account Management: Own all facets of the partner success process for large, complex strategic accounts within new business initiatives. Acquire deep knowledge of customers' vision, products, and objectives. Manage deal registration, partner onboarding certification, and joint business planning to accelerate pipeline and deployment velocity. Anticipate partner needs and resolve pain points before they escalate. Identify and execute on revenue-maximizing opportunities for both the partner and eero.

Strategic Guidance: Earn partners' trust and influence their customer-facing technology strategy. Help partners optimize their eero programs to deliver exceptional customer experiences.

Build & Scale New Initiatives: Help define and operationalize new partner engagement models. Craft scalable workflows, onboarding processes, and success frameworks. Balance customer needs with competing business priorities. Identify opportunities to “invent and simplify” and automate repetitive work, including with AI tools. Support partner readiness across international geographies.

Hands-On Customer Engagement: Be in the field with B2B customers — conducting on-site visits, supporting deployments, leading product demonstrations, and coordinating product training for new and existing partners. Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic accounts, translating technical requirements into actionable plans.

Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Support, and Manufacturing to advance partner initiatives. Facilitate cross-functional meetings to resolve partner escalations, align on requirements, and drive external commitments to completion.

Quantitative Analysis & Demand Planning: Create and utilize reporting and analytics, data modeling, and business case analysis to identify opportunities for partners and ensure their objectives are achieved through quantitative insights. Analyze partner purchasing behavior and demand signals to develop accurate internal forecasts. Collaborate with supply chain, procurement, and finance teams to ensure appropriate inventory lead times, hardware availability, and order fulfillment for partner deployments across multiple geographies.


A day in the life
As a Senior Partner Success Manager on the Strategic Accounts team within eero, no two days look the same — and that's by design. You might start the morning reviewing deployment data for a strategic account, then hop on a call to troubleshoot an onboarding challenge with a new B2B partner. By midday, you're collaborating with Product and Engineering on a feature request that emerged from customer feedback. In the afternoon, you may be preparing a business case for a new partnership model or traveling to a customer site to support a critical deployment milestone. Throughout it all, you're balancing proactive outreach with creative problem-solving, building relationships with partners, and contributing to the foundational processes that will define how eero serves strategic B2B customers for years to come.

About the team
This role sits within the Operations team at eero and is part of a newly formed initiative focused on growing eero's B2B partnerships with strategic accounts across new customer segments. We are a small, high-impact team that operates with a startup mentality inside a world-class organization. We value ownership, bias for action, and customer obsession with the highest standards. If you're passionate about building something from scratch, partnering deeply with B2B customers, and driving measurable business outcomes in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment — you'll thrive here.

- Experience with business development, partnership management, or sourcing new business

- Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders

- Travel up to 30% of the time

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Prime Video Offers Expansion
descriptionHtml:
Behind every "Buy," "Rent," "Subscribe," or "Bundle" button on Prime Video is a decision our system made in milliseconds: what offer to show, at what price, with what promotions, for which customer, in which country. We own that decision.

Our team within Prime Video Commerce owns critical offer orchestration and pricing services that power the global commerce experience. Our systems determine pricing, apply promotions, compose bundles, and serve the right offer to the right customer across every Prime Video surface. We process millions of requests per second, operate across 100+ markets, and sit on the critical path for every Prime Video transaction worldwide, spanning subscriptions, rentals, purchases, channels, and bundles.

The challenge is not scale alone. It is scale plus rapid change. We are expanding into dozens of new marketplaces each year, each with unique payment methods, regulatory requirements, and pricing models. We are building dynamic pricing capabilities, enabling promotional experiences for major commercial events, and evolving how offers are composed as the product portfolio grows. Every new market and every new offer type adds combinatorial complexity to a system that must remain correct, fast, and available.

We are looking for a Senior SDE who wants to own hard problems in a system where getting it wrong means a customer sees the wrong price, cannot complete their purchase, or misses an offer they should have seen. You will own services end-to-end, make architectural calls, ship to production, and operate what you build. The work is technical, the impact is immediate, and the problems do not come pre-solved.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and evolve offer orchestration and pricing services that determine what customers see globally, making architecture decisions for correctness, latency, and resilience
- Design systems that handle the combinatorial complexity of multi-market, multi-currency, multi-promotion offer serving at millions of TPS
- Investigate and resolve production issues that cross service boundaries, often requiring deep analysis of traffic patterns, caching behavior, and downstream dependencies to find non-obvious root causes
- Drive marketplace expansion from an engineering perspective: configuration, offer distribution, compliance requirements, and end-to-end validation across new territories
- Build and maintain operational health for Tier-1 services: stress testing, capacity planning, alarm tuning, scaling strategies, and incident prevention
- Propose and drive architectural improvements that reduce operational toil, improve system reliability, or eliminate classes of production defects, without waiting to be asked
- Provide technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, and architecture guidance, helping engineers across the team make better decisions and grow in scope
- Leverage AI tooling strategically to accelerate engineering workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and improve development velocity while maintaining quality and ownership of all design decisions


A day in the life
One morning you are tracing why an offer disappeared for customers in a specific region, following the data flow through multiple services until you find the filtering logic that does not account for a lifecycle edge case. The next day you are designing how a new promotional pricing type should propagate through the offer pipeline without breaking existing business rules. Later in the week you are reviewing stress test results, comparing actual traffic distribution against test configurations, and filing a scaling request based on your analysis. On Friday you are pairing with a newer engineer on their first multi-market configuration change, helping them understand the compliance implications before they ship.

The work moves between deep technical investigation, system design, production operations, and people development. You will not do the same thing two days in a row.

About the team
We are part of the Prime Video Commerce organization, based in Bengaluru. We own services that power offer serving, pricing, and commerce experiences for customers globally. Our scope spans pricing and promotions, offer composition, bundling, and international expansion across dozens of markets.

We work as part of a global engineering organization with counterparts across multiple locations and time zones. We respect time zones, value directness, and believe that the best engineering happens when people feel ownership over their domain and trust within their team. We are a high-ownership team where individual contributions are visible and impactful.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence
- 3+ years of distributed systems experience, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
- Experience building and operating high-availability services in production with demonstrated ownership of operational health

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in payments or e-commerce
- Experience in Database like NoSQL, or experience in technical support and experience with automation and any version control tools
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Experience with international expansion: regulatory compliance, local payment methods, market-specific configuration at scale
- Familiarity with caching strategies, traffic analysis, and capacity planning for high-TPS services
- Hands-on experience using AI/GenAI tools to accelerate engineering workflows while maintaining quality standards
- Track record of identifying and driving improvements to operational health, testing practices, or development processes without explicit direction

descriptionHtml:
eero is looking for a proactive Tax Manager who will be a key member of the eero finance team.
As eero continues to grow and expand, we are looking for a candidate with global tax experience who is comfortable directly liaising with eero business teams with an aim of gaining a deep understanding of the business vision and model in order to develop and support comprehensive tax solutions.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of indirect and direct tax issues and how those can impact the business solution being articulated. The candidate will also work closely with other members of the global tax department to communicate current and future business plans, obtain cross functional tax subject matter input, and ensure coordination of cross functional tax solutions. The Tax Manager will be fully immersed within the eero business team and support current and future eero offerings, guidelines, and day to day questions.

We’re also looking for someone who is curious about how technology can transform the tax function — someone excited about leveraging AI and automation to increase efficiency, scale operations, and reimagine how tax work gets done.

Key job responsibilities
Business Strategy & Advisory
• Drive new territory expansions by evaluating entity structures, tax implications, and optimal jurisdictional positioning
• Oversee tax compliance on procurement activities, ensuring correct tax treatment on all purchases
• Manage transfer pricing and intercompany tax matters, including documentation and policy alignment
• Provide strategic tax guidance on new initiatives, product launches, and business model changes

Tax Compliance & Operations
• Facilitate all tax filings and payments, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of tax calculations across jurisdictions
• Oversee tax audit management, including coordination with external authorities and internal stakeholders
• Drive automation across tax workstreams to improve efficiency, leveraging AI and technology solutions

Leadership & Collaboration
• Lead in ambiguous and evolving environments, owning the end-to-end tax function for the business
• Collaborate with the wider Amazon organization on cross-functional tax initiatives and alignment
• Partner effectively with multiple teams—including finance, legal, accounting, and business—in a fast-paced environment

A day in the life
Every day will be different. You might start the morning advising on a new eero product launch in EMEA, spend the afternoon modeling the tax implications of an expansion into a new market, and end the day collaborating with AI tools to automate a compliance workflow that previously took weeks. You’ll work as part of a collaborative team that shares knowledge freely, embraces innovation, and delivers results together. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to initiatives that span the broader Amazon Tax group, and you’ll be at the forefront of how technology is reshaping the tax function.

About the team
Wifi is the foundation of the modern home. Without it, nothing works. eero has worked to eliminate frustration and redefine wifi as a cornerstone of the home. Fixing connectivity is just the start. We’re working on the building blocks of the smart home by designing our own hardware, enabling it with software, and tying it all together to the cloud. A home that anticipates our needs, takes care of us and our families, keeps us safe and healthy, and saves money and energy.

title: Policy Communications Lead, UK Stores & Corporate Communications
descriptionHtml:
Are you a strategic communications professional with a passion for policy, media relations, and creative campaigning?

Amazon is looking for a Policy Communications Manager to join our UK Stores & Corporate Communications team, based in London.

In this role, you will develop and execute communications strategies that support Amazon's policy objectives in the UK, helping to ensure that debates about legislation and regulation are informed and accurate. The successful candidate will be a key member of the UK Comms team, reporting to the UK Head of Corporate Communications.

You will work at the intersection of public policy, media relations, litigation and corporate reputation – translating complex policy topics into compelling narratives for policymakers, media, third parties and the public. You will develop integrated campaigns across earned, owned, and paid channels, build relationships with policy-focused media and commentators, and support Amazon's engagement with key stakeholders in Westminster, Whitehall, and beyond.

This role requires an experienced, creative, and versatile communicator who demonstrates sound judgement under pressure, excellent writing and storytelling skills, and an ability to engage both policy and business audiences. You will collaborate closely with colleagues across Public Policy, Legal, and business teams to align communications strategies with Amazon's broader objectives.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop and execute proactive communications campaigns that support Amazon's UK policy priorities across earned, owned, paid, and social media channels.
• Build and maintain relationships with policy-focused media, commentators, and non-traditional media to shape coverage of issues relevant to Amazon.
• Craft compelling narratives, messaging, and content (including media materials, briefing documents, owned articles, social media content and executive communications) that translate complex policy topics for target audiences.
• Provide strategic communications counsel to Public Policy colleagues and business leaders on policy-related issues, regulatory developments, and reputational opportunities.
• Monitor the UK political and regulatory landscape to identify emerging issues and proactively develop communications responses and campaigns.
• Support issues management and reactive media handling on policy-related topics, working collaboratively with the wider UK communications team and international colleagues.

About the team
The UK Stores & Corporate Communications team is made up of communications professionals focusing on the Amazon Store, as well as corporate campaign topics and internal comms. We work in partnership with business teams, specialist PR topic teams, and colleagues from marketing, owned content, social, and public policy.

Our policy communications work sits within the broader International Stores & Corporate Communications (ISCC) organisation, which is responsible for Amazon communications in 29 countries outside of the U.S. and China. We use communication to ensure debates about legislation and regulation are informed and accurate, and we work to protect and enhance Amazon's reputation with policymakers and regulators. Our work is guided by Amazon's Leadership Principles and a commitment to creative, data-driven storytelling.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in professional communications or public relations
- Experience executing integrated communications campaigns across earned, owned, and social media channels.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
- Experience working in large teams or at a national/multinational organization, or experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions
- Experience working in or with UK government, Parliament, regulatory bodies, or political environments.
- Established network of relationships with UK policy journalists, political commentators, or think tanks.
- Experience developing executive communications and supporting senior leaders as spokespeople.

title: Sr. Applied Scientist - Perception (SLAM/VIO), Fauna
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Sr. Applied Scientist to develop and optimize Visual Inertial Odometry (VIO) and sensor fusion systems for our intelligent robots. In this role, you will design, implement, and deploy state estimation and tracking algorithms that enable robots to understand their position and motion in real time, even in challenging and dynamic environments.

You will own the full pipeline from algorithm development through embedded deployment, ensuring that perception systems run efficiently on resource-constrained robotic hardware. You will also leverage modern machine learning approaches to push the boundaries of classical perception methods, combining learned representations with geometric techniques to achieve robust, real-time performance.

This is a deeply hands-on role. You will work directly with sensors, hardware, and real-world data, while prototyping, testing, and iterating in physical environments. The ideal candidate has strong foundations in VIO and sensor fusion, practical experience optimizing algorithms for embedded platforms, and familiarity with how modern deep learning is transforming perception.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement Visual Inertial Odometry algorithms for robust real-time state estimation on robotic platforms like Sprout
- Develop multi-sensor fusion pipelines integrating cameras, IMUs, and other sensing modalities for accurate pose tracking
- Optimize perception and tracking algorithms for deployment on embedded hardware (e.g., ARM, GPU-accelerated edge devices) under strict latency and power constraints
- Apply modern ML-based perception techniques (learned features, depth estimation, neural odometry) to complement and improve classical geometric approaches
- Build and maintain calibration, evaluation, and benchmarking infrastructure for perception systems
- Collaborate with hardware, controls, and navigation teams to integrate perception outputs into the robot’s autonomy stack
- Lead technical projects from research prototyping through production deployment

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
- Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is a initiative within Amazon that aims to revolutionize global connectivity through the development of a state-of-the-art Low Earth Orbit (LEO) interconnected satellite communication constellation. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide by delivering high-speed, low latency, internet services to underserved and unserved communities and remote communities around the world. By leveraging satellite technology, we are working towards a future where everyone has access to reliable and high-quality internet connectivity regardless of their location.

The Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) Engineering organization is a multi-disciplinary technology team established to rapidly address the needs of targeted government and international customers with specific solutions that have the potential to scale. ALG Engineering leads the development and delivery of targeted and scalable solutions for custom space and terrestrial applications. ALG collaborates closely with Project LEO to leverage the constellation of advance satellites to provide seamless and efficient communication capabilities to meet the needs of our customers. The ALG Engineering team is seeking highly technical and talented individuals who are passionate about creating unique solutions that result in a positive impact on a global scale.

About the Role
We're looking for a Network Development Engineer who can design, build, and operate network infrastructure across data center and engineering environments. You'll own architectures that support production systems, integration environments, and engineering labs — delivering reliability and scalability while enabling teams to move fast.
You'll bring data center networking fundamentals — switching fabrics, routing, segmentation, automation — and apply them across environments with varying requirements, from production-grade availability to rapid reconfigurability for hardware integration and system validation.

About You
You deliver simple, sustainable, and repeatable solutions — whether refreshing aging infrastructure or standing up something new. You're comfortable designing a scalable switching fabric and equally comfortable helping an engineer debug why their test hardware can't reach a shared resource. You bring production-grade thinking to every environment you touch, and you understand that great infrastructure enables great engineering.

• Maintain standards for change management, documentation (SOPs, implementation guides, knowledge transfer), and configuration control; ensure compliance across the networking toolset

- 1+ years of data center, critical environment, computer hardware repair, infrastructure cabling, network deployment, or data center operations experience, or experience with Network Protocols: TCP/IP, Ethernet, L2/L3 technologies
- 3+ years of network engineering experience (design, deployment, operations)

title: Customer Solutions Manager, AWSI Automotive & Manufacturing, AWS
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Customer Solutions Manager (CSM) to join our global Automotive & Manufacturing Industries team. In this highly visible role, you will be responsible for helping guide AWS customers along their multi-year journey to the cloud, ensuring that all AWS teams are working together effectively and efficiently to deliver outcomes for the customer.

Our team is committed to helping industry enterprise customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers where they are in their cloud journey and work backwards from their industry specific needs to transform their business and their entire industry. Our team speaks the language of our industry customers, which means that we focus on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

If you are excited about the prospect of using your cloud architecture experience to assist our most valuable customers, tackling challenging problems, have a hand in shaping the future of cloud adoption, enhancing and growing your own skills, and having fun, then we would love to hear from you.

You will be a critical partner to our customers, leveraging your experience with large scale cloud transformations and helping shepherd them through their stages of AWS adoption. Guiding the customer through the operational, educational, and governance aspects of a successful AWS cloud journey.

You will interface with customer and AWS leadership, driving collaboration between the other core account groups (Sales, Support, Solutions Architecture, and Professional Services), product/engineering teams, and customer teams, planning and supporting major workload migrations. You will translate strategic initiatives in the account plan into executable actions, working backwards from our customers key milestones. You will manage cadence by leading the reporting and tracking functions along the way. The execution of education plans, roadmap to business outcome alignments, Executive Briefing Sessions, and go-live events and transitions are a few items owned by the CSM that are critical to the success of our customer’s cloud journey.

You are encouraged to think big, invent and take ownership on customer challenges. You will not only bring the best of AWS/Amazon to our customers, you will proactively help solve the customer’s challenges through new ideas, tools and mechanisms.

Successful candidates will have a strong technical background, be aware of details that matter, have excellent problem solving abilities, and be exemplary communicators both at the executive and project team level. Your enterprise cloud experience and operational excellence will influence the team’s decisions, provide insight, and help drive secure and robust solutions.

Key job responsibilities
You will establish a deep understanding of your customer’s business vision, culture and processes, and evangelize AWS services and influence customers to adopt the right solution at the right time. Customer Solution Managers (CSM) are responsible for four focus areas:

Accelerating AWS Adoption through delivery and execution of customer cloud initiatives

Customer Enablement, you will serve as the customer’s cloud journey coach and be the voice of the customer within AWS, evangelizing customer needs to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams

Implement governance structures to effectively govern both our partnership with the customer, and the customer’s adoption of AWS

CSMs are able to effectively coordinate cross-functional resources, drive disciplined project delivery, and quantify the tangible business benefits that customers realize through their cloud transformation initiatives. This holistic approach to customer engagement, coupled with the CSM's deep understanding of the Automotive & Manufacturing Industry and AWS capabilities; positions CSMs as trusted advisors who can guide customers through every stage of their cloud journey - from initial strategy and planning to migration, modernization, and ongoing optimization.

Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:

title: Software Development Engineer II, FleetWatch Team
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

DC BRIDGE builds the software platforms that support Amazon's data center engineering operations worldwide. Our systems directly impact the reliability and efficiency of the physical infrastructure that powers AWS and Amazon's global services.

Every AWS data center depends on its electrical and mechanical infrastructure, the power and cooling systems that keep it within operational limits. The FleetWatch team within DC BRIDGE builds the platform that monitors all of it, ingesting trillions of metrics a month. We expose metric data in real time to the operator tools that depend on it, evaluate alarms in-stream to determine actions when metrics breach thresholds, and persist telemetry to a datalake for analytics and long-term monitoring across the fleet.

As an SDE2 you'll own features from design through code, test, deployment, and operation, with autonomy. Our customers are the controls engineers and operations teams who run Amazon's data centers. You'll work directly with controls engineers to improve the alarm configuration experience on the one hand, and with operations teams to refine the alarm output experience on the other. The problems span stream processing at fleet scale, alarm quality and noise reduction, and extending monitoring to new regions and new generations of data center infrastructure. Telemetry volume grows every month, so efficiency is a feature: we simplify systems and drive down the cost of processing each metric even as the fleet expands.

Tech stack: Java (primary for service code), with Kotlin (stream processing), TypeScript (CDK infrastructure), and Python (Lambda functions, data processing, monitoring). AWS services include Kinesis, Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, S3, Fargate, CloudWatch, Athena, and Step Functions.

Key job responsibilities
- Build the services behind FleetWatch's real-time monitoring pipeline: stream processing at fleet scale, alarm evaluation that determines actions when metrics breach thresholds, and the noise-reduction logic that keeps alarms actionable. You'll own features end-to-end and make the implementation decisions yourself
- Contribute to the services that route alarms and tickets to data center operations teams with the context they need for faster resolution
- Build and operate the offline path: the datalake that persists telemetry for analytics and long-term monitoring, and the APIs that expose metric data to operator tools
- Drive efficiency at scale. Simplify systems, deprecate what the fleet no longer needs, and reduce the cost of processing each metric as volume grows
- Define infrastructure as code using AWS CDK and own the operational health of what you deploy
- Author designs for your own work and provide meaningful feedback in design reviews
- Mentor earlier-career engineers through code review and pairing

A day in the life
Your morning might start with standup, sharing progress on a new alarm evaluation feature, then a code review where you give thoughtful feedback to a teammate. You spend a focused block writing stream-processing code or CDK to extend the metrics pipeline, then debug a production issue that surfaced overnight, finding the root cause and writing a permanent fix. After lunch you join a design review, asking the questions that surface unstated assumptions. You wrap up walking through alarm feedback with a data center operations team, turning what you hear into the next noise-reduction improvement.

About the team
FleetWatch is led by Caleb Veth and operates with high ownership over our services end-to-end, from design through production operation. The Seattle-based team is a small group of SDEs who run everything we build. Our mission is to give the people who run Amazon's data centers a clear, trustworthy picture of the fleet's electrical and mechanical health: every alarm should mean something, and every metric should be worth what it costs to process. As an SDE2 you'll be a core autonomous contributor: owning features, raising the bar in reviews, and helping more junior engineers grow.

*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating, and that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- 2+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: Python, Java, or TypeScript

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

descriptionHtml:

Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You'll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You'll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn't abstract, it's visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world's most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

This is not a corporate, remote or office-based position. This is a full-time, early career position located within one of Amazon’s fulfillment centers, sort centers, delivery stations or other operations buildings. Amazon is seeking customer focused individuals to lead a team of hourly employees across our Operations network! Our warehouses are fast-paced environments where standing, walking, and having on-the-production floor conversations are common as a supply chain leader.

As an Area Manager, you will be responsible for engaging, leading and developing your team in a warehouse environment. Key job responsibilities

• Work independently and operate in an autonomous environment.

• Work in an environment where the noise level varies.

• Climb and descend stairs (when applicable).


A day in the life
As an Area Manager, no two days look exactly the same, but every shift gives you the chance to lead a team, solve real problems, and directly impact how millions of customers receive their orders.

Start of Shift: Set the Tone
• Get a handoff from the outgoing manager and review what's carrying over so nothing falls through the cracks.
• Lead a team huddle to kick off the shift. Huddles are used to align on goals, safety priorities, and key focus areas.
• Confirm your team is in place, positioned for success, and ready to go before operations begin.

Middle of Shift: Lead from the Floor
• Walk the floor regularly to stay connected to your team, spot issues early, and keep things running smoothly.
• Drive results across safety, quality, and productivity — balancing all three in real time.
• Adjust staffing and resources as volume and priorities shift throughout the day.
• Coach and develop your team members, respond to challenges as they come up, and partner with support teams to remove roadblocks.
• Keep peers and leadership informed on how the shift is tracking and flag risks before they become problems.

End of Shift: Close Strong
• Do a final walkthrough to make sure your area is clean, organized, and set up for the next team's success.
• Review your shift's performance data and capture what went well and what to improve
• Hand off to the incoming manager with a clear picture of priorities, open items, and next steps.
• Wrap up any remaining administrative tasks so you leave the shift with a clean slate.
• Every shift, you'll see the direct results of your leadership: from the energy of your team to the packages that reach customers' doorsteps. This is where your decisions have real, visible impact.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. ① 計画チームとの要件定義（エリア、面積、スペックなど）： 需要見通しに基づくキャパシティ計画を確認し、エリア、開業時期、施設規模、建物スペックなどの探索要件を定義します。適切な要件定義は、プロジェクトの方向性を明確にし、社外ステークホルダーとの信頼関係構築および希少物件の獲得に不可欠です。
② 市場調査および物件探索：各エリアのマーケット調査を実施し、公開情報に留まらず未公開情報や潜在的な移転情報も入手します。土地からの開発アプローチも行い、不動産デベロッパー、仲介会社、デューデリジェンス・工事等のサプライヤーネットワークを活用します。
③ デューデリジェンスおよび物件選定： 外部ベンダーを活用した不動産デューデリジェンスおよび投資採算性の検証を実施し、社内関係者と物件選定にかかる合意形成を行います。
④ 条件交渉、予算取得、契約締結： 契約諸条件の交渉を実施し、ファイナンス部門と協力して予算を申請します。競合案件など意思決定のスピードが求められる場面では高度なコミュニケーションスキルが必要です。法務部門と契約書の案文調整を経て、税務・会計部門の承認を含めた契約承認申請を実施します。
また業務の推進においては以下の要素が求められます。

・Strategic Thinking（戦略的思考） — 中長期の戦略を策定し、データに基づいた判断でポートフォリオ全体のギャップや機会を特定する。
・Proactive Collaboration（主体的な協働） — 指示を待つのではなく、提案を伴ってビジネスレビューやシニアリーダーレビューを主体的に推進する。
・Independence（自律性） — 戦略が未定義の領域を含む複雑なトランザクションにおいても、完全に自律的に遂行する。
・Influence（影響力） — 複数階層のリーダーシップや外部関係者と連携し、複雑なトレードオフを明確に伝え、合意形成を推進する。

This role broadly leads real estate procurement for inventory hubs, sortation centers, and delivery stations required for Amazon Japan's delivery network. Based on site planning, the role explores real estate opportunities, collaborates with relevant teams to select optimal properties from candidate sites, and drives budget approval and contract execution.
This position serves as the central point of communication among internal and external stakeholders, leading consensus-building, and is expected to execute the following four business scopes end-to-end:
① Requirements Definition with the Planning Team (Area, Size, Specifications, etc.): Confirms capacity plans based on demand forecasts and defines search requirements including area, launch timing, facility size, and building specifications. Proper requirements definition is essential for clarifying project direction, building trust with external stakeholders, and securing scarce properties.
② Market Research and Property Exploration: Conducts market research in each area, obtaining not only publicly available information but also off-market intelligence and potential relocation leads. Pursues ground-up development approaches and leverages networks of real estate developers, brokerage firms, and suppliers for due diligence and construction.
③ Due Diligence and Property Selection: Executes real estate due diligence utilizing external vendors and validates investment feasibility, then drives consensus among internal stakeholders on property selection.
④ Condition Negotiation, Budget Acquisition, and Contract Execution: Negotiates contract terms and conditions, and collaborates with the Finance team to submit budget requests. Advanced communication skills are required in situations demanding rapid decision-making, such as competitive deals. After coordinating draft contract language with the Legal team, submits contract approval requests including sign-off from Tax and Accounting departments.

In carrying out the responsibilities described above, the following competencies are required of this candidate:

・Strategic Thinking — Develops mid- to long-term strategies; identifies gaps/opportunities across portfolios with data-driven judgment.
・Proactive Collaboration — Drives business and senior leader reviews proactively with recommendations, rather than waiting for direction.
・Independence — Operates with complete independence on complex transactions, including undefined strategy areas.
・Influence — Partners with multiple levels of leadership and external parties; clearly communicates complex trade-offs and drives alignment.

title: Sr. Solutions Architect, Retail - CPG
descriptionHtml:
Do you like helping large enterprise customers solve technical problems? Would you like to do this using the latest cloud computing technologies? Do you have a knack for helping an organization understand application architectures and integration approaches, and the consultative and leadership skills to help guide a project to success? Do you want to be part of the business development team helping to move a large enterprise onto Amazon Web Services as their technology platform?


Come join the team as a Solutions Architect within Amazon Web Services (AWS). In your role, you will have the opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share and broad use of Amazon’s utility computing web services (Amazon EC2 compute, Amazon S3 storage, Amazon Simple DB/RDS databases, Amazon CloudFront CDN, etc.) within large strategic accounts. Your broad responsibilities will include: owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, working cross-organizationally to facilitate widespread use and adoption of the AWS platform, and developing a deep expertise in the AWS technologies as well as broad know-how around how applications and services are constructed using the AWS platform. The ideal candidate will possess customer facing skills that will allow them to represent AWS well within the customer’s environment and drive discussions with senior personnel regarding trade-offs, best practices, and risk mitigation. He/she should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges.



Key job responsibilities

Roles & Responsibilities:
- Serve as a key member of the Business Development and Sales team in helping to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the AWS platform.
- Scope each customer engagement, with attention towards clear and well-defined objectives and success criteria.
- Own each engagement, and help ensure a timely and successful delivery of value.
- Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the solution architect community.
- Understand and exploit the use of salesforce.com and other internal Amazon systems.





About the team
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
- Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent
- Experience working with end user or developer communities

title: Sr. Executive Research Recruiter, Principal Engineer Recruiting Team
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Global Specialty Recruiting team and help us identify and hire the world's most exceptional Principal Engineers. Members of Amazon's Principal Engineer Community Amazon's most senior technologists, exemplary practitioners and pragmatic visionaries who set the standard for engineering excellence across Amazon. This role offers unparalleled visibility—you'll work across all Amazon businesses, advising senior executives on hiring strategy while building relationships with world-renowned technical leaders.


Key job responsibilities
Strategic Search Design: Develop robust, multi-channel search strategies attracting world-class engineers. Map target companies, engage at conferences, generate referral leads. Build talent networks and tap industry sources for ongoing candidate pools.

Executive Advisory: Serve as talent adviser to leaders across Amazon—educating hiring managers about the external Principal Engineer demographic. Provide strategic guidance to executive leadership on top technical talent. Conduct continuous company and talent mapping.

Candidate Development: Develop prospects into candidates through sophisticated engagement. Perform assessment and screening, present to executive leadership. Conduct phone interviews, prepare candidates for technical interviews, coach leaders on talent acquisition at senior levels.

Market Expertise: Serve as expert for engineering recruiting. Contribute to knowledge base with education on industries and talent pools. Learn new domains quickly and craft effective search strategies.

What we're Looking for:

Research acumen: Learn technical domains quickly, craft effective search strategies, excel at candidate identification, engagement, and creative sourcing

Executive presence: Compelling communicator who engages busy executives and renowned engineers, self-assured and quick-thinking

Strategic judgment: Think strategically while executing tactically, relentlessly high standards, results-oriented

Collaboration: Team leader and member who believes individual wins are team wins, inquisitive with strong desire to learn


A day in the life
You'll identify technical leadership at target companies and domains, identifying Principal Engineers working on problems similar to Amazon's strategic initiatives. You'll craft multi-channel engagement strategies—attending technical conferences, leveraging networks for warm introductions to passive candidates who would be transformational hires.

You'll advise leaders on search parameters based on market realities, conduct phone interviews with renowned engineers assessing technical depth and influence capability, and coach hiring managers on candidate engagement. You'll contribute to the team's knowledge base by documenting insights about emerging talent pools that inform future searches.

About the team
The Principal Engineering Recruiting team is the talent acquisition engine for Amazon's PE Community. We take a multi-channel approach (target company mapping, conference and event engagement, referral and network lead generation) to talent identification, engagement, assessment, and match-making. Our mission: identify, build relationships with, and hire every great Principal Engineer in the world. You'll work with a strong, established team of executive recruiters.

- 7+ years of progressive corporate or search firm recruiting work with a focus on passive engineering candidate generation in a high tech market experience

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

- Experience recruiting passive candidates who are the most senior experts in their field
- Experience with executive recruiting in either a blue-chip, global in-house executive search team, or a top executive search firm

title: Senior Phased Array Architect, Payload Phased Array Systems
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

As a Senior Phased Array Architect, you will lead critical efforts to design and deliver next-generation antenna systems that will redefine how people connect to the internet. you will:


- Define and lead the architectural vision for advanced phased array antenna systems, ensuring they align with performance, scalability, and reliability goals.
- Serve as the technical authority on phased array systems, providing strategic input on program decisions and long-term technology roadmaps.
- Drive system-level design and optimization, creating blueprints that guide RF, digital, and hardware teams across the organization.
- Oversee system integration, ensuring seamless interaction between phased array systems, RF front-ends, and digital beamforming architectures.
- Guide cross-functional teams—including RF, software, and systems engineers—to implement designs that meet stringent performance, power, and thermal targets.
- Collaborate with product management, supply chain, and operations to ensure architectural decisions align with business goals and production realities.
- Set architectural direction for manufacturability and testability, ensuring designs are robust, scalable, and ready for high-volume production.
- Mentor and develop junior engineers, cultivating a team culture of technical excellence and innovation.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- 7+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver products and projects on tight deadlines
- Experience in phased array design principles, including beamforming, steering, and calibration.
- Experience with RF front-end design, high-speed digital systems, and signal integrity.
- Experience with system modeling tools and architectural design methodologies.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- Experience in Space Vehicle/Satellite Operations, Space Communications or related industry
- Experience in wireless system design and architecture, system integration, and RF system analysis
- Experience in high-volume manufacturing environments
- Familiarity with EM simulation tools (e.g., CST, HFSS, ADS) and system-level modeling platforms.
- Knowledge of at least one modern programming or scripting language such as C, C++, Python, or MATLAB

title: Process Improvement manager, Amazon Customer Excelence System
descriptionHtml:
Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Amazon Logistics部門（AMZL)のAmazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) チームでは、プロセス改善を担うProcess Improvement managerを募集しております。

【役割と業務内容】
ACESチームは、配送拠点(以下デリバリーステーション)の安全、品質、生産性を改善し、お客様の必要な時に商品を届けられる仕組みを構築し、カスタマーエクスペリエンスを高める役割を担っています。ACESチームは、デリバリーステーションでの配送効率を向上させるため、新規システム、仕組みの導入や改善プロジェクトを推進します。海外のAmazonで新規適用されたシステム、仕組みを日本のデリバリーステーションに適合させ導入、展開を推進します。新規導入したシステム、仕組みについては、データ分析と現場分析の両面から確認し改善をします。また、デリバリーステーションの全工程を理解し、安全、品質、生産性の向上に繋がるアイテムを抽出し改善を進めます。改善は、Operationのデータや現場観察からムダを定量化し、優先度決めをし、PDCA cycleを回します。Amazon デリバリーステーション全てに改善施策を適用できるようスケーラビリティーを考慮した上で標準化をし、拡大していきます。上記を、デリバリーステーションの管理者や各関係者と協業し業務を遂行していただきます。本ポジションでは、業界問わず業務プロセスに課題があった場合に自ら課題解決が出来る経験がある方を求めております。具体的にはシステムから抽出したデータを用いて問題分析を行い、問題を特定するだけでなく、現場訪問などの事実に基づく対策推進や改善を多くの関係者を巻き込みながら主導出来る経験がある方を求めております。ACESチームでは、物流業界出身の方のみならず、製造業、コンサルタントなど多様なバックグラウンドのメンバーが活躍しています。勤務日の半分程度、出張も含めた現場での業務が発生します。

【本ポジションの魅力】
本ポジションは海外（North America、EU）のデジタリゼーションの先端を走るAmazonのリソースを活用した、新たなビジネスモデル（物流領域）の構築をリードし、日本のマーケットに大きな影響を与える事が出来ます。この連携を通じて、先進的な業界動向を学ぶ事が出来る他、海外の関係者との連携を通じて多様性のある考え方、人的ネットワークの構築や改善のアプローチ手法なども体得する事が出来る魅力的なポジションになります。各プロジェクトを通じて日本各地のデリバリーステーションメンバーとの協業が可能であり、実際の配送業務を観察する事で地域のお客様へのカスタマーエクスペリエンス向上を身近に感じる事が出来ます。

関連情報
・所属部門:ラストマイル(AMZL)
・職種:プロジェクトマネジメント
・勤務地:東京オフィス

Amazon is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, or other legally protected status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request for support, please visit https://www.amazon.jobs/en/disability/jp.

オペレーション部門のDEIの取り組み（Japanese Only）

Key job responsibilities
デリバリーステーションの安全、品質、生産性の改善にあたっては、Amazonのネットワークで取得できるデータを定量的、論理的に分析し、問題点を深く理解します。データから確認できた問題点について現場の状況と合致しているか現場訪問をし確認します。また、Amazonネットワークで取得できるデータのみでは不足している場合は、現場でのムダの定量化（現場時間測定）、定性的データ（現場メンバーからのヒアリング）の取得を実施し、問題を深堀し、改善を実行します。改善の適用においては、日本のデリバリーステーションだけでなく、海外(North America、EU)のデリバリーステーションへのスケーラビリティも考慮し、標準化した上で拡大をします。

A day in the life
本ポジションは、実際の改善活動を各デリバリーステーションメンバーと連携をしながらリードしていくため、連携が必要な関連部署は多岐に渡ります。具体的には
・海外の同様の活動をしている組織との連携
・Process Improvementを実施するための現場拠点長及び現場メンバーとの連携
カイゼン内容が広範囲に渡る場合はデータや事実に基づいた生産性及びコスト低減の予測を明確化した上で、関連部署を巻き込んだプロジェクト推進が必要になります。

About the team
ACESチームでは、様々な業界からの出身者、多国籍なメンバーで構成されています。多様性の理解と心理的安全性を確保した業務環境の構築を推進しています。Weeklyで、AmazonのOur Leadership Principleについてのdiscussion、情報共有や問題解決を論理的に実践する方法の共有を通じて、日常的なコミュニケーションやリレーションシップの向上だけでなく、お互いの知識や知見を共有し、自己を高め合えるような組織作りにも注力しているチームです。

title: Applied Science Manager, Amazon Robotics
descriptionHtml:
The Manipulation Robotics Organization at Amazon Robotics is at the forefront of building adaptable and intelligent robotics and manipulating capabilities for Amazon’s fulfillment centers. We have developed and deployed solutions at scale, such as Robin which has sorted more than 3B sorted packages. Our next generation systems include item manipulation systems such as Sparrow which picks and places individual items from cluttered totes. We use state-of-the-art methods in robotics, perception, grasping, generative AI, and behavioral cloning to invent the future for Amazon’s fulfillment centers.

We are looking for an Applied Science Manager that is passionate not only about solving today’s complex robotic manipulation problems, but also about shaping and setting the visions for their team, and identifying what are the next set of priorities to tackle. They would partner with a talented and experienced team of applied scientists and engineers that have significant expertise developing and deploying technologies including building foundation models for perception and grasp learning, diffusion policies and sim2real transfer.

Key job responsibilities

You will learn a variety of technologies, development processes, and develop well-rounded skills such as leadership, and effective project management. You will also be accountable for building a strong development team and developing career plans for the scientists and engineers reporting to you.

title: HR Business Partner, SSD-DC PXT
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Business Partner provides HR generalist support to a large population of hourly employees and business leaders, bringing expertise in leadership development, employee experience, and operational excellence.

In this role, you will partner with business leaders to deliver HR initiatives focused on talent management, employee engagement, and internal customer service. Success requires leveraging data-driven insights and understanding the importance of HR metrics to drive business impact. You may also lead a team of entry-level HR employees and own projects that enhance the employee experience.

The HR Business Partner balances strategic and tactical responsibilities, driving organizational success through partnership with leaders. They execute core PXT processes while providing guidance on talent processes, performance management, and cultural initiatives. By building trust and influence through sound business acumen, they manage increasingly complex issues and deliver solutions that enhance both employee experience and business outcomes.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.

Key job responsibilities
- Improve site effectiveness by identifying systemic patterns, addressing root causes, and making high-judgment decisions that align with policy intent while minimizing risk. Establish and implement mechanisms that ensure consistent, fair application of policies while maintaining compliance with evolving regulations.

- Use data analytics to identify emerging trends, predict future challenges, and implement proactive solutions at the site level. Turn insights into practical initiatives that drive measurable improvements in employee experience and business performance.

- Execute and monitor employee engagement strategies and recognition programs. Maintain meaningful floor presence to gather insights, identify early signs of disengagement, and partner with leaders to drive targeted improvements.

- Coach Business Leaders on effective people management practices, including performance feedback, team development, and complex employee relations matters. Support leaders in building inclusive, high-performing teams.

- Partner with leaders to ensure equitable talent practices across selection, development, and advancement decisions. Champion initiatives that create an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive.

From coaching leadership teams on workforce and talent management to driving HR process excellence, you'll collaborate with business leaders to develop forward-looking strategies focused on operational objectives and team effectiveness. Success in this role comes from your ability to navigate organizational dynamics, lead change initiatives, and make high-judgment decisions in ambiguous situations. People, Experience and Technology (PXT) team members working at these locations support employees with technical credentials to manage Powered Industrial Truck (PIT) equipment, making these smaller operations as dynamic as larger fulfilment centers across Amazon, and places where safety and positive people experiences are a top priority. descriptionHtml:

Amazon Operations ist das Rückgrat der Amazon-Kundenerfahrung. Mit über 50 Logistikzentren, hunderten von Zustellstationen und zehntausenden von Versandmitarbeiter:innen arbeitet das Team zusammen, um Artikel effizient an Kund:innen zu liefern. Das Team ist stolz darauf, den Qualitätsservice zu liefern, für den Amazon weltweit bekannt ist.


Hinweis: Du musst zum Starttermin die Arbeitsberechtigung für das Beschäftigungsland haben.

Key job responsibilities
Als Amazon Operations-Praktikant:in hast du die Möglichkeit, deine analytischen Fähigkeiten in wirkungsvollen Projekten anzuwenden, die die Funktionalität und den Service von Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen verbessern. Wichtige Aspekte der Rolle umfassen:

• Abschluss von Projekten mit hoher Priorität nach höchstem Standard und Nachweis deiner Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse zu liefern
• Datenanalyse zur Identifizierung operativer Herausforderungen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
• Vorschlagen und Testen von Lösungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Umsetzung der effektivsten Ansätze
• Entwicklung von Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften, Stakeholdern und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Bewegung im Gebäude, um mit verschiedenen Teams zu interagieren. Das umfasst aktives Wissenssammeln durch Teilnahme an Aktivitäten wie Vorbesprechungen, Ablaufmeetings und Diskussionen mit dem Führungsteam und Versandmitarbeiter:innen.
• Die Fähigkeit, sich im Arbeitsbereich zu orientieren und zwischen verschiedenen Bereichen zu wechseln, ist für diese Position unerlässlich.
• Flexibilität bei verschiedenen Arbeitszeiten und Schichtmustern nach Bedarf zeigen.
• Möglicher Umzug an den vorgesehenen Arbeitsort.

A day in the life
Unsere Praktika sind Bildungsmöglichkeiten, die es dir als unserer zukünftigen Führungskraft ermöglichen, zu entdecken, wie wir unsere Teams von Versandmitarbeiter:innen führen und entwickeln. Du tauchst in die schnelllebige, komplexe Welt unserer Logistikzentren, Sortierzentren und Zustellstationen ein und erlebst, wie unsere Führungskräfte ihre Teams einsetzen, um Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen.

Dieses Praktikum versetzt dich ins Herz unserer Abläufe und ermöglicht es dir, den Weg einer Kundenbestellung zu verfolgen. Du erhältst einen realistischen Einblick in die Vollzeitchancen, die dich in unserem Unternehmen erwarten.

Du lernst, wie unsere Führungskräfte eine sichere, produktive Umgebung schaffen und das volle Potenzial ihrer Teams durch effektive Einbindung und Leistungsmanagement-Strategien nutzen. Das ist deine Chance, Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, die dich zu einer lohnenden Karriere bei Amazon führen werden.

About the team
Praktikant:innen-Community:

• Als Amazon-Praktikant:in bist du Teil einer lebendigen, unterstützenden Community, die dein Wachstum und deine Entwicklung fördert. Du arbeitest mit Praktikant:innen aus der ganzen Welt zusammen, knüpfst Kontakte und nimmst an sozialen Veranstaltungen teil, um deinen Horizont zu erweitern. Du kannst auch spezialisierten Gruppen beitreten, die sich auf Bereiche wie Nachhaltigkeit konzentrieren, um deine vielfältigen Interessen zu erkunden.
Unterstützung:
• Das Praktikumsprogramm bietet ein robustes Unterstützungssystem, einschließlich wöchentlicher Praktikant:innen-Sprechstunden, spezieller IT- und HR-Unterstützung sowie einem Programmteam, das sich deinem Erfolg verschrieben hat. Das stellt sicher, dass du die Anleitung und Hilfe hast, die du zum Gedeihen brauchst.
Lernsessions:
• Exklusive Lernsessions werden deine Fähigkeiten weiter verbessern und dir Zugang zu Amazons modernsten Lernplattformen und der Expertise von Branchenführern gewähren. Diese strukturierten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bereiten dich auf den nächsten Schritt in deiner Karriere vor.
Möglichkeiten:

Zusätzlich erhältst du ein wettbewerbsfähiges Monatsgehalt, Umzugsunterstützung und Zugang zu einer Reihe von Mitarbeitervorteilen.

title: 2027 MBA Pathways Full-time Operations Manager (Nationwide Opportunities)
descriptionHtml:
Launch your career with Amazon by solving complex operational challenges that impact millions of customers worldwide. As an Operations Manager in our Pathways Program — designed for recent MBA or Master's grads ready to make an immediate impact — you'll lead cross-functional teams, manage people, processes, and technology, and drive continuous improvement across one of the most innovative operations environments globally. From Day 1, you'll work on real business challenges, optimizing operations, enhancing the customer experience, and implementing scalable solutions across our global network. This is your opportunity to develop strategic leadership capabilities while building expertise in one of the world's most complex operational environments.

PROGRAM OVERVIEW:
Pathways is Amazon's three-year Operations Leadership Development Program, designed to cultivate the next generation of senior operations leadership at Amazon. Participants will gain high visibility with senior executives while tackling challenging assignments across diverse sites, technologies, and geographies within our world-class operations network. Day to day, participants will collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex operational challenges, take on progressively greater responsibilities, and work on real business initiatives that directly impact our operations. Along the way, participants will learn from experienced leaders, participate in cohort-based learning sessions, and build a network of peers who will become their professional community throughout their career at Amazon. This program is designed to build global leadership capabilities and prepare participants for executive-level impact.

- This program is open to external candidates only; current Amazon employees are not eligible to apply. The role appears on Amazon's internal portal solely for employee referral purposes.
- Candidates should be currently enrolled in an MBA or Master's program, or have graduated from one within the past 24 months.
- This role is for Pathways positions at Amazon operations facilities across the United States. Successful candidates will work with their recruiter to be matched to a site prior to receiving an offer.
- Candidates who apply to multiple Amazon MBA roles will only be selected to interview for one.
- Annual Pathways cohorts start between January and July. This application is for opportunities with start dates in 2027.

WHAT TO EXPECT:
Pathways graduates may lead organizations of nearly 4,000 people, manage labor budgets exceeding $2.5 million per week, and oversee $1B+ in capital projects. Here's how the program gets you there:

Step 1: Area Manager - Hit the ground running by leading 50–100 associates on the front lines of one of Amazon's world-class fulfillment, sortation, or delivery centers. This is where you'll build your operational foundation — learning how to lead people and systems at scale.

Step 2: Operations Manager - Take on greater responsibility by leading and developing other managers. You'll drive process improvements and collaborate cross-functionally across your site, region, and network.

Step 3: Senior Operations Manager - Graduate from the program as a senior leader known for operational excellence. In this role, you'll lead through others to execute regional or network-level initiatives — whether that's launching a new business, leading a major project, or running an entire site.

SITE PLACEMENT & EXPECTED HOURS:
- Must be willing to relocate at time of hire. Placement is driven primarily by business need, with consideration given to individual location preferences.
- The role is based in one of Amazon's operations facilities across the United States, including fulfillment centers, sort centers, delivery stations, Amazon Air, return centers, or other warehouse environments. Successful candidates will work with their recruiter to be matched to a site prior to receiving an offer.
- This is a demanding, hands-on role where hours may vary based on seasonal peaks and operational needs. Candidates should expect to work weekends, holidays, and/or overnight shifts, with overtime as needed.

COMPENSATION:
Total compensation for Pathways Operations includes three elements: (1) Base pay, (2) Sign-on bonus (paid over first two years), (3) Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).


Key job responsibilities
- Lead, coach, and develop your team, fostering a culture of accountability, growth, high performance, and customer obsession
- Partner with senior leadership to identify and solve complex business and operational challenges, thinking both strategically and tactically
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing operational data, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing scalable solutions
- Make real-time decisions in a fast-paced environment, balancing competing priorities to meet safety, quality, and productivity goals
- Collaborate cross-functionally with technology, engineering, and supply chain teams to improve end-to-end processes

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of professional or military experience
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a MBA or equivalent Master's level education degree
- Work flexible hours as business demands, including overnight, weekends and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Experience successfully leading and developing a team of direct and indirect reports

- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, an MBA in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics, or a related field
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Master of Engineering degree in one of the following disciplines: Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Systems, or Computer Engineering

descriptionHtml:
Garantire la sicurezza e il benessere dei nostri dipendenti sul luogo di lavoro è una priorità assoluta in Amazon. I nostri Safety Technician svolgono un ruolo fondamentale per renderlo possibile. Questo ruolo rappresenta un'opportunità per avviare la tua carriera nella sicurezza sul lavoro e crescere in un'azienda internazionale. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con i nostri esperti per monitorare il tuo sito, potendo così constatare ogni giorno la differenza che fai per il benessere delle persone.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è Logistica, Trasporti e Merci. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 3 del CCNL di riferimento.

Key job responsibilities
- Eseguire valutazioni del rischio e audit.
- Monitorare il sito per assicurarsi che i processi siano conformi alle procedure di sicurezza di Amazon.
- Creare e aggiornare i report sulle metriche di sicurezza da sottoporre ai colleghi.
- Collaborare con i colleghi di Operations e di tutta l'azienda su compiti relativi alla sicurezza e offrire indicazioni sui processi.
- Supportare l'implementazione di nuove misure di sicurezza

A day in the life
Lavorerai in uno dei nostri siti. Questo significa che potrai seguire da vicino ciò che accade e i colleghi potranno rivolgersi a te con domande durante i loro turni. Questo ruolo consiste nell'individuare potenziali problemi prima che si verifichino. Dedicherai molto tempo a controllare il sito e a osservare come le persone utilizzano le attrezzature. Comprendendo il funzionamento di ogni attività e di ogni macchinario, sarai in grado di individuare il modo migliore per mantenere i processi sicuri.

Sarai anche una delle persone che mettono in atto i cambiamenti in materia di sicurezza, il che significa che lavorerai a stretto contatto con molte persone. Oltre alle tue mansioni quotidiane e settimanali, offrirai supporto al team Operations su attività ad hoc legate alla sicurezza.

La sicurezza è fondamentale per Amazon, e ci aiuterai a raccogliere i dati essenziali che ci permettono di tenere sotto controllo i nostri processi e di prevenire qualsiasi problema. Condividerai questi dati con i colleghi di tutta l'azienda e collaborerai con altri team per assicurare che la sicurezza sia sempre al primo posto.

About the team
Il team Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire il benessere mentale e fisico dei nostri dipendenti sul luogo di lavoro. Il nostro team collabora con responsabili, associati e autorità locali in tutti i nostri siti, assicurando il rispetto delle politiche di Amazon e delle normative vigenti, e garantendo la sicurezza dei nostri ambienti di lavoro. Il team offre una varietà di opportunità, dai Safety Technician ai Programme Manager. Indipendentemente dal tuo ruolo, contribuirai allo sviluppo e all'implementazione della strategia di sicurezza sull'intera rete.

- Conoscenza delle norme e degli standard di sicurezza essenziali; Speak, write, and read fluently in Italian
