title: Principal Development Manager , Global Engineering Operations Service (GOES)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon operates a world-class network of large, technologically advanced fulfillment centers across North America. The North American Operations (NA Ops) Real Estate Team is responsible for strategic development, acquisition, and disposition of all facilities in the Amazon Fulfillment Network.

The Principal Development Manager will serve as a strategic leader within the NA Ops Real Estate Team, responsible for driving the most complex and high-impact real estate transactions supporting the continued expansion of Amazon's North America Customer Fulfillment (NACF) network. Operating with complete independence, this individual will define transaction strategy for significantly complex deals, influence senior leaders (VP+) across organizations, and establish the frameworks and mechanisms that enable the broader team to scale effectively. This role demands exceptional commercial real estate expertise, sophisticated financial and analytical capabilities, and the ability to drive clarity and alignment across ambiguous, high-stakes situations.

The Principal Development Manager will own build-to-suit (BTS) transactions end-to-end, lead a high volume of high-profile transaction activities, and serve as the team's escalation point for the most challenging deals. Beyond individual transaction execution, this role is responsible for delivering a vision for process improvement, creating cross-organizational structures that accelerate progress, and mentoring the next generation of transaction professionals.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and execute complex, high-profile real estate transactions for the NACF network, including build-to-suit developments, large-scale acquisitions, and strategic portfolio transactions that have multi-organizational impact

- Define transaction strategy in ambiguous environments where the business problem may not be clearly articulated, driving clarity and creating actionable plans that align with Amazon's long-term network vision

- Influence and align senior leaders across multiple organizations to drive coherent approaches to site selection, investment decisions, and portfolio strategy

- Lead deep-dive analyses into due diligence reports, evaluate whether further investigation is required, and drive sound decision-making on significantly complex environmental, zoning, entitlement, and infrastructure issues

- Drive cash flow preparations and key transaction steps for the most complex deals, applying sound knowledge of real estate law to mitigate complexity risks

- Establish and manage strategic relationships with senior brokers, developers, investors, landlords, municipalities, and government authorities to define strategic objectives and secure competitive advantages

- Deliver a vision for process improvement that transforms how organizations align and interact to achieve goals, creating or optimizing cross-organizational structures and mechanisms that accelerate progress

- Serve as the escalation point for the team on the most challenging transactions, deconstructing complexity into appropriate simplicity and making trade-offs between opportunity, resources, and sustainability

- Drive portfolio-wide strategy that considers network optimization, MSA positioning, and long-term optionality for Amazon's evolving fulfillment needs

- Travel throughout North America up to 30% of the time to evaluate sites, oversee transaction activities, and maintain senior stakeholder relationships

A day in the life
The NA Ops Real Estate Team secures real estate for Amazon operations across the continent. As a Principal Development Manager, you will operate at the intersection of strategy and execution, shaping Amazon's NACF network through the most complex and impactful transactions. Your day might include aligning VP-level stakeholders on a multi-site portfolio strategy, driving a build-to-suit negotiation to close, mentoring a team member through a challenging deal, or establishing a new cross-organizational mechanism that improves how the entire team delivers. You bring clarity to ambiguity, turn complex problems into simple solutions, and influence outcomes that shape Amazon's fulfillment capacity for years to come.

About the team
Our North American Operations Real Estate Team secures real estate for Amazon operations across the continent. In this role, you'll directly influence current business requirements while helping shape and forecast future capacity needs that aren't yet published. As a Principal-level contributor, you'll set the strategic direction for how the team approaches the most complex transactions and build the mechanisms that enable scalable, repeatable success.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of managing stakeholders in cross-functional project experience
- 10+ years of commercial real estate transaction management experience, including complex lease negotiations, build-to-suit developments, and purchase agreements
- Experience leading significantly complex transactions with demonstrated ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments
- 5+ years of experience demonstrating financial acumen with experience building and evaluating investment models, cash flow analyses, and comparative site evaluations for large scale projects

Preferred qualifications

- 12+ years of commercial real estate transactions experience in an industrial, logistics, or data center environment

title: Engineering Operations Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Physical Requirements:
• Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
• Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
• Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
• Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
• Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection
This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.


Key job responsibilities
• Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
• Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
• Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
• Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
• Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
• Technical writing to support change management program
• Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
• On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
• Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
• Role may support more than one location/site.


A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical or mechanical, or 1+ years of data center or mission critical facilities (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.) experience
- High school or equivalent diploma
- Ability to work on a flexible schedule including days, nights, and/or weekends.

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- 2+ years of Data Center Engineering experience
- Technical (Military/Trade School) training
- Associate or higher education in related field

title: Radiation Effects Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

As a Radiation Effects Engineer, you will join a small team focused on the qualification of electronics components used on a satellites constellation and take an active role in root-cause analysis of on-orbit events. Your day-to-day work will include collaborating with design engineers to coordinate radiation testing and drive mitigation strategies of common error modes, analyzing satellite enclosures for TID robustness, and review on-orbit data to determine root-cause of common errors.

- Lead root-cause analysis of on-orbit radiation events. Develop tools and dashboards to organize and visualize on-orbit events.

- Bachelor's degree or above in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- 3+ years of experience in avionics development including electronic component selection and radiation test
- Hands-on experience conducting radiation test campaigns using heavy ion and proton beam facilities for SEE characterization, and gamma ray sources (e.g., Co-60) for TID testing
- Experience with including evaluating Single Event Effects (SEE) and Total Ionizing Dose (TID) on electronic components and systems.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with particle transport tools such as FastRAD, NOVICE or GEANT4

- Knowledge of AWS tools such as S3 and DynamoDB

descriptionHtml:

Whenever a customer visits an Amazon site worldwide and types in a query or browses through product categories, Amazon Product Search services go to work. We design, develop, and deploy high performance, fault-tolerant distributed search systems used by millions of Amazon customers every day. Our Search Relevance team works to maximize the quality and effectiveness of the search experience for visitors to Amazon websites worldwide.

The Search Relevance team focuses on several technical areas for improving search quality. In this role, you will invent universally applicable signals and algorithms for training machine-learned ranking models. The relevance improvements you make will help millions of customers discover the products they want from a catalog containing millions of products. title: Sr. Program Manager, Inbound Strategy, Long Term Network Planning
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Inbound Long Term Planning team owns the topology framework that decides what the EU inbound network looks like in 2–3 years: which node types we build, where we place them, how they interact, and what inventory configuration they unlock. This role owns a critical slice of that framework — taking speed ambitions and placement targets and working backwards into the physical network design across 1DCs, RDCs, and IXDs that makes them achievable. It's the kind of problem where getting the answer right saves hundreds of millions of dollars; getting it wrong means we either over-invest or structurally cap our speed ceiling for years.

You'll work at the intersection of network topology, inventory science, and capital allocation — partnering deeply with Finance, IIPO, AIM, and business teams to determine the optimal long-term node configuration that delivers placement targets per outbound node type and selection cohort. This is a single-threaded role with high ambiguity and regular exposure to senior leadership across SCOT, Operations, and Finance.

Key job responsibilities
Key Job Responsibilities

- Own the long-term inbound topology framework — determine the optimal combination of node types, locations, and capacities that achieves placement targets at minimum total cost.

- Define network configuration per selection cohort — decide velocity demarcations between node types, regional zoning, and upstream storage share. Know when the model breaks and why.
- Build the multi-year inbound build plan — sequence node launches, size them against volume trajectories, and own the placement and inventory commitments that justify the investment.
- Resolve structural trade-offs that don't have clean owners. Frame options, quantify impact, and drive decisions when priorities across teams or geographies conflict.
- Align senior leadership to a single answer. Write the strategy documents that SCOT, Finance, IIPO, and Operations commit to. When priorities diverge, you reconcile.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in program or project management
- Experience in supply chain
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Experience leading process improvements

title: Senior Category Manager, WWRGD- Retail Growth & Development
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's fast-scaling Worldwide Retail, Growth and Development (WWRGD) Grocery business is looking for a Senior Category Manager to join the team. In this role, you will drive category-level procurement strategy for the WWRGD Grocery business, with direct ownership of financial performance, supplier partnerships, and total cost of ownership. Your scope will span Grocery FFE, building systems, design and construction contractors, consultants, and materials.

As a Senior Category Manager (Program Manager III), you will be a high-impact individual contributor at the center of WWRGD's growth engine, executing multi-category programs that directly support Amazon's ambition to scale from ~560 to 1,700+ grocery locations. You will:

- Drive end-to-end category management across Grocery retail and industrial FFE, building systems, design consulting, and construction materials and services.
- Own supplier negotiations, business plans, and savings realization for assigned categories — managing for total cost of ownership, lead time, sustainability and supply chain resilience.
- Drive cross-functional alignment with key partners — building trust and shared ownership around category strategy and business outcomes.
- Work at the intersection of procurement and merchandising strategy, CapEx investment, and customer and associate experience.
Join a team navigating ambitious growth with a mission to scale and senior leadership visibility.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and manage the end-to-end lifecycle for assigned procurement categories — from strategy execution through supplier performance and continuous improvement.
- Set category-level strategic direction that optimizes for long-term cost, quality, supply continuity, and customer outcomes.
- Conduct financial analysis of business opportunities; drive initiatives to meet and exceed financial goals, including CapEx investment and category P&L accountability.
- Initiate, structure, and negotiate partnerships with new and existing suppliers; develop business plans for new opportunities and execute project plans for pilots, launches, and long-term operations.
- Act as the business owner for assigned categories, accountable for identifying and driving realization of savings opportunities.
- Manage supplier relationships and performance; serve as the primary business contact for key suppliers.
- Build and streamline processes that simplify operations and drive continual improvement.
- Analyze industry trends and evolving technology to proactively identify supply base opportunities that reduce cost, minimize risk, protect continuity of supply, and support sustainability.
- Drive cross-functional alignment with key partners — building trust and shared ownership around category strategy and business outcomes.
- Own program status communication; build consensus on project prioritization and act decisively to implement and capture value.
- Travel up to 20%.

A day in the life
On any given day, you might be modeling total cost of ownership for a new equipment specification, aligning with Design and Construction partners on a category sourcing timeline, or leading a supplier negotiation to secure lead time commitments ahead of a pipeline milestone.

You'll engage regularly across Indirect Procurement, Operational Excellence, Merchandising, and site-level buying teams — translating business requirements into procurement decisions that move with speed and confidence. The problems you'll solve range from supply disruption and cost pressure to building procurement mechanisms that scale across multiple retail formats and geographies.

About the team
Our mission is to deliver best-in-class category leadership across the WWRGD value chain, driving cost optimization, scalability, speed to market, and supplier excellence through innovative strategies, deep industry expertise and collaborative partnership. We lead category strategy across design consulting, construction materials and services, Grocery retail and industrial FFE, and building systems. Team members target improvement in total cost of ownership, working closely with extended stakeholders to align procurement strategies with business requirements.

- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience in complex problem solving, and working in a tight schedule environment
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related technical field

- Experience practicing best-in-class procurement processes (category management, benchmarking, should-cost models, RFX, reverse auction, contracting, or equivalent)

- 5+ years of category management experience with fixtures and equipment in retail and food production environments, construction, and/or refrigeration.

Llevar a cabo tareas de mantenimiento proactivo y de prevención de una gran variedad de equipos.
Realizar reparaciones reactivas y diagnósticos de averías en un almacén de distribución en funcionamiento.
Utilizar las herramientas más modernas para maximizar la eficacia de los equipos.
Respetar todas las políticas y prácticas en materia de salud y seguridad.
Contribuir al desarrollo y la formación de los empleados en prácticas.
Trabajar en proyectos de mejora continua e implantar buenas prácticas en distintos centros de la UE.

A day in the life
Nuestros/as técnicos/as de mantenimiento y fiabilidad trabajan sobre el terreno en nuestros centros, lo que les permite responder rápidamente ante cualquier problema que surja con la maquinaria. Te encargarás del mantenimiento preventivo planificado de los equipos de nuestras instalaciones para garantizar que funcionen con seguridad. Como técnico/a de ingeniería de mantenimiento y fiabilidad, también deberás reaccionar con celeridad ante cualquier avería, investigando, identificando y aplicando soluciones lo antes posible. También propondrás mejoras a largo plazo.
Te encargarás de las tareas diarias de mantenimiento, como pintura y fontanería, codo con codo con los miembros sénior de tu equipo, y te pondrás en contacto con contratistas si hace falta ayuda externa. Trabajarás en distintos turnos para garantizar que nuestros centros cuentan con un servicio de asistencia las 24 horas del día, lo que permitirá a Amazon realizar sus entregas a la velocidad acostumbrada.

About the team
Nuestro equipo de ingenieros de mantenimiento y fiabilidad (RME) se encarga de que nuestros sistemas funcionen a pleno rendimiento. Nos caracterizamos por nuestra gran aptitud técnica y nuestra excelente capacidad para el trabajo en equipo, liderados por unos responsables con gran experiencia. Nuestro trabajo comprende el mantenimiento, la reparación y la solución de problemas relacionados con los equipos en toda nuestra red mundial de centros de distribución. El equipo cuenta con una serie de perfiles de dirección que se encargan de supervisar el desarrollo de tecnologías fascinantes, algunas de las cuales solo existen en Amazon.
Nuestro equipo se ocupa de la mayoría de los aspectos técnicos de Amazon, desempeñando tareas que van desde la instalación de sistemas automatizados de embalaje hasta la supervisión del mantenimiento general de un centro o la reparación de equipos clave de distribución. Esto incluye adaptar los edificios a la legislación vigente, para que todo el personal esté seguro y nuestras instalaciones funcionen con la mayor eficiencia posible. El equipo de RME, al igual que ocurre en otros departamentos de Amazon, ofrece numerosas oportunidades de progresar profesionalmente.
Todo nuestro trabajo gira en torno a reducir los periodos de inactividad en los centros de operaciones cruciales de Amazon, para que los clientes reciban sus pedidos a tiempo. Con frecuencia, trabajamos de madrugada o a altas horas de la noche para poder realizar las tareas de mantenimiento ocasionando las mínimas molestias, por lo que hacemos turnos nocturnos. Si descubrimos que hay una forma mejor de hacer algo, tenemos la capacidad y la posibilidad de desarrollar e introducir procesos totalmente nuevos o tecnología punta, como Amazon Robotics y nuestro clasificador de artículos complejos.

title: Principal Worldwide GTM Specialist, Amazon WorkSpaces AI
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
The way people work is being fundamentally reimagined. Enterprises and organizations are moving beyond traditional desktops toward intelligent, cloud-native workspaces that adapt to how people actually work—powered by AI, secured by design, and delivered anywhere. The workspace is no longer just for humans. Enterprises are moving from traditional virtual desktops to intelligent, cloud-native environments where people and AI agents work side by side — governed by design, observable by default, and delivered anywhere. Amazon WorkSpaces is leading this transformation with WorkSpaces for Agents (now generally available), alongside WorkSpaces Personal, WorkSpaces Core, and WorkSpaces Applications. Together with services like AWS Context and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, we're building the operating environment for the next enterprise workforce — one where AI agents navigate applications, automate workflows, and build institutional knowledge inside trusted boundaries. The companies that lead won't just have the smartest AI — they'll build the most trustworthy place for intelligence to work.

AWS is seeking a Worldwide (WW) GTM Specialist to accelerate adoption of Amazon WorkSpaces' AI and agentic capabilities. You will be part of a dedicated team focused on bringing these emerging solutions to market — defining the vision for agentic workspaces, building GTM motions around AI-enhanced features, and helping customers understand how governed cloud workspaces become the operating environment for their human + agent workforce. You'll be charting new territory at the intersection of end-user computing and enterprise AI — identifying early adopters, shaping lighthouse engagements, and building repeatable plays that scale.

You are a strategic thinker who operates with urgency. You combine deep business acumen with enough technical depth to be credible with CIOs and IT leaders navigating the shift to agentic work. You understand that the hardest problem isn't teaching an agent to click — it's making sure those clicks happen inside an environment the organization can trust. You've built GTM strategies in emerging technology categories, rallied cross-functional teams around a shared vision, and delivered measurable business results. You're energized by ambiguity — because that's where the biggest opportunities live.


Key job responsibilities
Define and execute the GTM strategy for Amazon WorkSpaces AI and agentic solutions — identifying high-value customer segments where agents can drive immediate productivity gains, and building programs that accelerate early adoption of WorkSpaces for Agents, AI-enhanced desktop experiences, and governed agentic environments.

Shape the narrative around the future of agentic workspaces — positioning AWS as the leader in trusted environments where humans and AI agents work together, with built-in governance, observability, and identity management that enable enterprises to scale autonomous work confidently.

Engage directly with enterprise leaders and partners connecting agentic workspace capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

Build and scale lighthouse engagements with early adopters deploying AI agents in enterprise environments — then operationalizing learnings from those wins into repeatable plays.

Establish data-driven mechanisms to measure adoption of agentic features, track program effectiveness, and continuously optimize the path from pilot to production-scale agent deployment.

Evangelize the agentic workspace vision externally through thought leadership, events, and industry engagement — and internally across AWS to drive mindshare and investment in this emerging category.

Orchestrate field uptake of AI-focused sales plays, equipping the broader sales organization to identify and qualify agentic workspace opportunities and deliver value through repeatable mechanisms.

title: Finance Manager, Customer Service, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is seeking an experienced Finance Manager to lead financial planning and analysis for our Customer Service organization. This role is central to our mission of providing fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities worldwide through our constellation of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites.

As a member of our Customer Operations (GCOPS) Finance team, you will own the end-to-end financial models for B2B and B2C customer support, concessions, and cost of payments. You will partner directly with customer care leadership to translate operational metrics – contact rates, cost per contact, outsourcing mix, and agent productivity – into actionable financial forecasts that anchor the Long-Range Plan and annual operating plans. This role offers the unique opportunity to help scale customer service finance from pre-launch through General Availability and rapid subscriber growth.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and evolve customer service financial models spanning enterprise and consumer segments, including cost-per-contact economics, in-house vs. outsourced delivery trade-offs, and multi-year cost projections that scale with subscriber growth

- Drive annual and long-range financial planning for a multi-billion-dollar customer service cost structure, including rate card development, scenario modeling, and executive-level variance narratives

- Deliver month-end close processes for CS partner invoicing and accruals via self-invoicing mechanisms; maintain accrual-to-actuals accuracy targets (>98%)

- Develop and maintain the concessions model, tracking cost exposure as a percentage of revenue and driving proactive strategies to reduce concession spend over time

- Provide financial analysis for outsourcing strategy decisions – vendor pricing evaluations, make-vs-buy tradeoffs, and recommendations that inform leadership on partner selection

- Support the Defect Elimination initiative by quantifying Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) impact and building the financial case for defect reduction investments

- Build and maintain scorecards and metrics for CS financial and operational performance; present insights to senior leadership and identify improvement levers

- Partner with cost-of-payments and bad-debt teams to ensure holistic customer operations cost visibility

- Drive productivity and automation in financial planning processes, including leveraging AI/ML tools to accelerate model updates and reduce cycle time

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing the latest outsourced contact center invoice reconciliation and confirming month-end accruals are tracking within tolerance.

Mid-morning, you join the weekly CS modeling sync with customer care leadership to align on contact rate assumptions for the next planning cycle.

After lunch, you're deep in the forecast model, layering in a new customer segment that the enterprise sales team just scoped.

Later, you present your cost narrative to senior leadership, highlighting rate improvements driven by vendor productivity gains.

Before wrapping up, you review the latest concessions trend data and flag a spike to your business partner with a recommendation to investigate.

About the team
You'll join the Global Customer Operations Finance (GCOPS) team within Amazon Leo, reporting to a Finance leader who also owns Leo's consolidated long-range financial plan.

This team provides controllership across field services, customer support, cost of payments, and bad debt management. As Leo scales to commercial launch, you'll shape frameworks that balance operational efficiency with exceptional customer experience.

Beyond your core CS remit, you'll contribute to Leo-wide strategic planning – multi-year investment modeling, scenario analysis, and executive narratives that span Leo's global business.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science)
- 5+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 5+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
- 5+ years of leading cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- 5+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
- Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of SQL/ETL
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
- 5+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- Understanding of subscription-based business models and customer lifetime value frameworks
- Experience with cost-per-contact analysis, handle time optimization, and workforce management metrics

descriptionHtml:

We're seeking a dedicated Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Manager to join our mission of creating the world's safest work environment. title: Software Engineer, AppSTAR COMPASS
descriptionHtml:
Write the code behind the system that decides how security attention gets spent. You'll join a brand-new team building at Amazon scale, on a platform that evaluates every code change tens of thousands of engineers ship and clears the vast majority without a human ever touching it.

Security review has always been a bottleneck. A developer ships a change, waits for someone to look at it, and the security team drowns in a queue it can never fully clear. We're ending that tradeoff. Our engine evaluates changes as they happen, decides how much scrutiny each one actually needs, and handles the common case automatically: no wait for the developer, no queue for the reviewer.

The team is funded and forming now, which means you'll be building features on a system that doesn't exist yet rather than maintaining one that does. You'll have senior engineers to learn from on the design side and security engineers backing you with the risk expertise, so you're building against what actually matters instead of guessing. If you want your code to be the reason a security review takes zero minutes instead of two weeks, come build it.

- Own real features on a greenfield platform, end to end
- Work on agentic and automated evaluation running continuously at high volume
- Learn the security side from engineers who do it every day


Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, deploy, and operate features of the platform that evaluates code changes for security risk and routes the ones that need a human.
- Own your features across their full lifecycle, from working out what the customer actually needs through production operation and the documentation that lets someone else maintain it.
- Write code that meets a high bar for correctness, testing, security, and operability, and keep it that way as the system grows.
- Build and tune automated evaluation logic, including agentic checks, working with the security engineers who understand what the checks need to catch.
- Partner with senior engineers on design, bringing them the hard tradeoffs and clarifying requirements that arrive incomplete.
- Participate actively in code review, giving useful feedback to teammates at every level.
- Take part in operational support and on-call. When something breaks, find the root cause and fix it permanently rather than patching around it.
- Document how your software works, how it's operated, and how it fits the bigger picture, and help new teammates get up to speed on it.
- Look for the improvements nobody asked for: the flaky test, the manual step, the slow path.

A day in the life
Most of your day is designing and writing code on a system that's still taking shape. You'll pick up a feature, work out the approach, take the tricky parts to a senior engineer or a design review, then build it and ship it. Some days you're deep in why a class of change is getting evaluated wrong at volume. Others you're on operational support, chasing a root cause. You'll sit with security engineers to understand what your code needs to catch, and review your teammates' code as often as they review yours.

About the team
We decide how security attention gets spent, automatically. Our customers are the engineers shipping code every day and the security engineers reviewing it, and right now both pay a tax we think is avoidable. Our job is to remove it. We're brand new, small, and close enough to the outcome that you'll see your work land. We hold a high bar on code and operations because automated decisions have to be trustworthy, and we'd rather encode expertise into a mechanism than depend on one person holding it.

As such, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain any necessary export licenses or approvals based on their nationality, citizenship, and any other factors considered by the applicable export control regulations.

- Establish and oversee performance metrics and conduct regular performance reviews of customs brokers (including transit time, compliance accuracy, cost, customs broker performance and relevant data for LEO’s GTC leadership)
- Implement standardized regional processes for broker management and communication
- Resolve escalated issues related to customs clearance and broker operations

Leadership Support
- Provide regular reporting and insights to the APAC GTC Lead
- Support global GTC initiatives and projects for Amazon Leo
- Represent APAC region in global GTC forums and discussions
- Contribute to strategic planning for trade compliance improvements

title: Program Manager II, AWS Health & Safety
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, the Leadership Principle "Strive to be Earth's Best Employer" challenges us to create a safer, more productive, and higher performing environment, reinforcing that nothing is more important than the safety and well-being of our teams. At AWS Health and Safety, we take that challenge seriously. Our Programs team sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and people, driving the initiatives and standards that protect employees and partners across the globe. We believe that great safety outcomes are built on great programs, and we are looking for passionate, driven individuals who are ready to roll up their sleeves, collaborate across teams, and make a meaningful impact at scale.

The AWS Health and Safety (H&S) team is an expanding, dynamic team that is critical to enabling AWS’s growth around the world, as well as ensuring compliance of AWS’s global operations, including physical data centers, as well as other AWS facilities, customer-facing enterprises and products. The H&S team has responsibility for architecting and implementing AWS’s global safety programs. This includes defining and implementing risk management and compliance systems and driving their continuous improvement; setting and refining global policies and procedures; overseeing the development of standards, tools, auditing and metrics, and employee training; ensuring effective engagement by H&S teams on global initiatives, including those that are part of Amazon’s ambitious sustainability goals; providing specialist expertise; and engaging with all AWS business units to provide scalable and H&S compliance strategies that support current and future business objectives while ensuring employee safety and compliance with H&S regulations.


As a Program Manager, you will work across teams to collaborate, generate buy-in, develop and execute to a plan. You will drive the expansion and growth of our global safety programs, scaling globally. You will play a crucial role in devising strategies, fostering partnerships, and executing initiatives to enhance the program's reach and impact. This entails serving as the main point of contact for stakeholders in coordinating and managing strategic, cross-functional, and business-critical programs and projects.

The ideal candidate excels at large-scale global Health & Safety programs planning & Implementation, encompassing gap analysis, ideation, planning, implementation, and retrospectives in a dynamic and diverse business environment. Effective communication and program management skills are essential, enabling you to manage multiple competing priorities and coordinate work across teams. The successful candidate will be proficient at working with data to identify trends, identify improvement opportunities, and proactively define plans to realize these opportunities.
To be successful in this role, the candidate will effectively multitask and prioritize, utilize data to encourage decisions, and maintain a high level of independence. They will be comfortable working in a growing and ambiguous work environment as we constantly improve and innovate. The successful candidate must have solid written and verbal communications skills, the ability to influence stakeholders, and willingness to dive deep into details.

Key job responsibilities
• Accountable for the overall Health & Safety program strategy and planning, communicate program requirements, negotiate priorities, and define success metrics
• Apply project management best practices to drive plan execution, mitigate risks, and improve effectiveness to deliver results in a timely manner
• Continuously improve program components and mechanisms to drive results and provide program status communication, deliver clear and concise summaries to leadership teams and effectively answer questions
• Serve as the primary point of contact for coordinating and managing strategic, cross-functional, and business-critical safety programs and projects
• Build partnerships with key stakeholders and organizations to promote H&S program adoption.
• Effectively communicate and manage multiple, competing priorities while coordinating work across teams
• Define, track, and monitor progress against success metrics and project plans. Analyze and report on overall project health using key performance indicators and success metrics, and accurately and clearly report on status against program objectives

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: 【Class of 2028／Full-Time】Applied Scientists , Amazon International Stores, Amazon Japan Store Tech
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to see your research directly impact how millions of customers discover, browse, and purchase products on Amazon — across Japan and the globe?

Amazon's Japan Store Tech team owns the science and technology behind cross-border shopping — product discovery, search relevance, personalization, and content experiences spanning dozens of marketplaces. We tackle problems at massive scale: multi-language signals, multi-marketplace data, and region-specific customer behaviors, all served at low latency to millions of daily shoppers.

We're looking for current Bachelor, Master or PhD students with a passion for applied science and machine learning to join us as an Applied Scientist in 2028 to shape the future of customer experiences at scale. For this position, our Japan Store Tech team is looking for students with a specialization in one or more of the following research areas: machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), information retrieval, recommender systems, computer vision, large language models (LLMs), generative AI, causal inference, experimentation and A/B testing, optimization, and more!

As an Applied Scientist, you'll develop novel models and algorithms, design and run experiments on live traffic, and own meaningful science contributions end-to-end. You'll also leverage and contribute to GenAI/LLM systems that power both customer-facing experiences and internal development tools.

If you want to kickstart your science career at global scale — solving real customer problems alongside talented scientists and engineers in a collaborative, international environment — this is the place to start.

Selection Communication Begins:
October 5, 2026
Offer Extensions:
December 2026 – March 2027

Key job responsibilities
- Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, develop, and deploy innovative machine learning models and scientific solutions that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.

- Design and conduct experiments (offline and online) to validate hypotheses and measure the impact of proposed solutions.

- Analyze large-scale datasets to identify patterns, generate insights, and inform model design decisions.

- Leverage and contribute to the development of GenAI and LLM-powered tools to enhance customer experiences and development productivity while staying current with emerging technologies.

Basic qualifications

Preferred qualifications

- Publications or submitted papers in top-tier venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, EMNLP, CVPR, KDD, WWW, RecSys, SIGIR).

title: Sr. Electrical Engineer, Sustainability Engineering
descriptionHtml:
The Sustainability Engineering team is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to drive the definition, development, and continuous improvement of electrical infrastructure standards across Amazon facilities in Europe.

You will join a team which:
• Enables EV charging infrastructure implementation through electrical design definition and review
• Develops grid infrastructure standards spanning high-voltage up to 24 kV (HV) and low-voltage (LV) systems, ensuring a coordinated and resilient approach to grid design
• Explores emerging technologies to address evolving sustainability needs, with emphasis on smart grid integration, efficiency, and resilience
• Drives end-to-end deployment of EV chargers and other sustainability technologies across European sites
• Defines processes for procurement and maintenance of electrical and sustainability infrastructure
• Owns cost budgeting, forecasting, and tracking across sustainability programmes

Possible locations for this role: Luxembourg, London, Munich, Milan, Madrid, and Barcelona

Amazon is committed to building a sustainable future for our customers, local communities, and the planet. Under The Climate Pledge, we committed to achieving net-zero carbon across our business by 2040, ten years ahead of the Paris Agreement. To get there, we need driven people who are dedicated to making a meaningful impact through sustainable energy technologies and scalable infrastructure design.

Key job responsibilities
• Own and develop electrical equipment standards, including standard designs for core electrical infrastructure in partnership with manufacturers and internal stakeholders
• Perform design validation and review to ensure compliance with established electrical standards during installation and commissioning of infrastructure
• Act as subject matter expert (SME) for LV and HV (up to 24kV) electrical systems
• Align stakeholder expectations and define technical requirements for EV charging network infrastructure and smart grid deployments
• Drive the technology roadmap for electrical infrastructure, including EV chargers, substations, energy efficiency solutions, and IoT technologies (e.g. smart metres)
• Develop business cases and present recommendations to leadership to secure approval for programme scoping and investment decisions
• Coordinate with programme managers to ensure quality and standards compliance across large-scale installations
• Drive process improvement across commissioning, audit, value engineering, and cost control activities


A day in the life
Your day could include engagement with all levels of the organisation and multiple stakeholder groups to drive short-, mid-, and long-term technical decisions with large-scale impact across the Amazon network. You will also work with partners from Operations, Reliability & Maintenance, Health and Safety, Global Fleet Product, Finance, Procurement, and external vendors to design and deploy electrical infrastructure across Amazon’s operational sites in Europe.

About the team
The Sustainability Engineering team drives the execution and deployment of EV charging infrastructure, grid connections, and smart grid solutions across Amazon’s European sites. We manage supply chain, procurement, and maintenance activities, and define the processes that ensure consistent, scalable delivery. To enable this, the team develops and continuously improves electrical standards and technologies that underpin reliable, compliant deployment at pace. We power Amazon’s sustainable growth through operational excellence and continuous innovation.

Basic qualifications

- Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field, with experience in electrical infrastructure design, standards development, or large-scale electrical systems implementation
- Experience driving technical programmes across multiple European countries in a corporate environment
- Demonstrated knowledge of HV and/or LV electrical distribution systems (up to 24kV) and applicable standards

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in technical program and product management, technical development or related roles in the industrial EV charging solutions sector
- Proficiency in one or more European languages (in addition to English)
- Experience working with public grid operators or Distribution System Operators (DSOs)
- Working knowledge of national grid codes and DSO requirements in one or more EU/UK markets
- Experience with protection coordination, fault level analysis, or power systems modelling
- Chartered Electrical Engineer (CEng) or equivalent professional registration

title: Senior UX Designer, Amazon Fulfillment Technologies
descriptionHtml:
Want to help scale Amazon's global fulfillment workforce, supporting them with efficient, engaging, and empowering experiences while keeping them safe and happy? Join the Amazon Fulfillment Technologies Experience Design team (AFT-XD). We are seeking a Senior UX Designer who is passionate about the intersection of the physical and virtual worlds, reaching beyond what is shown on a screen to include the physical environment, building layout, equipment, work processes, and emerging modalities like AI-mediated interactions, computer vision, and voice interfaces.

The ideal candidate is a problem-solver who owns outcomes end-to-end. You understand business impact and technical constraints, proactively frame problems worth solving, and deliver solutions that scale across Amazon's global fulfillment network. You will own a portfolio with a defined charter, maintain a roadmap balancing big bets and strategic priorities, and influence stakeholders across multiple organizations. As a Senior UX Designer, you will work alongside product managers, engineers, and researchers to improve the safety, productivity, and engagement of 1M+ Amazon associates worldwide. You will drive the user experience from a global perspective, ground decisions in research and operational reality, and communicate the impact of your work crisply at the leadership level.

This role spans the full product design lifecycle: research, problem-framing, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and measuring post-launch impact. You will develop fluency in emerging technologies within your domain and leverage AI tools to accelerate your workflows. Where applicable, you may push front-end code and contribute to production readiness.

What can we offer you in return?

You will be part of a growing team that will support, challenge, and inspire you every day. AFT-XD is a multidisciplinary team of designers, researchers, design technologists, and program managers who shape and simplify the fulfillment center experience through a human-centered design process. Our experiences span a range of devices and modalities that evolve as rapidly as our operations do. You will work on complex, strategic products that rethink how fulfillment centers work. You will own a clear charter within a business portfolio, build deep domain expertise, and develop continuity with key stakeholders to support long-term influence. Your primary portfolio is your north star for growth and impact, with opportunities to flex onto cross-cutting initiatives based on team needs. In addition, you will have access to mentorship from senior designers, IC design leads, and the broader Amazon design community. We invest in our team members to help them build their unique careers.

Key job responsibilities
- Own a well-defined charter within your business portfolio. Frame problems worth solving by understanding business objectives, technical constraints, and operational context. Advocate for the user's point of view while balancing feasibility and business impact.
- Drive the full product design lifecycle: research, problem-framing, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and post-launch measurement. Deliver solutions through whatever artifact communicates the idea most effectively, whether that's journey maps, user flows, wireframes, clickable prototypes, high-fidelity mockups, or production-ready specifications.
- Partner closely with product managers and engineers on problem-framing and solution definition. Run research, build prototypes, and measure post-launch impact for high-priority initiatives.
- Develop fluency in emerging technologies within your domain (e.g., human-agent interaction, AR/CV patterns, AI-assisted prototyping). Leverage AI tools to accelerate design workflows. Where applicable, push front-end code and contribute to production readiness.
- Communicate the work and its impact crisply and frequently at the leadership level. Build continuity with key stakeholders (L7s, L8s, partner teams) to support long-term influence.
- Maintain a 6-12 month roadmap balancing big bets and strategic priorities. Scope and manage work on assigned initiatives, provide regular progress updates, and escalate issues when needed.
- Run intake/prioritization, and sprint planning within your portfolio.
- Contribute to design infrastructure and standardization across AFT's products, including the team's design system. Surface proven patterns from project work for potential standardization.
- Ground decisions in operational reality by incorporating field research, customer feedback, usage metrics, and usability findings. Perform metrics analysis post-launch to inform ongoing optimization.
- Participate in peer mentoring, skill sharing, and the Bar Raiser Forum to raise the design bar within AFT and across Amazon.

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

We harmonize the physical and virtual world so Amazon customers can get what they want, when they want it.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS AppSync
descriptionHtml:
Do you enjoy working on distributed systems and solving problems of scale, availability, and low latency? Are you interested in building a large-scale distributed system that serves API traffic for applications around the world and stays seamless as traffic scales and infrastructure conditions change?

If so, then come join the AWS AppSync team. AWS AppSync is a fully managed, serverless service for building GraphQL and Pub/Sub APIs that securely connect applications to data and events at scale. Developers use AppSync to bring together data from sources like Amazon DynamoDB, AWS Lambda, and HTTP endpoints behind a single API endpoint, and to deliver real-time updates to connected clients through managed WebSocket subscriptions, without having to build and operate the underlying API infrastructure themselves.

We're looking for engineers who can independently design and deliver features and components of AWS AppSync. As a Software Development Engineer, you'll own the design, implementation, testing, and operation of meaningful parts of the service, make sound technical decisions, and contribute to the team's architecture and best practices. You'll continuously identify areas of growth within the existing frameworks, tools and processes to develop further technical mechanisms that reduce waste and continuously improve. You'll collaborate with engineers throughout the company who are building the next big thing in cloud computing. We need our engineers to be versatile, display strong ownership, and be enthusiastic to dive deep on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, and operate features and components of AWS AppSync
- Own delivery of well-scoped projects end to end, from design through production
- Contribute to the team's technical designs and decisions through design and code reviews
- Improve operational excellence, security, and quality in the areas you own
- Work with senior engineers to deliver features to customers around the globe

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirements and safety guidelines.

- Upholds all safety requirements in all zones and work locations of responsibility
- Assists in the development of new and junior team members and adheres to standards and procedures

- Rigging and critical lifts of bulky, sensitive flight hardware

Twitch Security Platform builds and operates the foundational software, data, and automation that enable security at scale across Twitch. descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. We’re seeking a dedicated Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Manager to help drive this mission forward. As our next WHS Manager, you'll be more than a safety professional – you'll be a catalyst for change, leading a comprehensive safety program that touches thousands of lives. Working at the intersection of operations and safety, you'll shape the future of workplace health while delivering real-time solutions that protect our most valuable asset: our people.

In this role, you'll serve as the site's safety facilitator, orchestrating our Global WHS Program with precision and passion. You'll partner with Operations leadership to weave safety into the fabric of our daily operations, using data-driven insights to create innovative solutions that reduce risk and enhance productivity. Your ability to build trust, influence change, and drive results will be crucial as you lead comprehensive risk assessments and transform safety data into actionable strategies.
Leadership is at the heart of this role. You'll build and develop a high-performing team of WHS professionals, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and excellence.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Leadership & Innovation - Transform safety culture through leadership and innovative solutions. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that set new benchmarks in workplace safety. Leverage technology and data analytics to drive preventive safety measures that protect our associates while enhancing operational excellence. Develop leadership plans, communicate expectations, and drive initiatives to create a safe work environment. Measure performance against WHS policies, analyze metrics, and conduct site audits to address non-compliance issues.

Strategic Partnership & Influence - Build partnerships with Operations leadership to integrate safety into every aspect of our business. Use compelling data analysis and risk insights to influence positive change and drive strategic decision-making. Establish yourself as a trusted advisor who balances safety excellence with operational demands. Oversee recordkeeping, workplace organization, and WHS training programs.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager , Amazon’s Worldwide Design and Engineering (WWDE) - Advanced Concept Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Design & Engineering (WWDE) organization is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to join our Advanced Concept Team. This team drives system-level design for early-stage fulfillment center concepts — defining next-generation automation solutions before they enter traditional design phases, at the intersection of business strategy, product development, and engineering feasibility.

You will lead complex, cross-functional program initiatives that transform early-stage concepts into executable programs — coordinating across multiple engineering organizations and partner technology teams. This role requires navigating highly ambiguous problem spaces where business problems, program strategy, and technology solutions are not yet defined. You will own the organizational mechanisms and operational processes that enable the team to execute effectively — driving rhythm, accountability, and resource alignment. You will present program strategies to senior leadership and manage the full lifecycle of concept-to-implementation programs, ensuring next-generation fulfillment systems are feasible, scalable, and deliver measurable business impact.



Key job responsibilities
- Lead end-to-end program management of complex, multi-team concept development initiatives across multiple automation and fulfillment technology domains

- Drive program execution across engineering organizations, resolving conflicts and building consensus on key program objectives

- Partner with engineering teams to ensure business objectives are translated into actionable technical requirements and functional specifications

- Manage program dependencies, risks, and critical path across diverse technical workstreams; proactively identify and resolve blockers

- Facilitate design reviews and architectural discussions, ensuring cost/schedule/performance trade-offs align with organizational goals

- Build executive-level program documentation (business cases, concept approvals) and present to senior leadership

- Drive stakeholder alignment across partner technology teams from ideation through design approval

- Establish team mechanisms (WBRs, program cadences, design review gates) that create operational rhythm and accountability

- Lead strategic planning and resource allocation — defining priorities, balancing headcount, and deploying capacity against highest-impact opportunities

A day in the life
Your mornings involve facilitating deep dives into technology trade-offs and partner team execution plans — resolving conflicts and aligning teams to deliver on senior leadership goals. Afternoons shift between concept approval meetings, unblocking cross-team dependencies, and working sessions refining program requirements. You also serve as the operational backbone of the team — running weekly syncs, maintaining the portfolio tracker, flagging resource conflicts, and partnering with leadership on strategic planning and prioritization. No two days are the same.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

title: Senior Marketing Manager, Amazon Supply Chain Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon spent decades building one of the best supply chains in the world to run its own business, moving, storing, and delivering products fast and reliably. Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS) now opens that same network up to other businesses, so any company can use Amazon's multimodal ground and air freight, warehousing, distribution & fulfillment, and parcel shipping to run their own operations. Think of it like what AWS did for cloud computing, but for supply chain, and it is just getting started.

We are looking for a driven, results-oriented Senior Integrated Marketing Manager to join the Amazon Supply Chain Services team. title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. descriptionHtml:
Are you enthusiastic about the latest advancements in industrial automation and robotics? Would you like to play a vital role in Amazon's investment in advanced technologies? If you have a passion for making an impact on the future today, consider joining Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) org.

In RDPI, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in RDPI develop. Project durations vary from a few days to several months, with travel across North America. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, demonstrating leadership in installation, maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting of technologies being deployed across North America.

You will work with cross-functional partners across our engineering, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Candidates should have a proven track record of successfully leading multiple concurrent projects across one or more automation solutions.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer I, you will work with a team of 1-5 engineers and collaborate with an on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on the installation of both third party and Amazon designed robotics equipment that may be in various phases of the product life cycle. These deployments require extensive collaboration with various stakeholders, including third-party installers, contracted engineers, construction, hardware, software, IT, and other partner teams. Strong communication skills are essential for interacting with both internal and external partners and customers. As an Amazonian, you must demonstrate independent initiative to identify and solve problems in real time during deployments. A strong technical understanding, love for field work, and a keen interest in diving deep into the understanding of Amazon’s robotics systems are key attributes for this role.

- You will support and guide installation of robotics, packaging and sortation technologies at Amazon fulfillment centers
- You will develop detailed knowledge of the operation of robotic systems and guide installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of these systems both on site and remotely
- You will manage technical ambiguity around integration of work cells in fulfillment centers
- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams
- You will travel to project sites and collaborate both virtually and in person to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status
- You will manage day to day project scheduling and budget management
- You will work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space
- You will generate and implement continuous improvement ideas around work-scopes
- You will lead teams of other engineers on projects
- You will travel to both live warehouses and new construction sites, the scopes may vary significantly in length and include heavy travel
- You will travel to project sites across North America, upwards of 75% or more


A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure the product you are deploying, is both ready for deployment and capable of achieving the business requirements. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space. You will spend time with mentors and your manager to develop your professional skills and collaborate amongst your team to move the needle on the services you are accountable for.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits for you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets.

About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply innovative advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are RDPI and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun

RDPI Tech Deployment are missioned with enabling the delivery of large scale automation technologies designed and manufactured by Amazon. The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon.
