title: Software Development Engineer, Leo Manufacturing Software Systems
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control : This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.

Manufacturing Software Systems (MSS) is seeking a Software Development Engineer who will help solve a variety of technical challenges related to manufacturing the satellites, ground equipment and associated ASICs. You will play an active role in translating business and functional requirements into concrete deliverables and build quick prototypes or proofs of concept in partnership with other technology leaders within the team. You will tackle challenging, novel situations and will have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams spanning a variety of domains: software, hardware, networks, RF, embedded, real-time, distributed as well as industrial automation systems.

You will design and develop the manufacturing software used to drive the assembly, calibration and test of satellite and ground systems as well as perform high-throughput ASIC/chip level provisioning and testing. You will collaborate with teams from manufacturing engineering, product engineering, and security engineering to identify requirements and design manufacturing software. You will design and develop the end-to-end system capabilities required for manufacturing orchestration across factory production lines.

Along the way, we guarantee that you’ll learn a ton, have fun and make a positive impact on millions of people.

Key job responsibilities
- Build the manufacturing software systems used by production operations to manufacture the Leo's satellite fleet, supporting ground systems and associated ASICs
- Build the end-to-end system capabilities required for the orchestration of manufacturing across factory production lines
- Architect and design a secure manufacturing software system that protects Leo's intellectual property and manufacturing assets via a secure chain of custody/trust
- Collaborate with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market

A day in the life
In this role as a Software Development Engineer, you will be developing Leo's secure manufacturing software systems and orchestration software capabilities. These products enable industrial automation for the manufacturing of the Leo satellite fleet and supporting ground equipment. You will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary team to develop, qualify, produce, and deploy solutions and products enabling Leo’s global network.

About the team
The Leo Manufacturing Software team is responsible for the architecture, design, build, and installation of the software used to manufacture the Leo satellite fleet, ground equipment and ASICs. We partner with hardware, software, test engineering, and enterprise architecture teams to ensure efficient and secure manufacturing operations.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

- Installing Fiber and Copper cabling and patching cabling between equipment

title: Data Center Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technicians should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair, candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.



NOTE: PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States



NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required

Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors

Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities

Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues

Helping to train and onboard new team members

Physical requirements:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds

Working in cramped and/or elevated locations

Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching

Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day

Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

Work in a noisy environment

Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Technician professional, you have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while you:

Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution

Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context

Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting

You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

title: Area Manager - Kierownik Obszaru/Kierownik Logistyki/Kierownik Magazynu
descriptionHtml:
Dział operacyjny to serce firmy Amazon. Ten kluczowy segment naszej działalności zapewnia, że realizujemy i wysyłamy zamówienia w sposób efektywny, dzięki czemu nasi klienci otrzymują swoje zakupy na czas. Osoba na stanowisku Area Manager dokłada wszelkich starań, aby centrum logistyczne, w którym pracuje działało sprawnie, co pozwala nam wychodzić naprzeciw oczekiwaniom klientów. Kieruje zespołem, który troszczy się o zachowanie bezpieczeństwa, wydajności i wysokiej jakości naszych działań, a także podejmuje się realizacji wielu projektów w całej naszej sieci, mających na celu zwiększenie wydajności.

Key job responsibilities
- Tworzenie, nadzorowanie i promowanie kultury bezpieczeństwa i zadowolenia z pracy
- Analizowanie i wdrażanie modyfikacji w celu zapewnienia jakości i wydajności na stałym, wysokim poziomie
- Nadzorowanie projektów mających na celu usprawnienie procesów, optymalizację wydajności i podniesienie jakości usług dla klientów w obrębie swojego obszaru odpowiedzialności
- Analizowanie wydajności zmiany w stosunku do stosownych celów biznesowych i wprowadzanie działań mających na celu osiągnięcie doskonałości operacyjnej
- Współpraca z innymi managerami w celu standaryzacji procesów na zmianach

A day in the life


Osoba na tym stanowisku pracuje w systemie zmianowym w jednym z naszych centrów logistycznych, zapewniając jego najwyższą możliwą wydajność. Głównym zadaniem Area Managera jest kierowanie i napędzanie kultury bezpieczeństwa oraz utrzymywanie jakości i standardów wydajności na zmianach. Area Manager nadzoruje również usprawnienia procesów w swoim obszarze i napędza ich wdrażanie. Typowy dzień jest tutaj niezwykle zróżnicowany i obejmuje rozmaite czynności, od rutynowego zarządzania zespołem i codziennych obowiązków operacyjnych, po doskonalenie procesów i szeroko zakrojone zadania operacyjne w sytuacjach awaryjnych. Osoba ta jest również mentorem dla nowych managerów.

About the team
Centrum logistyczne to miejsce, w którym firma Amazon stawiała swoje pierwsze kroki. Ze skromnego zespołu sprzedawców książek przekształciło się ono w wysokorozwiniętą korporację o zasięgu ogólnoświatowym, która każdego dnia obsługuje ponad 1,5 miliona zamówień. Osoby pracujące w centrach logistycznych stanowią fundament naszej działalności, a ich wysiłki pomagają nam w ekspansji naszej firmy na nowe rejony oraz w rozszerzeniu wachlarza świadczonych przez nas usług. Korzystając z najnowszych technologii, stale poszukujemy sposobów na zwiększenie i udoskonalenie gamy oferowanych przez nas produktów – dostarczanych szybko i tanio.
Nasze zespoły w centrach logistycznych są pierwszym ogniwem w łańcuchu dostaw przyczyniającym się do realizacji zamówień klientów w tempie, z którego tak słyniemy. Pracujemy w centrach logistycznych, które stanowią serce prężnej sieci operacyjnej firmy Amazon i określane są niekiedy jako „pierwszy kilometr”, ponieważ to właśnie tutaj większość przesyłek rozpoczyna swoją podróż. Pomagamy również zarządzać dynamicznie zmieniającymi się składami magazynowymi i umożliwiamy realizację szybkich dostaw 24 godziny na dobę.
W naszych centrach logistycznych pracuje wiele różnych osób, bo oferujemy perspektywy dla osób o każdym poziomie umiejętności i wykształcenia. Niektórzy z nas zajmują się bezpośrednio towarami, inni analizują dane, pomagając wszystkim w firmie w podejmowaniu trafnych decyzji.

Basic qualifications

- Wykształcenie wyższe
- Wcześniejsze doświadczenie w kierowaniu zespołem
- Wcześniejsze doświadczenie w komunikacji z szerokim gronem partnerów biznesowych, w tym ze współpracownikami i z przełożonymi
- Umiejętność wykorzystywania danych analitycznych i empirycznych do podejmowania decyzji i rozwiązywania problemów
- Biegła znajomość języka angielskiego i polskiego w mowie i piśmie

Preferred qualifications

- Preferowane kwalifikacje nie są wymagane do starania się o stanowisko w Amazon. Z przyjemnością zapoznamy się z kandydaturą osób, które posiadają wszystkie wyżej wymienione kwalifikacje podstawowe.
- Doświadczenie z narzędziami Lean, Six Sigma i technikami Kaizen

- Odpowiednia znajomość pakietu MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

title: Technicien(ne) de Maintenance industrielle H/F, RME AMZL
descriptionHtml:
Localisation du site: DIF6 - Noisy-le-Grand

-------
En assurant le fonctionnement continu des machines essentielles à nos activités, l’équipe RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) d’Amazon joue un rôle fondamental pour nos opérations. En tant que technicien RME, vous assurerez la maintenance d’un large éventail d’équipements et d’espaces de travail tout en respectant les meilleures pratiques en matière de santé et de sécurité. Vous contribuerez à la sécurité de vos collègues et à la prévention des temps d’arrêt des machines. Nos techniciens RME améliorent la disponibilité et la qualité de nos équipements et travaillent pour optimiser notre environnement opérationnel.

Key job responsibilities
- Réaliser des tâches de maintenance proactive et préventive sur les équipements du site
- Effectuer des tâches de réparation réactives et diagnostiquer les pannes dans un centre de distribution fonctionnel
- Utiliser les meilleurs outils pour optimiser le fonctionnement des équipements
- Respecter toutes les politiques et pratiques en matière de santé et de sécurité
- Soutenir le développement et la progression des apprentis sur le site
- Travailler sur des projets d’amélioration continue et appliquer les meilleures pratiques sur plusieurs de nos sites au sein de l’UE

A day in the life
Nos techniciens RME sont basés sur site, afin de répondre rapidement à tout problème technique affectant nos opérations. Vous effectuerez une série de travaux de maintenance préventive planifiée sur les équipements en place sur nos sites afin de vous assurer qu’ils fonctionnent et ne présentent aucun risque de sécurité. En tant que technicien RME, vous interviendrez rapidement en cas de panne, et vous mènerez l’enquête pour détecter les pannes et les solutionner aussi vite que possible. Il vous appartiendra également de faire des suggestions pour améliorer durablement les processus.
En collaboration avec des collègues expérimentés, vous effectuerez des tâches de maintenance quotidiennes telles que la peinture et la plomberie et assurerez la liaison avec les sous-traitants externes en cas de besoin si nécessaire. Vous travaillerez en équipe afin de vous assurer que nos sites bénéficient d’une assistance 24 heures sur 24, ce qui permet à Amazon de livrer ses produits à la vitesse qui fait sa réputation.

About the team
Notre équipe d’ingénieurs RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) veille à ce que nos équipements fonctionnent au mieux. Guidés par des responsables expérimentés, nous sommes une équipe à l’esprit analytique. Nos collaborateurs·trices possèdent à la fois des connaissances techniques poussées et un bon esprit d’équipe. Nous travaillons ensemble pour assurer l’entretien, le dépannage et la réparation des ressources de notre réseau mondial de centres d’expédition. Certains de nos employé·es occupent des postes à responsabilités et sont chargés de superviser l’équipe dans son travail sur des technologies passionnantes, dont certaines n’existent que chez Amazon.
De l’installation de systèmes d’emballage automatisés à la supervision de la maintenance générale d’un site, en passant par la réparation d’équipements de distribution essentiels, notre équipe assure le bon fonctionnement de la plupart des éléments techniques d’Amazon. Nous veillons, par exemple, à ce que les bâtiments soient conformes à la législation, afin d’assurer la sécurité de tous et le fonctionnement à plein régime de nos sites. Les possibilités d’évolution sont nombreuses, tant au sein de l’équipe RME qu’à l’échelle d’Amazon.
Tout ce que nous faisons vise à réduire les temps d’arrêt dans les principaux sites logistiques d’Amazon, afin que les clients reçoivent leurs commandes à temps. Nous travaillons souvent tôt ou tard pour effectuer les tâches de maintenance avec un minimum de perturbations, y compris en équipes de nuit. Si nous voyons qu’il existe une méthodologie plus aboutie pour faire les choses, nous avons les compétences nécessaires pour développer et introduire des processus nouveaux ou des technologies de pointe, comme Amazon Robotics ou notre robot de tri ultra sophistiqué.

Basic qualifications

- Formation : Bac Pro, BTS, BUT ou équivalent (Bac+2 minimum) en maintenance industrielle, électrotechnique ou mécanique
- Maintenance préventive : Maîtrise des systèmes de maintenance planifiée et des plateformes de gestion de maintenance assistée par ordinateur
- Dépannage : Capacités de diagnostic sur équipements de manutention et systèmes automatisés, avec maîtrise de la lecture de plans mécaniques et électriques
- Compétences techniques : Expérience avec convoyeurs, contrôleurs moteur, variateurs de fréquence et capteurs
- Compétences opérationnelles : Connaissance des normes de santé et sécurité
- Maîtrise du français (CEFR C1 ou supérieur)

Preferred qualifications

- Habilitations électriques : Expérience en travaux d'ordre électrique et maintenance de contrôleurs moteur et variateurs
- Automatisation : Expérience avec automates programmables (type Siemens), réseaux de terrain, robotique et systèmes automatisés
- Traçabilité : Maîtrise de la configuration et maintenance de scanners et systèmes d'impressionapplication
- Maintenance 40 : Utilisation des technologies liées à la maintenance connectée et prédictive
- Gestion de projets : Expérience en installation d'équipements ; compétences multilingues appréciées
- Conditionnement : Entretien et mise au point de machines de conditionnement automatique
- Sens de l'organisation et aisance relationnelle

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

title: Reliability Maintenance Engineering Technician , AMZL
descriptionHtml:
The Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team at Amazon is fundamental to our operations – they’re the ones keeping vital machinery running at all times. As an RME Technician, you’ll maintain a wide range of equipment and workspaces while upholding Health and Safety best practices. You'll help to keep your colleagues safe and prevent machine downtime. Our RME Technicians boost the availability and quality of our equipment and work to enhance the operational environment too.



Key job responsibilities
- Proactive and preventative maintenance tasks on a wide range of site equipment
- Carry out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse
- Use the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness
- Uphold all health and safety policies and practices
- Support the development and progression of on-site apprentices
- Work on continuous improvement projects and roll out best practices across a range of EU sites


A day in the life
Our RME Technicians are based on-site, so they can respond quickly to any machinery issues. You’ll carry out a range of planned preventative maintenance to our sites’ equipment to make sure it’s working safely. As an RME Technician, you’ll also respond promptly to breakdowns, investigating, finding, and implementing solutions as quickly as possible. You’ll also make suggestions for long-term improvements.

Working alongside senior colleagues, you’ll undertake day-to-day maintenance tasks and will liaise with contractors if you need external expertise. You’ll work on a range of shifts to make sure our sites are supported around the clock – allowing Amazon to deliver at the speed we’re known for.




About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint, supported by a portfolio vehicles (including Electric Vehicles) and technology to help us do just that.

Basic qualifications

- NVQ Level 3/ SVQ Level 3/ IVQ Level 3/ City & Guilds Level 3/EAL Level 3 all specialized in Mechanical, Electrical or Mechatronics
- Relevant experience as a qualified engineer
- Relevant experience working in mechanical and/or electrical maintenance
- Advanced proficiency in the local language verbally and in writing

Preferred qualifications

- Associate's degree in Mechnical or Electrical
- Experience with material handling equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and safety standards
- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance

descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 15, 2026

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security, and more. This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.

As a TAM you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, Gen/AI, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support, and risk management.

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us.

• The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer's environment for troubleshooting customer support issues rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy.

title: Facilities Service Coodinator, 施設管理部
descriptionHtml:
Amazonは、何百万もの商品をお客様のもとへ届け続けることで、世界的に高い認知を得たグローバルリーディングカンパニーです。
その物流を最前線で支える物流拠点がフルフィルメントセンター（以下FC）であり、そのFCを「安全・快適・効率的」に保ち続けるのが、私たちRME-Facilities（施設管理）チームです。
快適な現場も、雰囲気の良いオフィスも、みんなが楽しみにするイベントも、あなたが整える施設の一つひとつが、Amazonで働く一人ひとりの毎日を支えています。

**あなたの仕事で、数千人の「働く」が変わる。**
施設管理の専門経験は問いません。 Amazonの施設に興味があり、働く人のために動くのが好きな方であれば大歓迎です。
建物・設備の知識は、先輩のサポートを受けながら現場で少しずつ身につけていけます。
本ポジションは、FCで働くすべての人を"カスタマー"と捉え、魅力的で働きやすい職場づくりを推進する役割になります。

主な業務
はじめは先輩と一緒に、慣れてきたら少しずつ任される範囲を広げていきます。

■働く環境と人を支える仕事
オフィス環境の整備 — レイアウト変更や快適な職場づくりなど、従業員が気持ちよく働ける環境を整えます。
備品・消耗品の管理と購買・請求書処理 — 必要なものが不足しないよう手配し、日々の購買・請求書処理を進めます。
売店・Cafeteriaの運営管理 — 従業員満足度の向上に向けて、食堂運営会社と協力してサービスレベルの維持・改善に取り組みます。
従業員向けイベントの企画・運営 — FCで働く人が楽しめるイベントを自ら企画・運営します。自分が企画したイベントで従業員が笑顔になる瞬間に立ち会えることも、このポジションならではのやりがいです。
社内外の窓口・調整 — ベンダーや業者、行政などとの窓口を担い、必要な調整を進めます。
■建物・設備を守る仕事
施設の維持管理 — 建築・電気・空調・衛生・消火・昇降設備といった建物全体のインフラについて、点検結果の確認や修繕の手配・発注を行い、倉庫の安定稼働を支えます。
省エネルギー活動 — エネルギー使用量のデータをもとに、照明のLED化や空調運転スケジュールの見直しなどを進め、環境負荷の低減とコスト削減の両立を目指します。
廃棄物・リサイクル管理 — FC内で発生する産業廃棄物やリサイクル品の回収・分別を、安全・品質・生産性の観点で管理・改善します。マニフェスト管理や行政報告など、法令に沿った手続きも担います。

**このポジションの魅力**
幅広い経験がキャリアの土台になる — 建物・設備・環境・総務・イベント企画まで、施設に関わることを幅広く経験できます。特定分野に偏らない経験は、この先どんなキャリアにも活きる強みになります。
若手でも「任される」 — 発注者側の立場で、業者やベンダーへの依頼・調整を自分で進めていきます。指示を待つのではなく、自分で考えて動ける環境です（最初は先輩がしっかりサポートします）。
カスタマーの声がダイレクトに届く — 「美味しい食事が食べられて快適に働ける」「オフィスの雰囲気が良くなった」といったポジティブな声を、すぐそばで直接受け取れます。
AI・生成AIを日常業務に — Amazonでは最新のAIツールや生成AIを日々の業務に取り入れています。学習を継続する文化が根付いており、ご自身のペースでAIや施設管理の知識を深められるリソースが用意されています。

**こんな方を歓迎します**
- 施設管理の仕事に興味がある方
- 人と関わり、誰かのために動くことにやりがいを感じる方
- 新しい知識を学ぶことに前向きで、自分で考えて行動できる方
- チームや職場全体のために、情報を共有しサポートし合える方

Key job responsibilities
Amazonの業務は数値で管理されています。キーとなる数値目標がセットされ、業務の改善を通してパフォーマンスを引き上げていくことがミッションです。
たとえば電気使用量や社員食堂の満足度には数値目標があり、電気は節電、社員食堂はメニュー改善、廃棄物はリサイクル率の向上などを、各協力会社とともに進めて目標達成を目指します。


A day in the life
1日は朝礼から始まります。朝礼後はチーム別に分かれて当日の業務内容を確認し、メールチェックや現場巡回を行います。
ランチはカフェテリアや売店を利用し、あわせてサービスレベルもチェックします。会議は1日に1〜2件ほど、サプライヤーとの定例会議が中心で、主に業務進捗の報告を受けます。
困ったときは先輩やチームに相談しながら進められます。

About the team
メンバーは多くの場合、1 FCあたり1〜2名が配属されています。少人数だからこそ幅広い業務を経験でき、成長のスピードが速い環境です。
全国各地のメンバーが一斉に集まる定例オンライン会議が毎週あり、成功事例の共有や困りごとの相談ができます。
本ポジションの所属部門等に関する詳細は、下記リンク先をご参照ください。
・所属部門:オペレーション技術開発
・職種:セーフティ/セキュリティ/ファシリティ

Basic qualifications

- 外部委託先協業もしくはベンダーマネジメント経験
- PCスキル（Excel, Word, Outlook）

Preferred qualifications

- 建屋施設管理業務、工事施工管理業務、建築や電気設備のPM業務経験
- コスト改善提案を行った経験
- お客様意識お客様意識を強く持って行動できる。
- コミュニケーション:職場環境に溶け込み、分からない部分を積極的に質問し自身で解決する力。
- 職場全体への貢献, 他人の仕事をうまく進められるように情報を共有し、サポートする。
- アジリティとフレキシビリティー 迅速に業務をこなし、状況の変化に柔軟に対応できる。
- 周囲の意見を聞きながら判断し仕事を進められる。
- 探究心と向上心 いままで経験がない業務でも新しい知識を学ぶのに意欲的で何事も前向きに取組める性質。
- インクルーシブなカルチャーへの貢献や多様性に富んだグループで働くことに対して前向きであること。

descriptionHtml:
Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations

Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You'll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places at scale. You'll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn't abstract, it's visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world's most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

This position is based at Amazon's Bellevue, WA corporate office (SEA104). Candidates must be available to work on-site at the Bellevue location for the duration of the spring semester. During the summer months, occasional travel to Amazon fulfillment centers under construction and other corporate offices across the United States may be required.

The Startup Project Manager Internship is an on-site part-time internship (20 hours a week) during the Spring 2027 academic season (February/March 2027 – May/June 2027) based at a Amazon fulfillment center under construction.

Upon school release for Summer 2027 (May/June 2027 – July/August 2027) this position shifts to a 12-week internship “full-time” (40 hours/week) with potential travel opportunities to other fulfillment centers under construction and corporate offices across the United States.

Project Management & Execution

You will work under regular guidance from Startup Supply Chain (SSC) Project Managers, building your knowledge of project management concepts and Amazon's startup processes while contributing to real project deliverables.

title: Sr. Seller Success Manager, Amazon Autos
descriptionHtml:
Are you entrepreneurial? Would you like to take part in launching a fast-paced and dynamic new business? Does a start-up challenge sound like your career aspiration?

If your answer is yes, the position below would be a great fit for you.

Amazon Autos is revolutionizing the vehicle discovery and shopping experience, connecting customers with their ideal vehicle. As a Sr. Seller Success Manager at Amazon Autos, you'll have the opportunity to unleash your entrepreneurial spirit and tackle complex challenges alongside industry-leading professionals.


Key job responsibilities
Senior Seller Success Managers are responsible for driving business growth and delivering a positive experience with our program. The key responsibilities are to:

Build and cultivate strong relationships with dealers in your portfolio. Serve as a trusted advisor and business advocate, proactively monitoring dealer satisfaction, account health, and engagement to ensure long-term success.

Drive sustainable business growth for your dealers on Amazon through data-driven insights and marketplace expertise. Create and present compelling, customized solutions that help dealers achieve and exceed their business goals.

Leverage performance data and analytics to identify growth opportunities within your dealer portfolio. Track key input metrics that drive selection quality, pricing competitiveness, and customer experience improvements.

Partner with dealer leadership to develop strategic account plans that unlock new revenue streams, optimize existing operations, and scale their Amazon presence effectively.

Manage escalations and provide solutions to help dealers effectively navigate challenges and maintain healthy account operations.

Identify and champion process improvements that benefit your dealer portfolio and the broader program, including driving adoption of new tools, simplifying workflows, and sharing best practices across the team.

Collaborate cross-functionally with internal stakeholders to advocate for dealer needs and ensure alignment on programs that drive mutual success.

A day in the life
As a Seller Success Manager, you will work cross-functionally with internal teams across Seller Experience, Operations, Product, and Program Management, and externally with GM and VP-level dealer contacts. Your primary responsibilities include driving sustainable dealer growth on Amazon through data-driven insights and marketplace expertise, partnering with dealer leadership to develop and execute growth strategies, advocating on behalf of dealers while developing customized solutions, and managing escalations to ensure exceptional dealer satisfaction and account health across your portfolio.

About the team
About the team We are a newly formed rapidly growing team with a vision to create innovative discovery and shopping experiences on Amazon, providing customers better convenience and more selection. title: Content Operations Specialist - 12 month Keiyaku Shain
descriptionHtml:
At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

ABOUT THE ROLE
The Content Operations Specialist manages cross-functional operational processes for content in the Japan market, from post-deal-close contract execution, rights and licensing registration, vendor onboarding, and payment setup through asset delivery, metadata preparation, and distribution readiness.

This 12 month Keiyaku Shain role spans both Production Operations and Deal Operations, and is accountable for ensuring that contracts, rights, payments, production information, assets, metadata, and release data are accurately and timely transferred across relevant systems and teams.

You will work closely with Business Affairs, Content Acquisition, Legal, Production, Finance, Catalog, Marketing, and global Operations teams to translate agreed-upon deal terms into precise operational workflows and drive the operations required to bring each title to production- and distribution-ready status. This role focuses on the accurate operational implementation of agreed terms and the continuous improvement of supporting processes.

You will leverage AI and digital tools to build and improve an operational foundation capable of processing high volumes of contract, production, rights, payment, and distribution data efficiently and accurately. This is a 12 month Keiyaku Shain located onsite in our Tokyo office.

As the Content Operations Specialist you will...
- Coordinate the workflow from post-deal-close through contract execution, document archiving, data registration, rights configuration, and initiation of downstream processes
- Register and update contract terms, rights, licenses, territories, exclusivity, distribution windows, payment terms, and related information accurately in relevant systems
- Coordinate with Business Affairs and Legal on documents, approvals, signatures, and amendments required for contract execution
- Conduct vendor onboarding for publishers, creators, licensors, production companies, and studios, ensuring all information required for payment and production initiation is in place
- Coordinate with Finance to manage payment setup, submissions, and exceptions for advances, production fees, license fees, and other contractual payments
- Maintain a cross-functional view of the Japan market production slate, release calendar, production status, asset delivery, and distribution readiness, partnering with Production Specialists to confirm production-start prerequisites are met
- Track delivery status of final audio, artwork, metadata, credits, rights data, and promotional assets, and verify consistency across contract terms, deliverables, and distribution settings
- Confirm that all required contracts, rights, audio, artwork, metadata, and payment configurations are complete by the scheduled distribution date, escalating discrepancies as needed
- Investigate exception cases including data gaps, rights configuration errors, payment holds, missing assets, and release delays, and drive resolution with relevant teams
- Visualize and report on operational KPIs including processing volumes, lead times, error rates, backlog, and on-time completion rates
- Identify manual processes, duplicate data entry, and data quality issues within workflows, and execute improvement initiatives including updated SOPs, checklists, templates, and escalation rules
- Leverage AI and automation tools to optimize contract processing, rights verification, progress tracking, and reporting, while ensuring compliance with copyright, confidentiality, data protection, and internal policies

ABOUT AUDIBLE
Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of professional experience in content operations, production operations, deal operations, contract management, rights/licensing management, publishing, digital media, entertainment, content distribution, or a related industry
- Experience managing operations across multiple domains including contracts, rights, vendors, payments, production, assets, metadata, or distribution data
- Experience translating agreed-upon deal terms and business requirements into concrete operational actions such as system registration, payment configuration, and distribution setup
- Experience processing and managing high volumes of data accurately and within deadlines, with high attention to detail for critical information such as contracts, rights, and payments
- Experience collaborating across multiple functions to drive operational outcomes
- Ability to analyze complex operational issues by organizing facts, contract terms, and system data, and to lead resolution end-to-end
- Experience with operational tools such as spreadsheets, databases, CMS, contract management systems, project management tools, BI, or workflow automation platforms, with a track record of driving process improvements
- High level of professional proficiency in Japanese, with the ability to understand contracts, rights, and operational requirements, coordinate with stakeholders, and resolve issues
- Ability to communicate in English for email, document review, meetings, and coordination with global teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leveraging AI technologies (including generative AI) and digital tools to automate or improve operational processes, or demonstrated practical ability to do so
- Experience in audiobooks, publishing, audio content, digital distribution, or subscription services
- Experience handling rights information such as copyrights, licenses, distribution rights, territories, and contract terms
- Experience in vendor onboarding or payment operations (advances, royalties, production fees, license fees)
- Experience driving process improvement or automation using AI, RPA, SQL, Python, BI, or no-code/low-code tools
- Experience designing operational processes that bridge Japan-specific requirements with global standards

descriptionHtml:
Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

デリバリーステーション（DS）において、日次オペレーションの計画・実行・管理を担う。具体的には、入荷（Inbound）・仕分け（Sort）・出発（OFD）の各工程における進捗管理、労務計画、および生産性指標の達成をリードする。
50名規模のチームメンバーを率い、安全（Safety）・品質・コストのバランスを取りながらオペレーションを最適化する。日々の業務ではデータ分析に基づくボトルネック特定と改善施策の立案・実行（PDCA）を行い、標準作業手順の整備・徹底を推進する。また、ラストマイル配送パートナーとの連携を通じ、配送品質の向上と顧客体験の最大化に貢献する。加えて、アソシエイトの育成・エンゲージメント向上、およびAmazonのLeadership Principlesに基づく組織文化の醸成も重要な責務である。

引き継ぎ → 仕分け計画策定 → リスク確認・環境管理 → 朝礼・勤怠管理 → 現場巡回 → 中間チェック → 午前便ステージング → 午後便計画・実行 → 実績記録・引き継ぎ

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Unified Content Processing Platform
descriptionHtml:
Deliver AI Innovation in Compliance at Amazon

Join a team building the future of automated compliance in the product space. Your work will directly impact Amazon's ability to serve customers and partners safely and efficiently across the globe.

We have a unique challenge to overcome: use ML and LLMs at the scale of Amazon. As a software development engineer you will develop scalable LLM infrastructure that can be used to process billions of documents and images each year, in a cost efficient way.

The ideal candidate will be eager to work in a team of innovators and contribute to a suite of tools that power automating and scalable content processing with the end goal of providing Amazon shoppers and sellers with a frictionless and trustworthy shopping and selling experience. You will be working in an Agile mode, collaborating with product management and partner teams to iterate at a fast pace and delight our end users.


Key job responsibilities
Your key responsibilities will include:
- designing, developing and maintaining distributed systems hosted in AWS;
- guiding a team of engineers in writing maintainable code and adhering to operational practices;
- defining idiomatic solutions for processing varied types of content with diverse ML solutions and application integrations;
- improving performance and operational costs;
- researching solutions for technically ambiguous problems.

A day in the life
As senior software engineer’s day typically involves designing or researching technical solutions and alternatives to your team’s most critical and complex features and projects. As a team leader, you will also review your peers’ code and dive deep into their design documents to provide feedback on software architecture, scalability and security. You will code the critical code path in your projects and coordinate with peers on the tasks that you delegated to them. You advise your manager on trade-offs and product future direction.

About the team
Compliance Safety Services (CoSS) vision is to provide best-in-class automation of controls for internal compliance and business programs (our primary customers) to lower costs in the Amazon flywheel on behalf of our end customers: buyers and selling partners. We provide easy-to-use shared services with data privacy, security and tenant isolation across all stages, while continuously raising industry standards for automation performance and cost efficiency, giving our program customers confidence that they have access to optimal cost-efficient automation options to better serve their end customers.

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
- Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Data Center Logistics Specialist, Data Center Communities InfraOps
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

We’re looking for a Logistics Operations Specialist to raise the bar within our Data Center logistics team. You’ll own the daily flow of materials, equipment and inventory, troubleshoot issues on the ground, and ensure our operations meets our customer needs.
You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS インフラストラクチャサービス（AIS）は、AWS のグローバル インフラストラクチャ全体の設計、計画、提供、運用を担当しています。つまり、クラウドを安定的に稼働させ続けるのが私たちの役割です。AWS のデータセンター、サーバー、ストレージ、ネットワーク、電力、冷却装置など、すべてのインフラを包括的にサポートし、お客様が必要とするイノベーションへの継続的なアクセスを確保しています。私たちは、サプライチェーンに影響を及ぼす数千もの変数を含む複雑な課題に日々取り組んでおり、この挑戦に共に立ち向かう優秀な人材を求めています。

AWSデータセンターのロジスティクスチームでは ロジスティクス オペレーション スペシャリストを募集しています.。
本ポジションでは資材や機器、在庫の日々の流れを管理して、現場の問題を解決し、内部顧客のニーズに応えるオペレーションを実現していただきます。様々なメンバーと連携しながら、可能な限り低コストでほぼ無限のキャパシティを提供しつつ、安全性とセキュリティの最高水準を維持する業務をお願いします。また、ロジスティクスチームでは大胆なアイデアを歓迎し、最後までやり遂げる力を与えてくれるインクルーシブな文化が体験できます。

Key job responsibilities
As a Logistics Specialist, you will perform analysis related to process, inventory, efficiency and cost improvements. You will keep precise records of all commodities going in and out of the company, manage and maintain accurate inventory, and check out parts as needed to our internal customers. Your responsibilities will include tasks such as arranging, scheduling and supporting shipments across sites and other locations, unpacking boxes and verifying contents. Lastly, you will be expected to maintain a clean environment, orderliness and safety in all work spaces.

The ideal Logistics Specialist will proactively propose ideas to improve Logistics Metrics and Performance at the Data Center.

This position involves occasional trips across the cluster to support other sites and frequent lifting of materials up to 18kg (with support from teammates available).

ロジスティクスのスペシャリストとして、プロセス、在庫、効率性およびコスト改善に関する分析を行います。社内への入出荷されるすべての物品の正確な記録を保持し、正確な在庫の管理・維持を行うとともに、社内の担当者へ必要に応じて部品を提供します。主な業務には、各サイトおよびその他の場所への輸送の手配・スケジューリング・サポート、梱包の開梱および内容物の確認などが含まれます。また、すべての作業スペースにおける清潔な環境、整理整頓および安全の維持が求められます。

理想的な人材像は、ロジスティクス指標(KPI)およびパフォーマンスを向上させるためのアイデアを積極的に提案できる方です。

配属が異なるデータセンターのサポートのための出張が不定期に発生し、また最大18kgの物品を持ち上げる作業が本ポジションでは、度々あります（チームメンバーによるサポートあり）。

A day in the life
We provide items to our customers, safely, accurately and in a timely manner.

You will work in a diverse and international environment.


* 9:00-18:00 work on business days.
* Work will be conducted onsite in an office/storage room area with the occasional need to work outside for shipment support.
* Sometimes work in a 75db noise level environment (comparable to industrial grade fan).
* Involves occasional trips across the cluster to support other sites and frequent lifting of materials up to 18kg (with support from teammates available).
* On-call duties required after normal working hours, rotating by team members on a bi-weekly basis.
* Occasional outdoor work for shipment receiving and loading dock activities, exposed to varying weather conditions
* Ability to wear required PPE including safety shoes, as needed

私たちは社内のお客様に、安全に、正確に、そしてタイムリーに商品をお届けしています。

本ポジションでは多様な国際的な環境でご勤務いただきます。


* 勤務時間：平日の9:00〜18:00
* 勤務地はデータセンター施設内にあるオフィスおよび倉庫区域が主たる勤務場所となります。出荷サポートのため屋外での作業が発生することもあります。
* 騒音レベル75デシベル（工業用ファン相当）の環境で作業を行う可能性があります。
* 配属が異なるデータセンターのサポートのための出張が不定期に発生し、また最大18kgの物品を持ち上げる作業が度々あります（チームメンバーによるサポートあり）。
* 勤務時間外のオンコール対応が求められます。チームメンバーで隔週交代制を採用しています。
* 荷物の受け取りや積み込み作業のため、天候に左右される屋外作業が発生することがあります。
* 安全靴を含む必要なPPE（個人用保護具）の着用が求められます。

About the team
About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

チームについて
多様な経験 Amazonは多様な経験を持つ人材を求めています。募集要項に記載された資格やスキルをすべて満たしていなくても、ぜひご応募ください。

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS が選ばれる理由
Amazon Web Services (AWS) は、世界で最も包括的で広く採用されているクラウドプラットフォームです。私たちはクラウドコンピューティングのパイオニアとして、絶え間ない革新を続けています。そのため、急成長するスタートアップ企業からGlobal 500企業まで、多くのお客様が私たちの信頼性の高い製品とサービス群を活用してビジネスを展開しています。

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

インクルーシブなチーム文化
AWSでは、学びと好奇心が私たちの本質となっています。従業員主導のアフィニティグループを通じて、多様性を誇りとする包括的な文化を育んでいます。人種と民族に関する対話（CORE）やジェンダーの多様性を考えるAmazeConカンファレンスなど、様々なイベントや学習機会を通じて、私たちは互いの個性を尊重し続けています。

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

メンターシップとキャリアの成長
当社は、世界最高の雇用主となることを目指し、常にパフォーマンス基準の向上に努めています。そのために、知識の共有やメンターシップをはじめ、キャリア向上に役立つ様々なリソースを豊富に提供し、社員一人一人がバランスの取れたプロフェッショナルへと成長できるよう支援しています。

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years experience in logistics, supply chain, or operations
- 物流、サプライチェーン、またはオペレーション分野における1年以上の実務経験
- Proficiency in standard office software (Excel, Word, Outlook)
- 標準的なオフィスソフト（Excel、Word、Outlook）の操作が可能な方
- Proficient in Japanese and conversational English
- 日本語が流暢であること、およびに英語での日常会話能力

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with SQL and data visualization tools such as Tableau
- SQLおよびTableauなどのデータ可視化ツールの使用経験
- Experience in project management including resource planning, managing schedules, reporting project status and prioritizing tasks
- リソース計画、スケジュール管理、プロジェクト状況の報告、タスクの優先順位付けを含むプロジェクトマネジメントの経験

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. Do you like to use network and Unix systems engineering to deliver simple, sustainable, and repeatable solutions? Would you like to play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation IP networks?

The Networking team is looking for an Optical Network Development Engineer to join our team. As an Optical Network Development Engineer, you will be responsible for building, deploying and scaling the Amazon networks that support AWS, customers, and other business units, across multiple global data centers.

AWS Core Networking is focused on building Data Centers and the network that allows Data Centers to function efficiently. They own the solutions that allow racks to be aggregated and Data Centers to be interconnected. Core Networking’s goal is to balance efficiency, performance and reliability to allow customers access to their applications and data.


Key job responsibilities
Optical Network Development Engineers perform high quality network and/or systems operations, deployments, scaling, technology refresh, sustaining engineering, best practices application, optimization, internal/external customer interactions, and produce appropriate technical documentation.

• Collaborate with vendors/manufacturers to evaluate new hardware and software features. Create implementations plans for incorporating them into the network.
• Automate optical test plans and qualify optical modules.
• Collaborate with vendors/manufactures in defining and developing test plans for Optical Modules.
• Create processes that help operate and build our DWDM network. Drive scaling current DWDM designs to meet the demand of our customers.
• Drive operational excellence projects to deliver improvements in our DWDM network quality and reliability.


A day in the life
Engineers in the InterDC Optical services team have a wide range of responsibilities. In terms of product development and delivery, it covers all activities related to hardware and software development, cross-platforms and software integration, and transition to production for both inhouse commodity and OEM optical platforms. From the lifecycle support perspective, includes day to day operations on-call, sustaining engineering, operational load automation and reduction, product and network security, network data integrity and authoritativeness, availability assurance (SRLG monitoring) and improvement (OLP, RFTS) and fiber infrastructure and vendor performance management.

Our engineers not only make decisions on day-to-day work but they also own the long-term strategic view, they build strong partnership with customers to understand their immediate and future needs, their use cases and the things that we/they are not even thinking about so we make sure our solutions will fit into their needs. They bring perspective and context to influence the way we make technology and design choices, how we develop and deliver products that are right sized, fungible and future proof at the optimum cost per bit. They understand the business impact of their recommendations and show good judgment in decision making as we consider technical trade-offs between the immediate short-term technology solutions, operational needs and the long-term business needs.

The InterDC Optical Services team is responsible for the development, delivery and lifecycle support of the optical products used to interconnect AWS Data Centers and PoPs (Point of presence), ensuring diversity of supply and continually lowering data transfer cost for customers. This product portfolio serves a broad customer base and is primarily used to transport Core (EC2 & Prod) and Border (Internet) traffic in and across all but a few AWS commercial and ADC regions globally. Our current network size is >10Pbps of inter data center traffic over >30k devices worldwide and our team is structured to create and evolve these products and solutions while providing highly available, secure and scalable transport for multiple customer fabrics globally.

descriptionHtml:
Acerca de Amazon y External Fulfillment

En Amazon trabajamos para ser la compañía más enfocada en el cliente en el mundo, donde se pueda encontrar y descubrir cualquier cosa que se quiera comprar en línea. Los programas de External Fulfillment son iniciativas en las cuales Amazon trabaja con distintos proveedores para embarcar producto desde almacenes externos a Amazon, garantizando que nuestros clientes reciban sus pedidos a tiempo y en perfectas condiciones.

Acerca del Equipo

El equipo de operaciones de External Fulfillment UAF se divide en roles complementarios:

Field Support Team (FST): Equipo de soporte en piso responsable de alinear las operaciones a través de auditorías físicas, visitando almacenes de vendedores según se requiera para garantizar el cumplimiento de estándares operativos.

Flow Support Team (CST): Equipo que maneja operaciones mediante el monitoreo diario y conversaciones remotas con los proveedores, dando seguimiento a casos específicos.

Inbound Consumables: Equipo dedicado a la gestión del flujo de inventario entrante para la categoría de consumibles, asegurando niveles óptimos de ocupación y reposición oportuna en los nodos de Vendor Flex.

Back Office: Equipo encargado de la gestión administrativa y de soporte documental para la operación.

Tu Rol

Como Inbound Consumables Associate, serás el responsable de garantizar que el inventario de consumibles fluya de manera continua y eficiente hacia los nodos de Vendor Flex. Monitorearás niveles de ocupación, coordinarás con vendors la programación de envíos, identificarás riesgos de desabasto o sobrestock, y trabajarás de la mano con equipos de Retail e Instock para alinear la reposición con la demanda real. Tu gestión diaria será fundamental para que los nodos operen con inventario saludable y nuestros clientes reciban sus pedidos sin interrupciones.

Key job responsibilities
Responsabilidades clave del puesto

- Gestionar el flujo de inventario entrante (inbound) para vendors de consumibles en el programa Vendor Flex, asegurando el cumplimiento de ventanas de recepción, estándares de etiquetado y requisitos de prepack
- Monitorear niveles de ocupación por nodo y por ASIN, identificando proactivamente riesgos de sobrestock o desabasto que impacten la operación
- Coordinar con vendors la programación de envíos, resolución de discrepancias en recepción y cumplimiento de SLAs de reposición
- Dar seguimiento a métricas de salud de inventario incluyendo rotación de ASINs, días de cobertura, y tasas de recepción vs. plan
- Escalar problemas sistémicos de inventario a Program Managers, proporcionando análisis de causa raíz y recomendaciones de acción
- Colaborar con equipos de Retail y Supply Chain para alinear planes de reposición con la demanda proyectada y eventos comerciales (Prime, Hot Sale, Buen Fin)
- Mantener registros precisos del estatus de inventario entrante, acciones pendientes y compromisos de vendors
- Identificar cuellos de botella recurrentes en el proceso de inbound y proponer mejoras de proceso para reducir tiempos de recepción y mejorar la precisión del inventario
- Apoyar la preparación de nodos nuevos en lo relacionado a configuración de inventario inicial, definición de layout para consumibles y validación de capacidad de almacenamiento

Basic qualifications

- Experience with Excel
- High school diploma or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with SQL
- Experience in data collection and ability to draft clear and detailed requirements documents

title: Senior Manager, Customer Success Specialists, Amazon Quick , AWS Specialist and Partner Organization
descriptionHtml:
AWS is seeking a Senior Manager, Customer Success Specialists (CSS), Amazon Quick to lead a team of Service CSS driving enterprise adoption of Amazon Quick and AWS generative AI services. This is a people leadership role within the AWS Specialists & Partners (ASP) Customer Success Center of Excellence, responsible for building, developing, and managing a team of customer-facing specialists who help enterprises move from AI experimentation to systematic business process reinvention at scale with AWS AI services

Amazon Quick is AWS's enterprise AI platform that enables organizations to transform how work gets done, from knowledge management and research to decision-making and operational workflows. Your team will own end-to-end adoption outcomes for a portfolio of strategic Quick customers, progressing them through the post-launch lifecycle and delivering measurable business value.

You will set the operational cadence and quality bar for your team, ensure they have the skills, assets, and support to deliver customer outcomes, and partner closely with the rest of the Customer Success Center of Excellence team members (CS COE, who build scalable methodologies and assets) to create the flywheel between customer evidence and reusable patterns. You will also collaborate with the go-to-market, Forward Deployed Quick Engineers, partner-led CS (PLCS), and field roles to ensure seamless handoffs and coverage across the activation backlog.
Note: Demonstrable experience leading customer-facing, AI-centric teams is a key requirement for this role. Prior individual experience as an AI practitioner, while valuable, is not sufficient. This role requires proven ability to build, coach, and scale a team of specialists who drive AI adoption outcomes across enterprise customer portfolios.


Key job responsibilities
Team Leadership & Development
- Recruit, develop, and retain a team of Amazon Quick Service CSS who own end-to-end adoption outcomes within assigned accounts. Set clear performance expectations around activation targets, customer success plan quality, lifecycle progression, and contribution to scalable assets.
- Coach CSS on executive engagement, change management execution, adoption architecture, and value storytelling. Ensure each CSS can run C-suite alignment sessions, drive deep enablement, build champion networks, and deliver measurable business outcomes independently.
- Lead the team operating cadence: weekly account reviews, monthly portfolio health checks, quarterly performance calibrations. Ensure operational excellence tooling entries are current, escalations are documented with impact data, and interventions are triggered within defined SLAs.
Customer Outcomes & Portfolio Management
- Own the aggregate activation and value realization outcomes across the team's Quick customer portfolio. Track monthly active-users (MAU), activation rates, and revenue realization metrics, feature adoption breadth and depth, and retention across assigned accounts. Intervene directly on strategic or at-risk accounts when needed.
- Manage portfolio assignment and coverage optimization: match CSS strengths to account complexity, balance workloads across the team, and coordinate with partner-led CS and other field roles to avoid gaps or duplication.
- Serve as the escalation point for account-level blockers that exceed CSS authority, including product blockers, competitive threats, executive sponsor disengagement, and partner performance issues. Escalate systemic patterns to CS COE leadership.
Strategic Customer Transformation
- Guide the team in translating AI strategy into account-specific execution: discovery sessions, use case identification by function (sales, finance, HR, legal), customer success plans tied to business KPIs, and phased rollout sequencing.
- Ensure each engagement produces a documented customer success plan within 30 days of kickoff, with defined before/after KPIs per use case, activation targets by cohort, and a clear path through the lifecycle.
Operational Rigor & Governance
- Drive disciplined account management across the team. Ensure weekly operational excellence tooling updates[BS1.1], lifecycle progression documentation, and telemetry monitoring. Hold CSS accountable for intervention triggers: root cause analysis of stalled adoption, product blocker escalation with documented customer impact.
- Contribute to preparation for business reviews with account-level data, portfolio health summaries, and recommended strategic actions. Represent the Quick Service CSS portfolio in bi-weekly steering committee and monthly program reviews.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Partner Support
- Collaborate with the rest of the CS COE teams: share field engagement patterns, customer evidence, and adoption insights that inform scalable asset development, while leveraging existing methodologies, playbooks, and tooling to accelerate the team's customer outcomes.
- Coordinate with Forward Deployed Quick Engineers on implementation-to-adoption handoffs, ensuring the transition from initial activation to scaled adoption is clean and well-documented.

descriptionHtml:

Amazon is looking to hire highly motivated Network Engineers to help design, deploy, operate and automate one of the worlds largest and most complex networks. With Amazon Web Services, our goal is to become “The Infrastructure Platform“ to the world and our customers demand the highest quality and reliability for their services. We are expanding at a tremendous rate and our goal is to design, deploy and automate network delivery while maintaining the highest reliability for our customers. Our teams scale the existing network, design new topologies, deploy these topologies and also automate activities where possible.

As an Optical Network Development Engineer working within AWS Infrastructure you will:
· Build, Operate and rollout our global DWDM networks
· Drive scaling current DWDM designs to meet the demand of our customers
· Create processes that help operate and build our DWDM network
· Work closely with other Networking departments on new designs
· Ensure that the DWDM network adheres to the defined network standards
· Review and implement changes on the DWDM network
· Drive operational excellence projects to drive improvements in our DWDM network quality and reliability
· Troubleshoot complex problems and develop innovative solutions day to day on our network.
· Our ideal candidate is highly autonomous, possesses strong written and verbal communication skills, strong project management and time management skills and has a successful track record of troubleshooting complex network problems and has experience in automation and delivering innovative solutions. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, collaborative environment is essential

A day in the life
Engineers in the Optical services team have a wide range of responsibilities. In terms of product development and delivery, it covers all activities related to hardware and software development, cross- platforms and software integration, and transition to production for both inhouse commodity and OEM optical platforms. From the lifecycle support perspective, includes day to day operations on-call, sustaining engineering, operational load automation and reduction, product and network security, network data integrity and authoritativeness, availability assurance (SRLG monitoring) and improvement (OLP, RFTS) and fiber infrastructure and vendor performance management. Our engineers not only make decisions on day-to-day work but they also own the long-term strategic view, they build strong partnership with customers to understand their immediate and future needs, their use cases and the things that we/they are not even thinking about so we make sure our solutions will fit into their needs. They bring perspective and context to influence the way we make technology and design choices, how we develop and deliver products that are right sized, fungible and future proof at the optimum cost per bit. They understand the business impact of their recommendations and show good judgment in decision making as we consider technical trade-offs between the immediate short-term technology solutions, operational needs and the long-term business needs.

About the team
The Optical Services team is responsible for the development, delivery and lifecycle support of the optical products used to interconnect AWS Data Centers and PoPs (Point of presence), ensuring diversity of supply and continually lowering data transfer cost for customers. This product portfolio serves a broad customer base and is primarily used to transport Core (EC2 & Prod) and Border (Internet) traffic in and across all but a few AWS commercial and ADC regions globally. Our current network size is >10Pbps of inter data center traffic over >30k devices worldwide and our team is structured to create and evolve these products and solutions while providing highly available, secure and scalable transport for multiple customer fabrics globally.

- 1+ years of automation scripting using Python, Bash, Shell and/or Perl experience

title: Principal Applied Scientist, WW Fulfillment by Amazon - Global Supply Chain & Economics Science
descriptionHtml:
Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is a service that enables sellers to outsource supply chain and fulfillment to Amazon and use Amazon's world-class science, technology, and logistics infrastructure to deliver billions of products from manufacturing hubs to customers worldwide with fast delivery promise. As FBA expands into end-to-end supply chain and fulfillment management, the science problems are growing in complexity and strategic importance. The FBA organization is looking for a Principal Applied Scientist with deep expertise in Operations Research, Reinforcement Learning, and strong modeling and analytical skills to join our cross-domain group of applied scientists, research scientists, economists, and data scientists building the intelligence layer for FBA's supply chain.

As a lead Principal Applied Scientist, you will own the science strategy and execution for the optimization algorithms that power FBA's supply chain, spanning the full journey from the moment a seller procures product at origin, through upstream warehousing and distribution, and into Amazon's fulfillment network. Working with a team of scientists, your technical challenges will span product selection optimization for capacity-constrained speed nodes, balancing demand coverage, profitability, and speed sensitivity across hundreds of sites; multi-echelon inventory optimization across a tiered architecture spanning origin-country warehousing, destination-country distribution centers, and regional fulfillment centers; auction mechanisms that allocate scarce capacity to sellers efficiently; seller recommendation systems that deliver explainable, economically quantified guidance; and adoption of frontier AI approaches to accelerate science delivery across the team. Your work will directly shape how millions of products flow from factory floor to customer door for millions of sellers, and your algorithms will determine the economic viability of Amazon's fastest-growing fulfillment investments.

We are looking for a seasoned scientist who brings rigorous operations research thinking to large-scale supply chain problems, and who thrives in the ambiguity of defining the roadmap rather than receiving it. The problems above also draw on reinforcement learning for sequential, non-stationary decisions; machine learning for the prediction and estimation layer; and mechanism design for incentive design and auctions. Beyond individual contribution, you will set the long-term technical vision across work streams, influence product managers, engineers, scientists, and senior leaders on high-judgment decisions, and mentor junior scientists. We value deeply technical people who deliver results incrementally and frequently in a fast-paced, high-energy environment, and who are eager to learn new areas and develop themselves and their colleagues.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the science strategy and development of inventory routing, replenishment, product selection, mechanism design, and transportation distribution algorithms that power FBA's supply chain across Amazon's fulfillment network.
- Design and implement large-scale optimization algorithms and incentive-compatible mechanisms for marketplace challenges, including auction design and pricing strategies.
- Partner with Product Managers and Software Engineers to translate ambiguous business challenges into well-scoped science initiatives, and build and deploy production-grade solutions that operate reliably at scale across a network serving millions of sellers.
- Influence senior leaders on technical and business direction, identify and propose new science investment areas, and represent the science perspective across organizations.
- Mentor and develop junior scientists, raise the technical bar for the broader science community, and drive adoption of emerging research methods across the team.

A day in the life
In this role, you will be a technical leader in operations research and optimization with significant scope, impact, and high visibility. Your solutions will lead to billions of dollars of impact on either the topline or the bottom line of Amazon's third-party seller business. You will work closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, and other Scientists to deeply understand FBA seller business problems and priorities. You will design and launch new systems, solving real-world inventory, transportation, replenishment, pricing, and mechanism design problems with millions of unique products involving hundreds of thousands of Selling Partners and tens of millions of customers around the world. As a scientist on the team, you will be involved in every aspect of the process — from idea generation, business analysis, and scientific research, through to development and deployment of production-grade optimization models — giving you a real sense of ownership. You are expected to make decisions about methodology, model architecture, and technology choices, striving for simplicity and judgment backed by mathematical rigor. You will also collaborate with the broader decision and research science community at Amazon to broaden the horizon of your work and mentor scientists.

About the team
Sellers play a vital role in Amazon’s ecosystem, integral to our mission of offering the Earth’s largest selection, lowest prices, and fastest delivery speed. FBA is an optional service that enables third-party sellers to outsource order fulfillment to Amazon, and leverage Amazon’s world-class facilities to provide customers fast delivery promise. With commitment to taking on even more of the supply chain and operational complexities on behalf of our selling partners, Amazon now provides an end-to-end suite of supply chain and fulfillment services. This comprehensive solution empowers sellers to reliably transport products from manufacturing sites to customers worldwide. The FBA team is the core group in charge of warehousing, inventory management, fulfillment and pricing, and a diverse range of recommendation services for sellers, as well as building the internal resource management systems. We work to learn seller behavior, understand seller experience, recommend right actions to sellers, design seller policies and incentives, and develop science products and services that empower sellers to grow their businesses. To do so, we build and innovate science solutions that leverage the right tools across different fields including operations research, economics, machine learning, statistics, and data analytics. Our culture is centered on rapid prototyping, rigorous experimentation, and data-driven decision-making.
We are open to hiring candidates to work out of one of the following locations: Bellevue, WA, or Sunnyvale, CA.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 10+ years of applied research experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with supply chain optimization, demand forecasting, inventory management, or transportation/logistics algorithms.
- Strength in mechanism design, auction theory, or game theory, particularly in settings involving strategic agents, capacity allocation, or market-based resource allocation.
- Experience with reinforcement learning applied to sequential decision-making in operations or supply chain contexts.
- Experience with product selection or assortment optimization for capacity-constrained systems.
- Proven ability to influence senior leadership and drive alignment across multiple organizations.
- Track record of translating ambiguous business problems into well-defined science solutions with measurable impact.
