title: Principal Global Account Manager - IT/ITeS Industry, AGS-APJ-India-ITS
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to own the AWS relationship with one of the world's largest System Integrators and reshape how tens of thousands of its developers build software? AWS is seeking a Principal Account Manager to serve as the Global Account Director for a strategic GSI / large IT & ITeS customer, owning AWS revenue and driving developer productivity and AI adoption across the customer's global engineering workforce.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

As the Global Account Director for a strategic GSI / IT & ITeS customer, you will own the end-to-end global sales relationship with an organization whose core asset is a global developer workforce numbering in the tens or hundreds of thousands. This is a role for a leader with roughly twenty years of experience who can operate at the highest level of ownership, set global account strategy, and orchestrate a large, distributed virtual team across geographies. Your central mandate is to make AWS the platform on which the customer's engineers build, and to drive a measurable step-change in their developer productivity through the AWS AI stack. You will own the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) motion end to end, from IDE and code generation through testing, deployment, and operations, embedding AWS AI tooling into how the customer's developers work every day. You will align regional sellers across NAMER, EMEA, and India, engage the customer's most senior executives, define a multi-year global strategy, structure the largest and most complex commercial constructs, and represent the voice of the customer inside AWS to shape product roadmaps and investment priorities.



Key job responsibilities
• Own the Global Account Strategy: Serve as the single global owner for the account. Define and drive a multi-year global account plan that aligns AWS capabilities with the customer's worldwide business objectives and engineering roadmap.
• Drive Developer Productivity at Scale: Make AWS the default platform for how the customer's global engineering workforce builds. Drive adoption of Amazon Q Developer, Kiro, and the broader AWS developer tooling stack across the customer's delivery teams, and tie adoption to measurable gains in developer throughput, code quality, and time-to-delivery.
• Own the AIDLC Motion End to End: Own the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle motion across the account. Embed AWS AI tooling into every stage of the customer's software lifecycle, from requirements and code generation through automated testing, code review, deployment, and operations, and convert developer-level adoption into enterprise-wide standardization.
• Sell the AWS AI Stack: Position AWS as the customer's platform of choice for AI and GenAI. Drive adoption of Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, Amazon SageMaker, and the broader AWS AI and data stack across the customer's engineering, product, and internal-productivity use cases worldwide, and convert early experimentation into production workloads at scale.
• Drive a Large-Scale Global Migration Motion: Lead the migration of the customer's on-premises, co-located, and competitor-cloud workloads to AWS at global scale, and drive the consumption growth that follows across every region.
• Drive a Global, Multi-Geography Sales Motion: Lead one consistent global motion across NAMER, EMEA, India, and other regions. Set global revenue objectives, then align and mobilize regional account teams to execute against a single coherent plan rather than disconnected local efforts.
• Executive Relationship Building at the Highest Level: Establish and sustain relationships with the customer's most senior global executives, including the CEO, CTO, Chief Digital Officer, and engineering and delivery leaders. Position AWS as the customer's primary strategic cloud provider and influence board-level technology and engineering decisions.
• Structure the Most Complex Global Deals: Lead the largest multi-year, multi-region commercial engagements, including EDPs, PPAs, global framework agreements, and custom pricing constructs. Navigate complex global procurement, legal, and commercial processes across multiple jurisdictions.
• Orchestrate Extended Teams: Operate as the single-threaded global leader, orchestrating across regional Account Managers, Solutions Architects, Professional Services, Specialist sellers, and Product teams to deliver unified outcomes for the customer.
• Global Revenue Ownership and Forecasting: Own global revenue targets for the account, build and manage a healthy worldwide pipeline, forecast accurately across regions, and drive consumption growth across developer tooling, GenAI, data and analytics, migration, and modernization.
• Segment Strategy Shaping: Contribute to AWS's global GSI and IT/ITeS segment strategy by identifying trends, competitive dynamics, and whitespace across the account. Provide inputs that shape go-to-market priorities and product direction.
• Lead Without Authority: Set direction for a large virtual team that does not report to you. Align senior stakeholders across AWS regions and functions, resolve conflicting regional priorities, and drive execution through influence.
• Mentor and Raise the Bar: Coach senior and junior Account Managers across the account team, share best practices for global account management, and act as a role model for how AWS engages its most strategic customers.


A day in the life
As the Global Account Director for a strategic GSI / IT & ITeS customer, you own the worldwide sales relationship and are responsible for driving the customer's developer productivity and AI transformation on AWS. Your day combines global strategy, senior executive engagement, cross-region orchestration, and complex deal leadership.

A typical day may include:
• Global Strategy and Alignment: Reviewing the global account plan, analyzing developer-tooling and AI adoption metrics alongside consumption and pipeline across regions, and aligning NAMER, EMEA, and India account leads on shared priorities and resourcing for the largest opportunities.
• Executive Engagement: Running global steering committees and executive briefings with the customer's engineering and business leadership, and joining regional business reviews to keep the worldwide plan on track.
• Driving the Developer and AIDLC Motion: Working with the customer's engineering leaders on rollout plans for Amazon Q Developer, Kiro, and the AWS AI stack, reviewing adoption and productivity data, and removing blockers to enterprise-wide standardization.
• Internal Orchestration: Engaging Solutions Architects and Product teams on technical proposals and roadmap needs, and coordinating across time zones with regional account teams.
• Deal Leadership: Advancing the most complex global commercial engagements, structuring multi-region agreements, and removing blockers across legal, procurement, and commercial functions in multiple countries.
• Advocacy: Bringing the voice of the customer into AWS, informing product and developer-tooling roadmaps, and representing AWS at senior customer and industry forums.



About the team
The GSI and IT/ITeS team owns AWS's sales relationships with the world's largest System Integrators and technology services organizations, global companies whose competitiveness depends on how fast and how well their developers build. You will own the global relationship for one of these customers and work with a collaborative, high-energy team that values customer obsession, ownership, and results at global scale.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating, that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve

- Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent

- Experience reaching and exceeding sales revenue goals
- Experience leading matrixed virtual teams that create and execute strategic programs
- • 15+ years of technology sales or strategic account management experience selling enterprise software, developer tooling, infrastructure, managed services, or cloud computing services.

title: Técnico/a de seguridad y salud
descriptionHtml:
En Amazon, la seguridad y el bienestar de nuestro personal es una prioridad absoluta. Nuestros Técnicos de Seguridad desempeñan un papel esencial para hacerlo posible. Este puesto es una oportunidad para comenzar tu carrera en seguridad laboral y desarrollarte en una empresa internacional. Colaborarás estrechamente con nuestros expertos para supervisar tu centro, lo que te permitirá ver cada día el impacto positivo de tu trabajo en el bienestar de las personas.


Key job responsibilities
- Realizar auditorías y evaluaciones de riesgos.
- Supervisar el centro para garantizar que los procesos cumplan con los procedimientos de seguridad de Amazon.
- Crear y actualizar informes sobre las métricas de seguridad para que los compañeros los revisen.
- Colaborar con el personal de Operaciones y de toda la empresa en tareas relacionadas con la seguridad y ofrecer orientación sobre los procesos.
- Apoyar en la implementación de nuevas medidas de seguridad.

A day in the life
Trabajarás en uno de nuestros centros. Esto significa que podrás seguir de cerca lo que sucede y los compañeros podrán consultarte fácilmente durante sus turnos. Este puesto consiste en identificar posibles problemas antes de que ocurran. Dedicarás mucho tiempo a revisar el centro y a conocer cómo el personal utiliza los equipos. Al comprender cómo funciona cada tarea y cada máquina, podrás pensar en la mejor forma de mantener los procesos seguros.

También serás una de las personas encargadas de poner en práctica los cambios de seguridad, lo que implica trabajar estrechamente con muchas personas. Además de tus tareas diarias y semanales, ofrecerás apoyo al equipo de Operaciones en trabajos puntuales relacionados con la seguridad.

La seguridad es fundamental en Amazon, y nos ayudarás a recopilar los datos esenciales que nos permiten controlar nuestros procesos y adelantarnos a cualquier incidencia. También compartirás esos datos con el personal de toda la empresa y colaborarás con otros equipos para asegurar que la seguridad sea siempre lo primero.


About the team
El equipo de Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) desempeña un papel fundamental para garantizar el bienestar mental y físico de nuestro personal en el trabajo. Nuestro equipo trabaja con responsables, asociados y administraciones locales en todos nuestros centros, asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas de Amazon y las normativas legales, y garantizando la seguridad de nuestros entornos de trabajo. El equipo ofrece una variedad de oportunidades, desde Técnicos de Seguridad hasta Responsables de Programas. Independientemente de tu puesto, contribuirás al desarrollo y la implementación de la estrategia de seguridad en toda la red.

Basic qualifications

- Formación como técnico/a intermedio en prevención de riesgos laborales (Incluye las especializaciones en Seguridad en el Trabajo, Higiene Industrial y Ergonomía, y Psicosociología aplicada), de acuerdo con los reglamentos españoles en materia de salud y seguridad.
- Experiencia relevante en el cumplimiento de la legislación local en materia de salud y seguridad.
- Dominio del español y nivel básico de inglés (A2), escrito y hablado.

Preferred qualifications

- Las cualificaciones preferidas no son necesarias para solicitar un puesto en Amazon. Si cumples con todas las cualificaciones básicas anteriores, nos encantará saber de ti.
- Experiencia con metodologías Lean, 5S o Kaizen.
- Experiencia en la planificación o gestión de iniciativas medioambientales.
- Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y en equipo.

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. title: Responsable des Opérations Logistiques
descriptionHtml:
Résumé

Les opérations représentent la force motrice d’Amazon. Ce service clé de notre activité nous permet d’exécuter et d’expédier les commandes de manière efficace afin que nos clients reçoivent leurs articles en temps et en heure. Il est chapeauté par les directeurs des opérations qui rassemblent l’équipe afin de promouvoir l’excellence en matière de sécurité, de qualité et de productivité sur l’ensemble de nos sites. Sur votre site, vous dirigerez d’autres responsables et créerez le planning opérationnel qui aidera vos équipes à atteindre leurs objectifs. Ce rôle consiste à favoriser l’excellence opérationnelle pour créer la société Amazon de demain.


Key job responsibilities
Missions

- Gérer et développer une équipe de chefs de secteur
- Diriger les équipes opérationnelles d’un quart, solutionner les problèmes et avoir un impact positif sur les performances du site
- Analyser les performances de l’équipe par rapport aux objectifs de l’entreprise et mettre en place des actions pour améliorer notre excellence opérationnelle
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec d’autres équipes de soutien (RH, Finance, Santé et sécurité, etc.)
- Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des initiatives sur l’ensemble des sites afin d’améliorer les performances opérationnelles

A day in the life
Journée type

Vous dirigerez des équipes sur l’un de nos sites logistiques. Vous serez également le maillon clé entre plusieurs équipes, notamment les équipes Finance, Sécurité et Intégration des opérations. Cela signifie que vous gérerez de près les opérations quotidiennes du site, mais aussi que vous contribuerez à de nouvelles méthodes d’innovation.
Lors d’une journée type, vous participerez à des réunions avec vos collègues de différents services de l’entreprise, mènerez une analyse approfondie des indicateurs de performance et de risque pour les sites, et réfléchirez aux meilleurs moyens de se préparer à différents niveaux de demande. Chaque jour, vous serez également amené·e à encadrer et à coacher votre équipe. Vous montrerez l’exemple en tant que leader et aiderez votre équipe à devenir les meilleurs managers possibles.

About the team
À propos de l’équipe

Notre centre de traitement des commandes (Customer Fulfilment, ou CF), est l’endroit où tout a commencé pour Amazon. D’une modeste équipe de libraires, le CF est devenu une équipe mondiale spécialisée qui traite plus de 1,5 million de commandes chaque jour. L’équipe CF est le moteur de notre entreprise et ses efforts nous ont permis de nous tourner vers de nouvelles régions et de proposer de nouveaux services. Avec l’aide des technologies émergentes, nous sommes en permanence à la recherche de solutions nouvelles pour proposer une gamme de produits plus large et de meilleure qualité, livrée rapidement et à un prix abordable.
L’équipe CF est le premier maillon de la chaîne qui permet aux clients d’obtenir les produits à la vitesse qui fait notre réputation. Nous sommes basés dans les centres de traitement des commandes, qui sont au cœur du réseau des opérations d’Amazon. Nos centres sont parfois appelés le « premier kilomètre », car c’est là que la plupart des colis Amazon commencent leur voyage. Nous aidons à gérer les stocks dynamiques et à faciliter les livraisons rapides, 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7.
Nos centres de traitement des commandes regroupent des profils variés et les opportunités y sont nombreuses. Certains membres de l’équipe travaillent avec des produits physiques, tandis que d’autres analysent des données. Ensemble, nous travaillons pour que chacun puisse prendre des décisions éclairées dans toute l’entreprise.

Basic qualifications

- Diplôme d'ingénieur, d'école de commerce ou d'université
- Expériences en management de cadres aux profils variés
- Expérience en analyse de données
- Capacité à communiquer en français et en anglais (oral et écrit)

Preferred qualifications

- Certification Lean ou Six Sigma
- Expérience dans un environnement industriel, logistique ou de transport

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers, agencies, authors, and entrepreneurs. Our ad solutions—including Twitch and Prime Video ADs—leverage Amazon’s innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys. With a range of flexible pricing and buying models, including self-service, managed service, and programmatic ad buying, these solutions help businesses build brand awareness, increase product sales, and more. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do, including advertising. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing team working to build a unique, world-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.

Amazon Adapt is a program designed to offer coverage solutions for business gaps which may occur due to extended leave (parental, medical) and unexpected account transitions. Amazon Adapt deploys highly skilled, hyper-agile talent that ensures customers can continue to invest in their partnerships with Amazon Advertising, uninterrupted. The program ensures that the high bar for customer service, strategic partnership, and revenue attainment is maintained during these coverage gaps.

As a member of the Amazon Adapt team, you will have the opportunity to work on a range of client businesses. This enables Adapt team members to experience high-velocity exposure to teams across the organization and to clients across different verticals. From day 1, Adapt team members must use their experience to earn trust with multiple stakeholders and take command of a new leadership role within a team. As a member of the Adapt team you will use your experience and vast knowledge in an array of work scenarios that affect internal stakeholders and clients. Adapt team members are decisive, knowledgeable, and use high judgement. The Adapt role will give you a chance to Learn and be Curious and the autonomy to own projects that will help you advance your career at Amazon. The Adapt team prioritizes flexibility, and hires for both 40 and 30 hour work weeks. If you are ready to make an immediate impact, embrace change, and accelerate your career at Amazon, come join us!



Key job responsibilities
- You deliver revenue while managing complex advertiser goals and problems to drive revenue
- You grow existing client revenues that may expand regionally
- You educate advertisers on performance metrics, insights, and how to drive greater results
- You develop campaign strategies and audience engagement recommendations
- You evaluate success metrics and drive campaign performance using data
- You leverage your knowledge of media and communications to develop annual brand plans and campaign media plans
- You educate customers based on customized insights
- You provide in-depth data analysis to form and deliver actionable recommendations for both short- and long-term advertising strategy
- You work cross-functionally with Senior Sales and other Amazon partners to drive incremental revenue and increase advertiser satisfaction
- This is a client facing role and requires up to 20% domestic travel as needed or 1x per month on average. Global travel may be required up to 2 times annually.




A day in the life
As an Sales Account Manager on the Adapt team, you will work with internal customers to create and execute advertising strategies while driving incremental revenue. You will rotate across teams and verticals to cover open books of business due to leaves of absence and use your experience and vast knowledge in an array of work scenarios to drive value for internal stakeholders and clients. You will consult the client to define goals and work backwards to develop a curated advertising strategy to achieve it. You use complex, data-driven insights to enrich advertisers' understanding of their campaigns, objectives and even business. Internally you work closely with Sales, Creative, Product, and other internal partner teams to drive advertiser success.

About the team
Amazon Adapt is a program designed to offer coverage solutions for business gaps which may occur due to extended leave (parental, medical) and unexpected account transitions or gaps in business needs. Amazon Adapt deploys highly skilled, hyper-agile talent that ensures customers can continue to invest in their partnerships with Amazon Advertising, uninterrupted. The program ensures that the high bar for customer service, strategic partnership, and revenue attainment is maintained during these coverage gaps.

Learn more about the Adapt team by hearing from our leaders here - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QzzMRk7LQCA.

- Experience in online marketing channels such as social media marketing, display advertising, and search engine marketing

- Experience identifying and resolving complex issues
- Experience leading process improvements

- Bachelor's degree in Economics, Marketing, Advertising, Statistics, Engineering, or Business

- 5+ years work experience in Advertising with experience owning Media Buying/Planning across Digital Advertising, eCommerce, and/or Linear Broadcast/Streaming TV focused roles.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Amazon Quick
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in building AI-powered services at the core of Amazon Quick on AWS? AI is reshaping how people work, and Amazon Quick is at the center of that transformation on AWS. Amazon Quick's built-in catalog lets organizations discover, share, and install agents, skills, connectors, and many quick resources — giving teams ready-made AI capabilities they can use from day one. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to own the architecture of the distributed services behind the skills platform and the broader catalog experience.

Amazon Quick is growing and we need senior Software Development Engineers who move fast, break down and solve complex problems, and have a strong will to get things done. This is an opportunity to lead technical direction on an experienced team of AWS engineers working on services within the skills, web search and catalog space, with a high degree of visibility across Amazon Quick and the broader AWS organization.

As a senior engineer on this team, you will lead technical direction across the services that power agentic resource authoring, discovery, publishing, versioning, and organization-level administration. Your design decisions will determine how customers build, browse, install, and share AI-powered agentic resources across their companies. If you want to solve real distributed-systems problems on a product that is actively changing how organizations use AI, this is the role for you.

What makes this role special?

- You will own high-visibility services at the core of Amazon Quick, with the scope to shape their architecture and direction.
- You will solve hard problems in distributed systems, data platforms, and marketplace infrastructure, at AWS scale.
- You will lead and grow a strong engineering team, leaving a lasting mark on both the people and the technology.
- You will build on AWS, the platform that defines the cloud industry, and ship features that reach customers around the world.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the architecture and technical direction of multiple distributed services, balancing reliability, scalability, performance, and cost.
- Lead large, ambiguous, cross-team initiatives from design through launch and production operation.
- Set and raise engineering standards across the team — code quality, design reviews, operational excellence, testing, and secure-by-design practices.
- Build and operate the infrastructure for Enterprise Data Platforms, applying modern distributed systems, data streaming, and data management best practices.
- Build the platforms that instrument key data, surface data quality issues, and provide data lineage and visibility, working with product owners and engineers across the company.
- Improve the reliability, performance, and operational posture of the team's services, including on-call leadership and incident response.
- Communicate clearly with teams and stakeholders, escalate issues at the right time, and resolve conflicts.
- Mentor and grow engineers, raising their technical depth and multiplying the team's impact.
- Set technical strategy within the team and influence technology across Amazon Quick and beyond.

About the team
The Quick Marketplace team owns the skills platform and catalog experiences within Amazon Quick, part of Amazon Web Services (AWS). We build and run the services that let customers discover, install, publish, and manage agents, skills, connectors, and other quick resources across their organizations — end to end from design to production.

Our team is investing in the infrastructure that makes it simple for organizations to customize Quick for their industries and workflows. Joining now means you will shape how the skills platform scales during a period of rapid growth, working alongside experienced engineers on problems that reach AWS customers worldwide.

A Culture of Curiosity

It is in our nature to learn and be curious. Our team culture is built on inclusion, and we take pride in our differences. We make space for every voice and support one another to do our best work.

Grow With Us

We care about your growth. You will find mentorship, knowledge-sharing, and the support you need to keep raising your bar and develop into a well-rounded engineer.

Life Beyond Work

We value work-life harmony. Success at work should not come at the expense of your life at home. We strive for flexibility so you feel supported both in and out of the office.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Joining this team means building on the platform that defines the industry.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

Our product portfolio spans the full electrical distribution chain, including medium voltage switchgear, medium voltage transformers, low voltage switchgear, generators, busduct, transfer switches, power distribution cabinets, and other critical electrical infrastructure.

title: Principal, Strategic Initiatives, Special Projects
descriptionHtml:
Visionaries wanted! Are you an entrepreneur? A dreamer? A builder? This role is on an Amazon Special Projects team that takes the company’s Think Big leadership principle to the limit. We focus on creating new businesses with a goal of positively impacting the lives of our customers. No industries or subject areas are out of bounds. If you’re interested in innovating at scale to address big challenges in the world, this is the team for you.

At Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have thirteen employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We are constantly learning through programs that are local, regional, and global. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Our team highly values work-life balance, mentorship and career growth. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects and offer training that will challenge you to become your best.

We are recruiting talent to play a key role in identifying and building new businesses at Amazon. We are looking for candidates who thrive in a fast-paced start-up like environment and want to invent the future for Amazon current and future customers. Working backwards from customers, you seek to understand key customer pain points, map potentially non-intuitive solutions to those needs, and leverage Amazon’s capabilities and resources to launch and scale new businesses. In this role, you are responsible for writing business reports, new business proposals, and evaluating reports and proposals at a high cadence. This is a high-visibility role in which you pitch new businesses to senior leadership for funding. After achieving funding, you leverage Amazon’s resources to building new businesses.

You have experience building a startup from zero-to-one (ideally having achieved revenue), and experience working within or evaluating new areas, startups, and investment opportunities. You have an insatiable appetite to learn new areas, a willingness to dive deep into details, and are quantitative. You are able to credibly engage stakeholders, investors, subject matter experts, and potential customers to form data-driven perspectives on businesses opportunities, and an ability to stay focused and motivated in an ambiguous, highly-dynamic environment. In additional to identifying and diving into innovative technologies, you are comfortable quantifying the business opportunity of ideas. You are adept at distilling complex subjects into easy to understand, actionable written artifacts based on data. Finally, you are willing and able to relocate to Seattle to work with a team in person in the near term. Still interested? Read on, we’d love to speak with you about this incredible opportunity!

Key job responsibilities
Our team at Amazon is recruiting a highly-versatile candidate to contribute to identifying opportunities for Amazon to build a large, sustainable business.

In this role, you:

Work independently within a small team to identify and qualify promising opportunities for new Amazon businesses.

Perform extensive first-person research independently and with the other members of a team.

Distill learnings from your internal and external research into clearly-written idea proposals for discussions and review.

Pitch rigorous business proposals to leadership for funding.

Post-funding, build a team and grow, launch, and scale a new business.

A day in the life
Over time, your role evolves from research and exploration as an individual contributor to implementation. Initially, you are tasked with bringing well-formed written proposals to the team for review. Once we've landed on a problem space and identified a solution that has Amazon-scale potential, you are responsible for building the “working backwards” document that outlines the opportunity and details the resources required to build it.

About the team
Using Amazon’s well-known process of working backwards from the customer, the Special Projects team looks across a wide range of industries and topics to develop ideas that Amazon hasn’t pursued yet. The Special Projects team uses Amazon’s six critical questions to decide which big ideas to develop:

1. Can the proposed solution make people’s lives better? We are inclined toward areas that yield widespread positive impact.

2. How many people does it impact? We seek areas that have the potential to impact at least 1% of the global population.

3. Could the business be large enough to “move the needle” for Amazon? We focus on opportunities that can grow into large, sustainable businesses.

4. Is the problem in an area well-served by others? We seek to solve unmet needs.

5. Is our approach to solving the customer’s problem differentiated? We develop solutions that are differentiated and often non-intuitive.

6. Why should Amazon do this? We are inclined toward solutions that (in part) leverage our internal expertise.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience technical product management
- 10+ years of end to end product delivery experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
- Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

title: Mission Manager, Launch Operations, Mission Manager
descriptionHtml:
Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of over 3,000 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

The Leo team is looking for a Mission Manager with experience in launch vehicle and dispenser interface management; launch systems integration; mission management; project management; and program management for complex multi-manifest launches. The role will interface with cross-functional engineering and program/product management teams to manage launch campaigns, interface with launch vehicle and dispenser system providers, and interface with internal stakeholders delivering satellites to the launch site. Join us and make a difference to people around the world!

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
• Plan efficient launch campaigns in a highly dynamic environment.
• Manage a complex schedule developed with internal and external stakeholders.
• Have technical proficiency with satellite integration.
• Drive engineering project throughout launch campaigns, make technical trade-offs, track and report on status, and resolve blocking issues.
• Oversee program plans for launch vehicle and dispenser system providers.
• Lead launch integration activities at the payload processing facility / launch site.
• Collaborate with payload processing facility stakeholders and drive requirements to closure.

• Collaborate with procurement, legal/regulatory and export control for contracts management, import/export, and related regulatory compliance.

• Fully competent in a variety of project management tools, methodologies and techniques for all phases of the project life-cycle and exhibit demonstrated proficiency in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, reporting and metric development/tracking.

You will plan multiple launch missions a year. For each, you will be aligning launch dates with satellite production, coordinating resources to perform the launch campaign, verifying launch documentation is ready, and holding integration and launch readiness reviews. Daily work will be with the Production Operations Team in Redmond or the PPF in Florida.
Work with a team of professional, experienced, space enthusiast Mission Managers to provide an efficient launch cadence to meet Leo launch rates. Collaboration with various teams in Leo is essential as we strive to innovate and make launch as routine as boarding a passenger flight.

title: Senior Chip Design Engineer , Graviton
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs is a fabless semiconductor company founded by industry veterans. We develop leading-edge products on state-of-the-art process technologies, and we're looking for talented engineers to help us build a semiconductor platform based on a revolutionary architecture.
You'll help develop state-of-the-art products within a disruptive system architecture, working on the technologies that power the world's largest cloud provider in a dynamic, open and fast-paced environment. AWS provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries.

AWS Graviton is a family of processors designed to deliver the best price performance for cloud workloads running in Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2). Graviton is designed in-house. It has reshaped what EC2 offers AWS customers and has become their preferred choice for cloud compute.
You'll join the Chip Design team on the Graviton product line. The team defines the product's features and owns their architecture and development. We work closely with product definition, pre- and post-silicon validation, physical design, software and other teams across the full chip development cycle, from idea to mass production. Your design will ship in Graviton products deployed in AWS data centers worldwide, so your work will have large-scale impact.
At Annapurna Labs, you'll play a key role in developing the next generation of semiconductor platforms for the world's largest cloud infrastructure, and in shaping the future of cloud computing.

Watch these videos to learn more about Annapurna Labs and the Graviton project:

* AWS re:Invent 2025 - Keynote with Peter DeSantis and Dave Brown: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JeUpUK0nhC0
* AWS re:Invent 2025 - AWS Graviton: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=haSHl2BLhm8

Act as the technical lead for a major SoC domain across its full lifecycle, from feature definition through tape-out and silicon bring-up
Work with Product Definition and Architecture to turn product requirements into feature specifications for your domain
Lead micro-architecture definition and own power, performance and area trade-offs, working with Physical Design and Software
Drive RTL design in Verilog/SystemVerilog and lead design reviews for the domain
Define and execute IP integration strategies
Set verification priorities with the Verification and Emulation teams, and lead system-level and post-silicon debug for your domain
Carry design learnings into the next Graviton generations, and improve design methodology and flows
Mentor and technically guide engineers working in your domain, raising the technical bar of the team

About the team
Annapurna Labs started in 2011, as a fabless chip start-up, focused on bringing innovation to the fast-growing cloud infrastructure. Four years after its inception, Annapurna Labs was acquired by Amazon Web Services (AWS). Since then, we have accelerated innovation and developed a number of products that benefit cloud customers, including AWS Nitro technology, AWS Graviton processors, AWS ML Inferentia & Trainium and more. Although Annapurna Labs is a small company, it is significant for AWS, with a reputation of being the key ingredient in the "secret sauce" behind its success. The Annapurna Labs team is responsible for building custom chips, accelerators, and software stacks that run on top of them, which gives us the possibility to optimize and improve our products in different layers more effectively.
We are a dynamic group of engineers dedicated to pushing the boundaries of semiconductor innovation. Our team combines the agility of a startup with the resources of Amazon Web Services, creating a unique environment where breakthrough technologies are born. We collaborate across disciplines, from product definition to silicon validation, ensuring each chip represents the pinnacle of performance and reliability.

title: Applied Scientist, Superconducting Digital and Cryogenic Control Electronics,Center for Quantum Computing, Physical Design and Simulation, Enabling Technologies
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) is seeking a Senior Applied Scientist to research and design cryogenic control hardware for large-scale quantum processors, with an emphasis on superconducting digital circuits. Control and reading out orders of magnitude more qubits than today's systems demands rethinking where classical control lives and what technology implements it; you will design and model superconducting digital logic (e.g., single-flux-quantum-family circuits) and related cryogenic electronics, evaluate them against the wiring, power, and thermal budgets of a scaled system, and co-design control approaches with the qubit devices they serve. You will carry designs from concept through simulation, layout, design review, and fabrication handoff, and your evaluations will inform which control-electronics directions the organization invests in.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and simulate superconducting digital circuits and cryogenic control/readout electronics for scalable qubit control
- Develop and validate Josephson-junction circuit models, timing and margin analyses, and verification methodology for superconducting digital designs
- Quantify system-level trade-offs — wiring count, power dissipation at each cryogenic stage, latency, footprint — across candidate control architectures, and communicate recommendations
- Co-design control interfaces with qubit-device colleagues so control electronics and quantum devices are developed as one system
- Deliver design artifacts through the organization's design-request and design-review processes, including tapeout-ready layouts and verification reports
- Present results internally and, where appropriate, publish in peer-reviewed venues

About the team
The Enabling Technologies team develops technologies and relationships facilitating scaling, including alternative quantum processor architectures, superconducting qubit device packaging, and cryogenic control device electronics. We work alongside a co-located quantum processor design team focused on current-generation devices; the two teams share design and review processes, and moving ideas between them is an explicit part of our charter.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience in professional software development

- 7+ years designing industrial control systems for automated manufacturing
- Proficiency in PLC programming (e.g., Siemens TIA Portal, Allen-Bradley Studio 5000, Beckhoff TwinCAT)
- Experience with industrial safety system design (e.g., ISO 13849, safety PLCs, safety networks)

Identify development opportunities through data and anecdotal feedback from onsite floor walks and observation. Educate leaders on HR operating model standards. Support interviews for site manager and technical manager roles.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with partner teams such as HRBPs and Centers of Excellence (COEs) to innovate, implement, and deploy HR strategies across your cluster of Data Centers. At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

title: Ausbildung - Mechatronik
descriptionHtml:
Deine Chance: Technik, die bewegt
Bei uns hältst du die Systeme am Laufen, die Produkte vom Klick bis zur Haustür bringen. Du analysierst Störungen, wartest komplexe Anlagen und arbeitest mit Mechanik, Elektrotechnik, Pneumatik und Steuerungssoftware, mit echtem Einfluss vom ersten Tag an.
Hier ist deine Arbeit nicht abstrakt. Sie ist sichtbar, unmittelbar und bedeutsam. Und dein Weg? Den gestaltest du selbst, mit endlosen Möglichkeiten, dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Du tüftelst gerne, packst mit an und willst früh Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.


Key job responsibilities
• Installation, Überwachung, Wartung und Instandhaltung mechanischer und elektrischer Anlagen.
• Analyse und Behebung von Störungen an automatisierten Systemen.
• Arbeiten in den Bereichen Metallbearbeitung, Elektrotechnik, Hydraulik, Pneumatik und Steuerungstechnik.
• Messen, Prüfen und Programmieren von Komponenten nach Vorgaben und Sicherheitsstandards.
• Unterstützung bei der vorbeugenden Instandhaltung und Inbetriebnahme neuer Anlagen.


A day in the life
Deine Ausbildung verbindet Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an. Deine theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst Du in unserer modernen Partnerlehrwerkstatt sowie der Berufsschule, während Du die praktischen Kenntnisse direkt bei Amazon am Standort erwirbst.
Ein typischer Tag? Du analysierst eine Störung an einer Förderanlage, tauschst Komponenten aus und bringst das System wieder zum Laufen. Am nächsten Tag programmierst du eine Steuerung, führst eine vorbeugende Wartung durch oder unterstützt bei der Inbetriebnahme neuer Technik.
Du arbeitest von Anfang an Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Techniker:innen, die dich fördern und fordern. Du übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung, probierst Dinge aus und lernst Fähigkeiten, von denen du vorher nicht wusstest, dass es sie gibt.

- Du hast mindestens einen Hauptschulabschluss zum Beginn der Ausbildung

Preferred qualifications

- Grundkenntnisse in Englisch (A2-Niveau)

title: Senior Supply Chain Manager III, AMXL
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's dynamic environment as a Supply Chain Manager with a planning background, where you will play a crucial role in shaping and optimizing various facets of our operations, concentrating on managing the flow of goods, information, or services within the supply chain network.

We have exciting opportunities across different business units, each seeking a skilled professional to lead strategic initiatives and drive process improvements within our supply chain network. As a strategic Supply Chain Manager, you'll take end-to-end ownership of operations, emphasizing capacity planning, logistics optimization, network design, and analysis of operational efficiency.

In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business, operations, program management, product, finance, and more. Utilize your analytical prowess to identify opportunities for operational improvements, implement scalable systems, and drive automation to enhance efficiency, with a particular focus on optimizing the physical flow and operations within the supply chain network. Whether you're managing network capacity initiatives, overseeing cross-functional programs, or focusing on strategic projects, your impact will be visible, ongoing, and contribute directly to our commitment to being the most customer-centric company on earth.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the long-term network plan for AMXL's middle mile network, including the multi-year sort center topology, linehaul connectivity and carrier mix strategy, and capacity plan.
- Own the inputs, outputs, and assumptions of the network optimization models used to build those plans, working with the science teams who develop them.
- Author the full year plans and planning documents for your segment through Amazon's annual and three-year planning cycles, and present recommendations to Director and VP leadership.
- Lead cross-organizational workstreams on network strategy, such as externalization and hard regionalization, with Operations, Finance, Transportation, and Retail partners.
- Analyze and synthesize data to identify opportunities for enhancing customer experience and operational efficiency in the network.
- Define metrics, develop mechanisms, and invent and simplify processes to drive decision-making in complex network situations.
- Collaborate with stakeholders across functions, influencing and facilitating agreements to achieve shared network goals.


A day in the life
In this role you own the long-term plan for AMXL's middle mile network: how volume flows from fulfillment centers through sort centers to delivery stations, which lanes run on Amazon's fleet versus third-party carriers, and how the network extends to external customers. You work with our science, finance, transportation, engineering, and operations partners to model what the network needs to look like over the next three years, and you write and present the recommendation to senior leadership. You will also own the strategic questions that come out of those reviews and see them through to a decision.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you're passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!


About the team
Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) is a single-threaded organization that owns the end-to-end customer experience for heavy and bulky products. AMXL consolidates supply chain, tech, FC operations, transportation, delivery stations, and last mile delivery. We also provide special handling services such as Room of Choice delivery, Haul-Away, and Installation/Assembly for select items. AMXL currently has operations in NA and EU.

We are seeking an experienced supply chain planner for a role on the middle mile long-term planning team, responsible for the design of AMXL's sort center and linehaul network, carrier mix strategy, and the network modeling behind AMXL's externalization initiatives. In this role you will deal with ambiguity, identify problem statements, and develop innovative solutions to improve customer experience, reduce cost, and create a best in class fulfillment network. We make complex problems fun working backwards from our customers!

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of supply chain management (e.g. logistics, inventory turn management, forecasting, operations) experience
- Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree, or MBA in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
- Experience writing strategy documents for executive audiences with clear recommendations in the midst of ambiguity
- Experience with VBA, Python, SQL, or other database language
- Experience building network design, capacity, or flow optimization models, or working directly with science teams that do

title: Operations Manager III
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Last Mile network delivers millions of packages to customers' doorsteps every day, and our Rural Super Rural (RSR) team takes on some of the most challenging delivery territory — longer routes, lower stop density, and greater distances between stops. We are looking for an Operations Manager to run an entire delivery station, owning everything from cost and budgeting to productivity, quality, and on-time delivery. In this role, you will operate as the general manager of your building, leading a team of exempt leaders and frontline associates while applying Lean continuous improvement methods to solve complex problems unique to rural logistics. Our RSR network is growing, and this is a great time to step into a leadership role where you can shape how we deliver for customers in some of the hardest-to-reach areas.

Key job responsibilities
- Own building-level performance across cost, payroll, productivity, budgeting, quality control, and on-time delivery, using data and Lean continuous improvement methods to drive results.
- Lead, hire, and develop exempt leadership and frontline associates, building a culture of accountability, continuous feedback, and professional growth across all shifts.
- Drive safety as the top priority by modeling safe behaviors, conducting regular gemba walks, integrating safety into daily planning, and holding your leadership team accountable for improvements.
- Collaborate with cross-functional partners including Safety, Human Resources, Engineering, and Loss Prevention to develop and execute plans that meet building objectives and improve the associate experience.
- Identify systemic operational issues through root cause analysis, develop solutions that account for upstream and downstream impacts, and implement scalable process improvements across the building.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing safety metrics and building performance with your leadership team, then set clear priorities for the shift ahead. From there, you will walk the floor to observe operations firsthand, coach managers in real time, and work through emerging challenges. You will also partner with support teams on improvement initiatives and join planning discussions that connect your building's results to broader RSR network goals. Our buildings operate 24 hours a day, and this position may require nights and/or weekends.

About the team
Rural Super Rural (RSR) sits within Amazon's Last Mile network, focused on delivering packages to customers in rural and less densely populated areas. These regions present unique operational challenges that require thoughtful planning and strong execution to maintain speed and reliability. Our network is growing, and our team is powered by a combination of delivery partners, technology, and the frontline teams who bring the customer experience to life every day. If you are excited about leading an entire building and making a direct impact on how customers receive their orders, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

descriptionHtml:

The Payments and Fraud Data Platform team within AWS Payments & Fraud is the backbone of one of the most critical missions at AWS: ensuring every transaction is safe, every suspension is justified, and every customer experience is seamless. Power ML & Rules Engines - Deliver high-quality, timely datasets that fuel non payment and fraud detection ML models and business rule engines, directly impacting fraud prevention and non-payment suspension accuracy.
Build Intelligent Data Access Layers - Design and implement a Smart Query & Data Access Analyzer that profiles query patterns, identifies hot data, and automatically promotes frequently accessed datasets into hot memory tiers (e.g., OpenSearch, DynamoDB DAX, Redshift RA3 caching) for sub-second retrieval.
Create Natural Language SQL Interfaces - Leverage Amazon Bedrock and LLM (large language models) to build a natural language-to-SQL generation tool that empowers analysts and stakeholders to query complex fraud datasets conversationally - no SQL expertise required.
Develop Real-Time Dashboards & Insights - Build rich, interactive dashboards using Grafana and internal tooling that provide real-time visibility into fraud trends, pipeline health, data quality metrics, and operational KPIs.
Curate a Living Data Dictionary - Design and maintain a comprehensive, searchable data catalog and dictionary that provides rich metadata, lineage, and documentation - improving discoverability and self-service analytics across the organization.
Champion Data Quality at Scale - Implement automated data validation, anomaly detection, and reconciliation frameworks that ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency across the entire data lifecycle.
Secure & Govern Sensitive Data - Implement encryption, fine-grained access controls, audit trails, and compliance frameworks to protect highly sensitive payments and fraud data.
Monitor, Optimize, Repeat - Build observability into everything , proactive alerting, pipeline performance tracking, SLA monitoring, and intelligent auto-remediation to ensure five-nines data reliability.

About the team
The AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention team protects AWS and its customers from fraud, abuse, and account compromise at global scale. We build highly scalable, batch and near real-time systems that ingest billions of signals daily, process petabytes of data, and make timed decisions to stop bad actors from account registration through the entire customer lifecycle. DynamoDB and OpenSearch drives search and analytics, and Amazon Bedrock serves as our AI/ML foundation. title: Software Development Manager, Traffic Marketing Tech - Search
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Stores Economics and Science organization is building the Internet's largest-scale Search Marketing systems worldwide. The team is responsible for a number of business-critical systems that generate, target, measure, and optimize hundreds of millions of search engine ad placements and organic search listings. We bring prospective customers who start their shopping journeys on search engines, and increasingly in AI assistants and agentic shopping experiences, to Amazon through our ML- and LLM-driven software and systems. We apply best-in-class digital marketing and search engine optimization (SEO) techniques to process and optimize billions of webpages, images, videos, and content snippets to improve Amazon's discoverability across both traditional search and AI-mediated discovery. We routinely solve challenges related to large-scale distributed services, applied science, big data systems, and web search. Cutting-edge technology is core to our business, from large language models, generative AI, and agentic systems to machine learning and large-scale optimization, and we build in an AI-native way, using AI tools and agents across the development lifecycle to raise our quality and velocity.

As a Software Development Manager on this team, you will lead a team of software development engineers building the technology behind tens of millions of daily search-engine shopping queries. You will own the technical direction and product roadmap for your area, partnering closely with product managers to define requirements and with peer engineering teams to unblock dependencies. With a strong research-and-development component to the work and multi-million dollar business impact, this role combines hands-on technical leadership with meaningful people management and career development.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and grow a team of software development engineers, providing coaching, career development planning, and actionable feedback that raises the performance bar.
- Define and prioritize the team's product roadmap in partnership with product managers, translating customer and business needs into clear technical requirements and sprint plans.
- Own the operational health and quality of your team's services, establishing metrics and mechanisms that ensure reliability at scale.
- Collaborate across dependent teams to resolve blockers, align on priorities, and deliver cohesive solutions that serve shared business goals.
- Drive system design decisions and evaluate tradeoffs across scalability, maintainability, and performance, keeping your architecture simple and sustainable.

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing operational dashboards and triaging any alerts before joining your team's standup. From there, you might spend time in a design review with your engineers, then shift to a roadmap planning session with your product manager to scope upcoming features. Afternoons often involve cross-team syncs to resolve dependencies and unblock your engineers, followed by a one-on-one where you discuss a team member's career goals. Throughout the day, you balance technical depth with people leadership, using AI-native tools and workflows that keep the team productive and learning.

About the team
The Search Marketing team within Stores Economics and Science builds the systems that connect shoppers on external search engines and AI assistants with the right products on Amazon. We operate at massive scale, processing billions of webpages and content assets through machine learning and optimization pipelines. Our work has a direct, measurable impact on how customers begin their shopping journeys.

We are an inclusive, collaborative group of engineers, scientists, and product managers who value curiosity and continuous improvement. Cross-team partnerships are central to how we operate, giving you broad influence and exposure to new technologies — including AI-native development workflows that keep the team at the forefront of modern software engineering.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of engineering experience
- 3+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

descriptionHtml:
Hardware Development Engineer II – Thermal Analysis

We are seeking a Hardware Development Engineer II to join our Electric Propulsion Subsystem team. In this role, you will be a significant and autonomous contributor, solving difficult thermal engineering problems for an electric aerial drone. You will own the thermal analysis and thermal management strategy for the vehicle's battery pack, electric motors, power electronics, and avionics, developing high-fidelity FEA and CFD models that drive design decisions.

This position requires an engineer who demonstrates strong technical depth in heat transfer, fluid dynamics, and numerical simulation while also exhibiting the system-level thinking and influence characteristic of our most impactful contributors.



Key job responsibilities
• Develop high-fidelity FEA and CFD thermal models of the drone's battery pack, motors, power electronics, and avionics, capturing conduction, convection, and radiation across the full flight envelope and ambient operating range.
• Define and develop thermal management strategies and systems for the battery pack, including cold-weather heating, in-flight and ground cooling, and cell-to-cell temperature uniformity.
• Develop cooling strategies for electric motors and motor controllers, including forced-air and conductive paths, and trade thermal performance against mass, drag, and packaging constraints.
• Analyze candidate designs and quantify thermal margins, hot-spot locations, transient temperature response, and sensitivity to operating conditions, and communicate results as clear design recommendations.
• Perform thermal analysis of avionics systems, defining heat-sinking, airflow, and conduction paths that maintain component junction temperatures within reliability limits.
• Build reduced-order and lumped-parameter thermal models derived from high-fidelity simulations for use in system-level performance, range, and mission-planning tools.
• Define and execute thermal test campaigns, including instrumented bench tests, environmental chamber tests, and flight test data collection, and correlate physical results to analysis models.
• Establish thermal design requirements and operating limits.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of working in mechanical engineering or equivalent experience
- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- Experience developing and validating thermal models including reduced-order models, FEA, and CFD.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent
- Experience with electric powertrain components and thermal management systems design
- Experience with applicable aerospace design standards including DO-25, DO-160G, SAE AIR1168, or MIL-STD-810

title: Applied Scientist II, Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS)
descriptionHtml:
Can a large language model read a regulatory change and draft the requirements and control tests that follow from it, accurately enough for a Compliance Officer to sign off? How do you train a breach-risk model when confirmed breaches are rare, arrive months after the event, and mean different things to Compliance, Assurance, and the regulator? What does a model have to prove before a Compliance team acts on its output?

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to join the Data and Analytics team within Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS). Our team builds the data, analytics, and modeling layer that RCS runs on, from regulatory reports and filings to the intelligence that tells Compliance Officers and our first line of defense (1LoD) partners where risk concentrates and which controls hold. You build the machine learning (ML) and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) systems in that layer, take them into production, and own the evaluation science that lets Compliance rely on them.

The work spans 3 areas: risk models that score which open risks and control weaknesses convert to breaches; GenAI systems that remove manual effort from requirement translation, control testing, and regulatory reporting, with human approval gates at every stage; and the evaluation science behind every model and agent the team ships. Financial crime compliance is the first domain, and its constraints shape the science: threats change faster than control sets adapt, and every output faces internal audit and external examination. Once an approach proves out, you carry it into the next compliance domain across the RCS portfolio.

You own problems from formulation to production: framing the science question with Compliance and 1LoD partners, designing experiments and backtests, building and validating models, and shipping them into the pipelines, reports, and tools that RCS teams use. The stack includes Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Redshift, and AWS Lambda, and your partners include data scientists, data engineers, business intelligence engineers, and software development engineers across RCS.

The successful candidate treats an auditor's question as a design requirement, writes production-quality code alongside their models, and stays comfortable when the evaluation set does not exist until they build it.

Key job responsibilities
• Formulate ambiguous compliance problems as ML and GenAI problems with Compliance and 1LoD partners, and choose methods that fit the data, the risk, and the audit standard
• Develop risk models that learn from rare, delayed, and noisy labels to score which risks and control weaknesses convert to breaches, and calibrate them so a score carries a defensible meaning
• Build GenAI systems that remove manual effort from requirement translation, control testing, and regulatory reporting, with human approval gates at every stage
• Design the evaluation for every ML and GenAI system you ship: golden sets that compliance experts label, metrics suited to rare outcomes and generated text, and release criteria a system meets before Compliance relies on it
• Deploy and monitor models in production with software development engineers, including drift detection, performance tracking against realized outcomes, and retraining criteria
• Explain model decisions, quantify uncertainty, and document methodology so Compliance Officers, auditors, and examiners can trace how a system reached each output
• Create reusable science components, such as feature sets, scoring services, and evaluation harnesses, so an approach that works in financial crime compliance extends to the next domain without a rebuild
• Review peer models for statistical soundness, mentor data scientists and engineers on ML methods and experimental design, and publish or patent where the work and confidentiality allow


About the team
Risk and Compliance Solutions (RCS) serves as a crucial safeguard for Amazon's buyers, brands, and selling partners while ensuring business teams meet their regulatory obligations. RCS operates as the second line of defense under the Three Lines of Defense (3LoD) model, providing specialized oversight, monitoring, and expertise while setting policies and procedures that guide Amazon's compliance framework.

RCS's mission is to apply specialist industry insights and Amazon's unique approach to scale through technology, delighting customers through tailored compliance solutions. Our work spans multiple critical areas, including:
• Streamlined license acquisition that enables Amazon's financial services expansion
• Management of existing business risks across the organization
• Comprehensive governance, risk, and assurance services
• Innovative solutions such as Compliance as a Service (CaaS)
• A proactive, intelligence-led framework for compliance operations

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience in financial modeling, or experience designing and implementing controls or experience performing audits over financial reporting environment
- Experience with training and deploying machine learning systems to solve large-scale optimizations, or experience with data infrastructures: relational analytic DBMS, Elastic-Search, and Big Data EMR/EC2/Glue/Lambda
