title: Area Manager Jr, Worldwide Operations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for high-potential leaders, who are ready to own their impact in Amazon Operations as an entry-level manager. We promise you will have your leadership capacity stretched to its full potential. As a front-line leader, you will have an opportunity to truly invest in others and develop a people-focused leadership style, while mastering the tools, processes, and operations that have created the most customer-centric company on Earth. If you want to be involved in continuing to define the future of online retail, and are dynamic and an organized self-starter, join our team in Amazon Operations as an Area Manager.
As an Area Manager, you will have the opportunity to lead and develop your own team of Amazon Associates in a distribution warehouse environment. Your main focus will be motivating, mentoring and coaching your team. As a servant leader, the Area Manager will ensure that their team of Amazon Associates have all the tools needed to succeed for any task during a shift. Engaging with your team during a shift to ensure that the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance performance and engagement are maintained are core functions of the role. Come learn how the largest online retailer in the world runs its fulfillment and delivery networks!

What is fulfillment you ask? Fulfillment is how we refer to completing or fulfilling a customer’s Amazon.com order and the acts of picking, packing, shipping and delivering their order to meet or exceed their expectations!

Locations and Placement:
- The position is NOT a corporate role and will be located in a Fulfillment Center: BJX1 at León, GTO.


Key job responsibilities
- Lead, manage, and develop a team of 20 to 50 Amazon Associates
- Communicate policies to Associates and act as the primary information source for the team, maintaining compliance, consistency, and taking corrective action when needed
- Create, manage, and support recognition and communication programs
- Support all safety programs and OSHA compliance to ensure a safe work environment for all Associates
- Ensure procedures are followed for building security and product loss prevention
- Partner with the management team to establish and maintain quality control standards
- Develop performance goals and objectives to achieve customer demand and ensure accuracy and quality.

A day in the life
Must be able to perform the following tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation:
- Stand/walk for up to 10-12 hours
- Walk in/and around the warehouse with great frequency; many facilities are over a quarter mile in length
- Access all areas of building (ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation)
- Regularly bend, lift, stretch and reach both below the waist and above the head
- Lift and move items up to 49 pounds.

About the team
Inclusive team culture
At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance
We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Applied Scientist, PXT Central Science
descriptionHtml:
The People eXperience Technology (PXT) Central Science (PXTCS)'s mission is to make PXT the most scientific, technologically proficient, and inclusive HR organization in the world. PXTCS does this by accelerating scientific rigor in business-led initiatives, working backwards from employee experience, and delivering science-driven products that improve the well-being of and value of work for Amazonian worldwide.

We are seeking an Applied Scientist to build production machine learning systems that turn Amazon's employee listening signals into insight at scale. You will design, develop, and deploy ML solutions that transform large volumes of employee feedback — survey responses, free-text comments, and other listening channels — into signals that drive strategic decision-making across the organization. In this role, you will work on challenging problems spanning natural language processing, large language models, predictive modeling, and generative AI applications applied to employee experience. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate ambiguous business challenges into rigorous technical solutions.

Key job responsibilities
- Apply and adapt state-of-the-art NLP and machine learning techniques to extract structured, reliable signals from employee listening data (surveys, free-text feedback, and related channels), using reasonable assumptions, data, and customer requirements.
- Design, develop, and implement small-to-medium ML components on top of the employee listening system — such as theme and sentiment extraction, text classification, and aggregated signal generation — with input and guidance from senior scientists, taking ownership of the code in your components.
- Write secure, stable, testable, maintainable, well-reviewed code (at the SDE I bar) to deliver solutions into production that benefit customers and the business.
- Design features and signals responsibly, applying privacy-preserving practices appropriate to sensitive employee data.
- Collaborate with cross-functional partners to understand business context and impact, and help mentor interns.
- Communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, from technical peers to senior leadership.

About the team
The People eXperience and Technology Central Science Team (PXTCS) uses economics, applied science, statistics, and machine learning to proactively identify mechanisms and process improvements which simultaneously improve Amazon and the lives, wellbeing, and the value of work to Amazonians. We build and apply science on top of Amazon's employee listening systems — turning what Amazonians tell us into products and insights that improve their experience. We are an interdisciplinary team that combines the talents of science and engineering to develop and deliver solutions that measurably achieve this goal.

descriptionHtml:
※本ポジションの勤務地は東京都板橋市に新たに立ち上がる物流拠点です。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

我々は日本のAmazon Logistics （AMZL）チームのデリバリーステーション・オペレーションマネージャーを募集しています。AMZLのゴールはお客様に荷物をお届けする物流の最後の区間、ラストマイルにおいて、世界水準のオペレーションを構築することです。Amazonではお客様により速く、正確に、そして効果的な方法でお届けすることで、お客様の期待を上回るサービスを提供することに重点的に取り組んでおり、日本でもAMZLが急速に拡大しています。

デリバリーステーション（DS）のオペレーションマネージャーは、出入荷、ソートオペレーションに対する責任を負い、大きな裁量を任される仕事です。センター長の右腕として、マネージャーレベルの部下を持ち、ソート（仕分け）やディスパッチ（配送ドライバーへの荷物の引き渡し）のオペレーションを指揮します。また、DSで働くメンバーのエンゲージメントを高め、日々のオペレーションの目標を確実に遂行することに加え、さらなる高みを目指してオペレーションの改善や新しいサービスの導入を進めていく改善スキル、推進力が期待されています。

【具体的な業務内容】
・ソートおよびディスパッチオペレーションのリードおよび監督
・シフト全体の安全性、品質、パフォーマンス、カスタマーサービス向上
・組織の方針と手順に従っての監督責任
・オペレーション目標の達成、および、それを上回る成果の実現
・物量等の予測に基づく、戦略的な計画立案、パフォーマンスの評価、問題の解決および人材配置に関するニーズへの対応
・チームメンバーのキャリア向上、指導、トレーニングおよび育成
・Learning and Talent Developmentチームとのパートナーシップにより、人材の獲得、パフォーマンスとキャリア開発、育成、サクセッションプランに関する計画の立案と実行
・シフトとネットワーク全体にわたってのベストプラクティスの創出・展開

このポジションに求められるのは、経験に裏打ちされたプロセスの改善能力と、Amazonの成長速度に合わせ、メンバーのモチベーションを高めながらさまざまなチャレンジに対して短期間で成果を出していく能力を持つ候補者です。また、さまざまな経験、バックグラウンドを持つ多様なメンバーと協業していく柔軟性が求められます。

title: Instandhaltungstechniker:in Elektrotechnik
descriptionHtml:
Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du für die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer förder- und haustechnischen Anlagen sowie Produktionsanlagen zuständig. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.

Key job responsibilities
- Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten
- Durchführung von Reparaturen und Fehlerdiagnosen
- Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
- Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
- Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
- Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten

A day in the life
Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen.

Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen.

In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

About the team
Mit der Erfüllung unserer Kundenbestellungen (Customer Fulfillment oder CF) fing für Amazon alles an. Das Customer Fulfillment Team hat sich mittlerweile von einem Team von Buchhändler:innen hin zu einem hocherfahrenen globalen Team gewandelt, das täglich mehr als 1,5 Millionen Bestellungen bearbeitet. Das Team bildet die Grundlage unseres Geschäfts und hat uns bei der Verbreiterung in neue Regionen und Dienstleistungen geholfen. Mithilfe aufkommender Technologie sind wir stetig auf der Suche nach Möglichkeiten, eine größere und bessere Produktauswahl anzubieten – die schnell und erschwinglich geliefert wird.
Die CF-Teammitglieder sorgen als allererste dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen mit der Geschwindigkeit erhalten, für die wir bekannt sind. Wir arbeiten in Fulfillment-Centern, die das Herzstück von Amazons dynamischem Betriebsnetz bilden. Unsere Fullfilment-Center werden manchmal auch als die „erste Meile“ (First Mile) bezeichnet – hier starten die meisten Amazon-Pakete ihren Versandweg. Wir unterstützen die Verwaltung eines dynamischen Bestands und ermöglichen schnelle Zustellungen rund um die Uhr.
In unseren Fulfillment-Centern sind vielfältige Mitarbeitergruppen beschäftigt. Es gibt zahlreiche Möglichkeiten für Menschen mit den verschiedensten Fähigkeiten. Einige von uns arbeiten mit physischen Produkten. Andere analysieren Daten und helfen unternehmensweit dabei, intelligente Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Basic qualifications

- Abgeschlossene elektrotechnische Berufsausbildung, anerkannt durch die Industrie- und Handelskammer (IHK) oder Handwerkskammer (HWK) oder Nachweis eines erfolgreich abgeschlossen Hochschulstudium im Ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich (Maschinenbau / Elektrotechnik oder artverwandt) einer deutschen Hochschule oder anerkannte ausländische Hochschulabschlüsse (BA, B. Sc., MA, M. Sc., Dipl.-Ing.)
- Mindestens zweijährige Berufserfahrung in dem entsprechenden Handwerk
- Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung von industriellen Produktionsanlagen
- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Preferred qualifications

- Erfahrung mit zustandsorientierter Überwachung
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Druck- und Applikationsmaschinen
- Erfahrung in der Störungssuche und Wartung von Förder- oder Automationssystemen

title: Principal Product Manager - Technical, AWS Proactive Security / Support Authorization, AWS Proactive Security - AWS Piezo
descriptionHtml:
The Mission
AWS customers trust us with their sensitive data. We are building AWS Support Authorization, the mechanism that puts the decision about Support access in the customer's hands. The customer defines what AWS personnel may do, scoped to their own resources and bound to their open support case, and sees the resulting access in CloudTrail. We are looking for a Principal Product Manager - Technical to own that product and define the experience every AWS service presents when it needs a customer's permission. Your work will change how AWS asks for access to customer content across its services, and it will carry to customer data protection at industry scale.

What You'll Own
You own the approval product end to end, from the API and console surfaces to the evidence a customer keeps afterward and the requirements AWS service teams build to. You define the approval model and the experience a customer moves through when AWS asks for permission, you set the success metrics, and you read the usage data to learn whether customers trust the control enough to use it. You partner with AWS Support, service teams, and Legal on what approval means in each operational context, and with GTM, Marketing, and PR on the strategy, messaging, and themes AWS uses to talk about customer approval and operator access, so what a customer hears matches what they find in the product.

The Product Challenge
A customer with an open case wants two things at once. They want to decide who touches their data, and they want their problem fixed now. Approval that feels meaningful to give takes effort to give, and the person paying that effort is already waiting on help. Designing an experience a customer trusts, can get through without stalling their own case, and recognizes whichever AWS service they called about is the center of this role. There is no predetermined answer. You define it, and you take the definition to the service teams that build to it.

The Impact
Your work will have CISO-level visibility. You write the decision narratives and investment proposals that set product direction, and you take them to VPs and the CISO. You set requirements for engineering teams that do not report to you, and you earn adoption by being right and being clear. You represent the product directly to customers in financial services, healthcare, and the public sector, who ask hard questions about who at a provider can reach their data. As the capability reaches the rest of AWS, the experience you define becomes the way AWS asks for a customer's permission.

What We're Looking For
You are a product manager with real technical depth and a long view. You think about what this product should be two and three years out, before customers have put words to the requirement, and about what it says about AWS to a customer deciding where to run a regulated workload. You have defined a platform product that other engineering teams adopted and built on without reporting to you, and you did it by writing requirements clear enough to survive contact with engineering. You read an authorization or access-control architecture closely enough to know which models a given service can implement. You work across the whole AWS portfolio, where services differ in how they are built and operated, and you guide VPs and directors on where the product goes next. You hold opinions about security and permissions experiences and you back them with customer evidence. You set strategy while the customer requirements are still being discovered, and you own the call when security and customer convenience pull against each other. You have worked with product marketing and PR on positioning a capability whose value is trust, and you have sat across from a regulated customer and answered hard questions about provider access. You develop other product managers as the product grows past what one person owns.

Key job responsibilities
Own the customer experience for AWS Support Authorization end to end: how a customer learns Support needs access, what the request tells them, how they decide, what proof they keep afterward. Define the consent model, covering approval granularity, defaults, duration, revocation behavior mid-case, and the evidence a customer receives. Set the requirements AWS services build to as the capability reaches the rest of AWS, and decide which elements a service team may shape to its own workflow. Own the API and console product surfaces. Define the success metrics and read the usage data to learn how customers respond to consent requests. Partner with AWS Support and service teams on what consent means in each operational context, and bring in Legal on the commitments the product makes to customers. Partner with GTM, Marketing, and PR on how AWS positions customer consent and operator access. Write the decision narratives and investment proposals that set product direction and present them to VP and CISO-level leadership. Represent the product directly to customers. Mentor PMTs and contribute to PMT assessments.

A day in the life
The AWS Proactive Security team builds the controls that protect customer data at scale. You start the day in the usage data, looking at how customers responded to consent requests over the past week and what that says about the experience. You meet a service team preparing to adopt Support Authorization, work through how consent should present for their access patterns, and decide what their integration can and cannot vary. Midday you review messaging with Marketing so the way AWS describes customer consent matches what the console does. In the afternoon you write: a narrative on where the consent model goes over the next two years, for a review with VPs and the CISO. You close the day on a call with a regulated customer walking them through the control and hearing what still gives them pause.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience
- 5+ years of technical (software development, network development, IT, other related) experience
- Experience delivering large-scale SaaS, PaaS or LaaS products where you are responsible for the full product lifecycle, from concept through GTM (go to market)

Preferred qualifications

title: Product Manager, High Consideration Basket Building
descriptionHtml:
Customers purchasing high-consideration products such as laptops, televisions, cameras, and mobile devices often need complementary products and services to complete their shopping mission. Finding the right accessories and services can require additional research across multiple Amazon experiences.

The High-Consideration Basket Building team is looking for a Product Manager to improve and expand how customers discover complementary products and services across Hardlines. You will own a defined set of customer experiences within the Basket Building portfolio, including attach recommendations and post-add-to-cart experiences.

This role is suited to a product manager who enjoys solving customer problems, using data to identify opportunities, and working across teams to bring ideas to life. You will partner with Engineering, Science, UX, Personalization, Search, Detail Page, Cart, PurchaseX, BuyX, Ads, Vendor Management, Category, Marketing, and BI teams.

You will translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements, prioritize features, coordinate launches, and measure results. You will also help expand successful experiences across categories, marketplaces, and customer surfaces while protecting recommendation relevance, customer trust, and financial performance.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the roadmap for defined High-Consideration Basket Building experiences across Hardlines.
- Identify customer needs and product opportunities using research, business performance, and partner feedback.
- Translate customer problems into clear product requirements and user experiences.
- Prioritize features and category expansions based on customer impact, business opportunity, delivery effort, and operational readiness.
- Partner with Engineering, Science, UX, and business teams throughout product development and delivery.
- Manage the product lifecycle from requirements and experimentation through launch, measurement, and iteration.
- Develop business cases and recommendations for new features, category launches, and customer-surface expansion.
- Define launch criteria, success measures, and customer-experience guardrails.
- Track outcomes such as completed shopping missions, complementary-product attach, contribution profit, recommendation relevance, anchor conversion, and returns.
- Coordinate dependencies and resolve delivery barriers across partner teams.
- Use experiment results, customer feedback, and performance data to improve existing experiences and inform the roadmap.
- Identify opportunities to simplify product setup, launch processes, and the customer experience.
- Communicate product plans, performance, risks, and decisions through written updates and business and technical reviews.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of product management experience
- Experience in product, program, or project management in leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building and analyzing cost/benefit scenarios and business cases and communicating results throughout the organization

title: Electrical BIM Designer, DC Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Are you an experienced Electrical Designer with a passion for BIM? Are you a creative, smart and driven individual that enjoys working with complex projects within a team environment? If this is you, we want YOU on our team!

You will be a part of highly creative and efficient MEP BIM team, tasked with designing challenging and complex projects with innovative solutions for Amazon owned Data Center facilities. You will provide support to our Central Engineering Team through the preparation of Electrical BIM models, construction documents and leveraging BIM data. You will influence Data Center design documents for: One-lines, Switchgear, UPS, Panelboards, Transformers, Power, Lighting, Lighting Control Systems, grounding, Fire Alarm systems, Short Circuit and Arc Flash analysis, Cable tray and Cable pathways for Ethernet and Fiber systems. You will produce, maintain and publish permit Electrical Engineering drawing sets for our fleet of Data Centers.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


Key job responsibilities
Daily responsibilities will include designing the electrical systems of Data Centers, and utilizing Revit to create and maintain BIM models. You must be able to work independently and work within a team environment to accomplish assigned tasks. This includes working with internal groups as well as external suppliers and consultants, manufacturers, vendors, and contractors. Your duties will include:

• Be self-motivated and work within the MEP group as well as within other teams.
• Understanding of electrical engineering calculations and studies, such as short circuit, arc flash analysis.
• Ability to perform voltage drop calculations, raceway and conductor sizing, and grounding system conductor sizing.
• Preparing and developing detailed Revit models of electrical building systems.
• Developing & publishing construction documentation for electrical building systems designs in a fast-paced environment to meet scheduled deliverables.
• Updating and modifying existing models, studies and construction documents as required with coordination of engineering group.
• Assist with creating and maintaining standard regional BIM templates.
• Participate in design coordination meetings with other trades for clash detection and resolution.
• Work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical locations.
• Assist the project team with information exchange processes between internal and external customers.
• Provide coordination support for information requests during construction phases.
• Recording and reporting of key metrics to management.
• Travel to Data Center sites for engineering evaluations and surveys as required. On average, once or twice a year.
• Be positive and always offer creative, out of the box solutions.
• Have fun and work hard!


A day in the life
As a designer, you will collaborate across disciplines and teams to refine data center designs. Your work includes creating detailed models, drawings, specification, prototypes, and updating managers and leaders of changes to the building design. You engage in design discussions, review feedback from peers and collaborators, and adjust designs to ensure our data center solutions meet the highest standards of efficiency and quality.

About the team
Why AWS
o Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
o Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
o We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Tea Culture
o Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
o We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel

title: Sr. Infrastructure TPM, AWS Power Generation Solutions
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

AWS Global Energy is responsible for powering the world's most demanding cloud infrastructure. The team is organized across three verticals: Global Energy Strategy (GES), which leads the development of innovative commercial structures to meet capacity demand and AWS's carbon-free energy commitments; Power Generation Solutions (PGS), the single-threaded owner for AWS power generation and energy engineering — delivering capacity solutions aligned with AWS's availability, reliability, sustainability, and redundancy requirements and managing the production readiness lifecycle of AWS-owned or commissioned generation and storage assets; and Energy Portfolio Operations (EPO), which owns Amazon's global renewable PPA portfolio and AWS CFE supply agreements. Global Energy partners closely with regional data center planning and delivery, global sustainability, and broader Amazon business units on energy procurement and infrastructure needs.

About the Role

As a Senior Technical Program Manager on the PGS leadership team, you will report directly to the Head of Power Generation Solutions and serve as a strategic partner to PGS and Global Energy leadership. This is a dual-scope role: you will own technical program management for one of PGS's power programs, while also driving cross-cutting strategy, controllership, and operational mechanisms for PGS and the broader Global Energy organization.

You will work at the intersection of technical execution and business strategy, partnering with PGS engineering leads, Global Energy Principals, Energy Portfolio Operations, Finance, and senior AWS leadership to ensure our programs are on track, our organization is scaled appropriately, and our strategy is clear and actionable. You'll engage external partners, facilitate senior executive interactions, and serve as a trusted voice for PGS in cross-organizational forums.

This role is right for someone who thrives in ambiguity, thinks big, and can operate with equal fluency in a technical design review and a VP-level strategy session.

About You

You have a track record of delivering complex, ambiguous programs at scale — and doing it with the business acumen and executive presence to bring senior leaders along. You are data-driven but not data-bound; you know when to go deep and when to synthesize. You write clearly, speak directly, and earn trust quickly across organizational boundaries. You utilize AI regularly and have experience driving AI solutions at scale.

You are energized by consequential work. AWS's power strategy is shaping how the world's infrastructure gets built — and this role sits at the center of it.

Basic Qualifications
- Experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization
- Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with senior leadership visibility
- Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to translate data into strategic recommendations
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; experience preparing materials for VP-level audiences

Key job responsibilities
Key Responsibilities

Own technical program management for part of the AWS power program, including pipeline management, milestone tracking, senior leader engagement, and vendor coordination.

Partner with the Head of PGS to develop and maintain a multi-year strategic roadmap for Global Energy, translating long-term priorities into annual execution plans with clear owners and accountability mechanisms.

Lead Global Energy controllership mechanisms, including headcount and resource planning, hiring performance tracking, and operating cadence — ensuring leadership has timely, accurate visibility into organizational health and delivery status.

Develop and manage reporting for senior leadership on program status, strategic initiatives, and organizational metrics; synthesize complex inputs into clear, decision-ready narratives.

Build and maintain trusted relationships with Finance, Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, and partner delivery organizations to ensure Global Energy's full scope of needs is represented in cross-organizational planning.

Drive continuous improvement in Global Energy's operating mechanisms — identifying gaps, proposing solutions, and leading implementation across teams.

Represent PGS and Global Energy in senior forums, including facilitating off-sites, leadership reviews, and partner engagements inside and outside AWS.

Champion a high-performance team culture: model strong judgment, clear communication, and a bias for action.


About the team
The Power Generation Solutions team creates and delivers product and engineering solutions in for power and energy to help advance AWS’ mission to deliver world-leading cloud services. Our solutions are guided by four main principles; unlocking capacity growth, maintaining high infrastructure uptime, minimizing infrastructure costs, and advancing our net-zero carbon Climate Pledge. To deliver these solutions, our team provides technical input to realize a shared vision and strategy with partner teams and provides engineering support across the project or product lifecycle to deliver the solution. We also provide grid analytics and manage and develop models for determining the total energy and water use within our fleet of data centers and work with partners on improving overall performance.

- 4+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

Preferred qualifications

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 17, 2026

Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Controls Deployment & Service (CDS) Engineers to deliver and support data center building automation systems, such as Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). CDS Engineers work to deploy and service building automation systems, to ensure the health of our data centers. As a CDS Engineer, you may oversee deployment of a new BMS or EPMS as part of a new data center build, deliver projects to upgrade an existing data center owned or leased by Amazon, or deliver projects to upgrade colocated data centers with Amazon hardware. As a CDS Engineer, you may also be required to provide local servicing expertise to our fleet or data centers in your region, and occasionally assist with global support. Successfully working as a CDS Engineer will also require you to partner effectively with the many teams at Amazon that make our data center deployments and operations a success, including Construction, Commissioning, Critical Projects, Data Center Operations, Procurement, Program Management, Design, and Engineering teams, as well as maintaining strong relationships with our vendors.

- Deployment of data center controls, on time, with effective management of vendors to ensure minimal defects at the point of Power and Facilities Hand-Off (PFHO)
- Delivery of critical projects to upgrade data center automation
- Service and support provided to partner teams, providing diagnosis and resolution of Loss of Visibility (LOV), Loss of Resilience (LOR), Large Scale Event (LSE), Critical Scale Event (CSE), and other operations impacting events Resolution of tasks within predefined Service Level Agreements (SLAs)

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Environmental Compliance Manager, EU EAP Field
descriptionHtml:
Are you an environmental compliance professional ready to make a measurable impact on the ground at Amazon facilities? As environmental regulations evolve across Europe — including the EU Energy Efficiency Directive being transposed into national law — we are expanding our Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team to keep pace. In this field-based role you will be the on-site environmental compliance expert for the Middle Europe region, covering Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, Czechia, Slovakia, and Austria. You will work directly at facilities to ensure compliance across all environmental media — energy, air emissions, stormwater, waste management, and wastewater discharge — turning regulatory requirements into clear, practical guidance for site teams.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Regional Environmental Leader for Middle Europe. You will work closely with operations leadership and the Workplace Health and Safety organization to embed environmental compliance into daily site operations. As you grow, you can expect to move from hands-on field delivery to leading compliance programs across a broader set of sites and topics, with a clear path toward owning compliance areas across Europe or stepping into a team leadership position.

Key job responsibilities
- Ensure compliance with EU directives and country-specific environmental regulations across energy, air emissions, stormwater, waste management, and wastewater discharge programs at facilities in Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, Czechia, Slovakia, and Austria.
- Conduct on-site environmental risk assessments, identify and prioritize gaps, and develop site-specific mitigation plans using ISO 14001 and ISO 50001 frameworks
- Work with operations leadership and the Workplace Health and Safety organization to integrate environmental compliance requirements into daily workflows and training at each facility
- Interpret and apply EU directives and country-specific regulations, coordinating with Legal on permit applications, regulatory inquiries, and authority submissions
- Build repeatable compliance mechanisms across facilities, track key performance indicators, and report results to internal stakeholders

Operations is at the heart of everything Amazon does, and automation is one of the ways we optimise our processes. As an Automation Engineer, you’ll make sure that our automated systems are working at their best so that our customers get their orders on time. By exploring data on everything from control systems to sensors, you’ll maximise the availability of equipment at your sites. This role puts you at the forefront of Amazon’s emerging technology to solve complex productivity challenges.

As an Automation Engineer, you’ll be the site expert when it comes to keeping key automated systems running smoothly. You’ll be working with our automation machinery, from conveyors to sortation systems, and ensuring they’re working efficiently. If something has gone wrong or can be done better, you’ll take the lead in coming up with and implementing a solution.

You’ll also share your expertise with your close colleagues. You’ll be keeping your Engineering Technicians up to date with device troubleshooting and preventative maintenance control training, so that your team can keep our automation systems in order.

Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. We often work during early or late hours to carry out maintenance with minimal disruption, including night shifts. If we spot a better way to do something, we have the skills and the opportunity to develop and introduce completely new processes or innovative tech like Amazon Robotics and our Complex Item Sorter.

title: Technical Program Manager, AWS Security & Risk Compliance, AWS Security Risk & Compliance
descriptionHtml:
At AWS, Security is priority zero. As part of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Security team, we are looking for a Technical Program Manager who is passionate about how AWS identifies, evaluates, and resolves security compliance risk, and wants to help build the systems that make it possible. The Risk and Compliance Remediation (RCR) team is moving from a reactive remediation function to a proactive, intelligence driven remediation engine that eliminates systemic security compliance risk at its root, before findings reach auditors, customers, or regulators.
You will remediate technical security compliance issues across AWS service teams, working with builder teams to understand the technical gap, evaluate solutions, and negotiate an agreed remediation plan and timeline that closes the issue. You will also own the delivery of cross team technical remediation programs, and you will partner with engineering teams on engagements to improve AWS’s remediation tracking system, the source of truth for every issue. You will gather requirements, drive technical tradeoffs, and deliver improvements to that system and the automation built on it, translating compliance requirements and risk advisory guidance into actionable technical work. You bring a solid understanding of the design approaches and technologies in your program area, spot risks, and ask the right technical questions to make sure the right tradeoffs are made for the customer and for the engineers who build and maintain these systems.


Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:
• Own a program of technical remediations, scoping, planning, and driving delivery across multiple AWS service teams, partnering with engineering teams to secure resources, set milestones, and meet deadlines
• Work technical remediation issues end to end, partnering with security engineers and builder teams to understand the technical gap, evaluate solution options (automation, configuration changes, compensating controls, architectural changes), and negotiate an agreed remediation solution and timeline that closes the compliance issue
• Negotiate remediation priority with engineering leads alongside their roadmap commitments, using data on risk, audit deadlines, and builder cost to reach decisions that hold up with both service teams and auditors
• Own technical remediation campaigns across dozens of AWS service teams from evaluation through close, determining whether the work can be done centrally or automated before launching a campaign, and building the case with data, effort estimates, and clear return on investment
• Serve as theme owner for technically complex root cause themes within RCR's thematic remediation approach, negotiating remediation prioritization with engineering leads and tracking measurable reduction in recurring findings
• Drive away team TPM engagements with engineering teams to enhance the remediation tracking system, owning requirements gathering, writing functional requirements and technical specifications, and representing RCR as the customer in design reviews
• Understand the remediation tracking system's architecture, its upstream and downstream integrations, and data model well enough to spot risks, ask the right technical questions, and make sure dependencies are not broken by changes
• Make and document tradeoffs across time, scope, and cost for both remediation programs and tracking system feature delivery, escalating appropriately when designs are too complex or risky

title: SDEII Specialist GenAI Tooling, Specialist Technology Team (STT), AWS WWSO SA Field Initiatives
descriptionHtml:
You will own major features and services across two connected products that deliver specialist expertise to the AWS field:

- AWS Specialist Agent (ASA) – A production multi-agent system that gives field teams deep technical expertise across all AWS domains on demand. ASA is available in SpecReq, AskAWSentral, Pathfinder, Slack, Kiro, and any MCP or A2A client. It answers routine technical questions directly and escalates complex (L300+) challenges to human specialists with a pre-researched solution packet, so specialists spend their time on the highest-value customer problems.

- Specialist Knowledge Vault (KV) – An AI-first knowledge service that uses purpose-built crawlers to index specialist content from Highspot, YouTube, Broadcast, GitHub, Workshop Studio, Alchemy, and more, which removes manual consolidation. KV lets 46 Technical Field Communities (TFCs) endorse golden content, add agent steering, build reusable playbooks, and flag outdated or incorrect content, so the agent answers with the specialist point of view built in.


This is an AI-first engineering role. As an SDE II, you will design, build, and operate significant parts of the platform on your own. You will solve hard problems in retrieval-augmented generation, multi-agent orchestration, and LLM evaluation at AWS scale, using the AI services AWS builds for its customers. You will also help raise the engineering bar for the team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and scale Knowledge Vault crawlers and ingestion pipelines that bring specialist content from internal and external sources into the vault reliably and at low cost. Make clear trade-offs on freshness, cost, and quality.

- Lead embedding, retrieval, and ranking improvements end to end, from hypothesis and experiment design through evaluation and production rollout. Measure each change against agreed quality metrics.

- Build and maintain evaluation test sets, prompts, and guardrails. Use evaluation results to decide what ships, and help define the quality bar for agent responses.

- Design APIs and MCP/A2A integrations as clean, reusable interfaces that bring ASA and KV into the tools where field teams already work.

- Drive operational excellence for the services you own: define monitoring and alarming, lead incident response during on-call, fix root causes, and run COE and metrics reviews. Leave the software easier to maintain than you found it.

- Work with Product Management, Applied Science, and TFC stakeholders to turn ambiguous field problems into well-scoped projects. Balance customer needs with team priorities.

- Raise the team's bar through thorough code reviews and design reviews. Mentor and onboard SDE Is and new team members, and take part in recruiting and interviewing.

A day in the life
You start the day with a standup, where you share progress, flag risks, and unblock teammates. You spend a focused block building a new retrieval or agent capability that you designed, then review a teammate's code and give feedback that helps them grow. You might set up an evaluation run to confirm that a ranking change improves answer quality before you roll it out, or meet with a product manager and a TFC lead to scope a new field request into a set of tasks. Later you walk the team through your design doc and work through the open trade-offs. On your on-call weeks, you handle alarms, lead the fix for the root cause, and turn what you learn into operational improvements.

About the team
We are engineers, applied scientists, and product managers. Engineers own their services from design through on-call. SDE IIs act as technical owners of major components and help senior engineers set the team's technical direction.

- Meet customers where they work.

title: Sr. Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, Data Center Planning & Delivery, AWS DC Acquisition & Construction
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of technical program managers, design engineers, construction managers, network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We're seeking an experienced Sr. Technical Infrastructure Program Manager to own infrastructure delivery for the network and logical scope of our ML/AI data center builds. This is an infrastructure role with a heavy network focus. You'll assist and advise across multiple locations at once, and serve as the subject matter expert on the network and logical side of the process so infrastructure deliveries account for it. You'll own the physical foundation network capacity lands on: space, power, rack positioning, and deployment readiness. You'll work closely with the Network TPMs and engineering teams who own network design and delivery, making sure their plans can actually land, on time and to spec.

To do that well, you'll need more network fluency than a typical infrastructure PM. That means understanding topology, scaling, and rack requirements well enough to turn network intent into infrastructure plans and to question assumptions in both directions. You don't need to own the network yourself. When five teams are pointing at each other, you find where the chain is broken and get the program moving again. When a declared blocker doesn't hold up, you test it and push back with data. When an issue shows up at one site, you assume it's coming at others, get ahead of it, and write it down so the next build doesn't hit the same wall.

The successful candidate is a strong written and verbal communicator who adjusts the depth and framing of an answer to who's asking and why. They aren't slowed down by ambiguity or competing priorities, and they're comfortable working across many builds at different phases at the same time.

Key job responsibilities
- Own infrastructure readiness for network and logical scope across concurrent new-region and expansion builds
- Turn network requirements (topology, rack BOMs, power data) into site-specific space and power plans
- Act as the infrastructure counterpart to Network TPMs: line up network schedules with site delivery, and surface physical constraints early
- Map dependencies across construction, fiber, capacity planning, logistics, and deployment teams; build and drive schedules down to critical-path detail
- Cross-check outputs from multiple planning and tracking systems, find gaps in upstream data, and drive corrections

title: Electrical Engineer, HW Sustaining
descriptionHtml:
As a Sustaining Electrical Engineer, you will be the electrical technical owner for multiple Amazon device programs from mass production through end of life. You will lead the investigation and resolution of major hardware quality issues reported by customers, drive related hardware design changes, qualify alternate hardware components, spearhead cost-reduction engineering initiatives, and lead hardware failure analyses that significantly impact manufacturing yield. Each decision weighs electrical risk against cost, schedule and customer impact. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will set the technical bar across a broad portfolio, make data-driven calls when requirements are ambiguous, and influence US-based design teams and manufacturing partners without direct authority.

This role requires approximately 30% travel to ODM/CM partner sites across Greater China.

Key job responsibilities
• Own electrical sustaining engineering for multiple programs across the Echo, Fire TV, eReader and Tablet portfolios
• Lead electrical evaluation and qualification of alternate / second-source components (memory, PMIC, DC/DC, passives, connectors), defining validation plans and sign-off criteria
• Assess supplier PCN / EOL notifications (e.g., fab transfer, die revision, process change) for electrical risk, and drive qualification or last-time-buy decisions
• Identify and drive cost-reduction engineering changes, balancing BOM savings against electrical risk and validation effort
• Drive root cause and corrective action on mass-production yield issues and field returns through failure analysis and bench debug
• Provide engineering validation for factory and line transfers, ensuring electrical conformance at the new site
• Develop and execute electrical validation test plans to ensure functional and parametric conformance, and report status at milestone gates
• Raise the technical bar across the team by setting validation standards, reviewing peers' analyses, and mentoring junior electrical engineers
• Use AI tools and write scripts to automate validation, data analysis and reporting where feasible

About the team
Amazon Devices Sustaining Engineering owns Amazon's consumer electronics after launch, covering Echo, Fire TV, eReader and Tablet products. Our job is to keep these products high quality, cost-competitive and supply-resilient for their whole production life. descriptionHtml:

Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.

descriptionHtml:

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シフトアシスタントとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、より便利でお客様に満足いただける高い品質のサービスを提供できるビジネスをつくる事、安全・快適・楽しい職場環境の構築を行う、将来の組織のリーダーを目指していただける事を期待しています。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

本ポジションはアマゾンの新しいエキサイティングな配送拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商
品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！


■業務内容■
具体的にはマネージャーのサポートのもと、以下の業務に責任をもち遂行いただきます。

① 安全・品質・作業効率の向上
安全安心な作業環境の維持・向上のため、日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、標準作業手順書の作成や多岐にわたる問題解決・改善活動を行います。

② 日々のオペレーション対応
商品を入荷、在庫として管理し、注文があった商品を出荷するという一連の流れを各工程間で連携をとりながら、業務を円滑に進める事が求められます。お客様とお約束した期日までに商品を迅速かつ正確にお届けするため、時間ごとの計画に沿ってオペレーションを実施することに責任を持ちます。

③ 新規プロジェクトの導入・セール時など、オペレーション拡大時の準備
新しいサービスやシステムの導入に備え、現場での手順変更・導入方法を検討し円滑な導入に向けて準備を行います。また、新規入職者でもAmazonの標準作業に則った手順がスムーズに身につくためのトレーニング構築やマニュアルを作成します。

④ イレギュラーへの対応
作業で発生する様々な課題の原因を追求し問題解決を行います。また、再発防止策案の検討、実施を行います。

※社内公募により、マネージャーへのキャリアアップや他部署への異動機会もあります
※勤務は交代制（夜勤あり）です

入社後、約1週間はAmazonのリーダーとして必要な会社のカルチャーや、配送拠点の基本的な業務を一通り学ぶことができる座学の機会を提供します。各部署へ配属後は、トレーナーのもと、OJTで工程知識やツールの使用方法など基礎知識を学んでいきます。トレーニング資料も完備しており、相互に進捗を確認しながら独り立ちまでしっかりとサポートしますので、未経験者も安心してスタートができる環境です。

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a pioneer in blazing new trails of cloud computing. We are a high-growth, fast-moving group within Amazon where new and diverse challenges arise every day. At AWS, you will be surrounded by business partners who are exceptionally talented, bright, and driven who believe that world-class support is critical to customer success.

The AWS Finance team supporting the GCR Sales, Marketing, and Support is looking for an experienced Finance Manager/Senior Financial Analyst to join our team. This role will partner specifically with Sales, Marketing, and Support Leadership and the Sales Operations team. This is a position with huge potential for growth as we develop scalable processes to optimize investments in the rapidly expanding GCR region.

This is a cross-functional business partnering role, so the ideal candidate will have strong communication, cooperation and prioritization skills. This candidate will be a insightful business partner who dives deep in data, builds intuitive models, and prioritizes areas of focus to fuel long-term growth.

This role will be based in Beijing.

Key job responsibilities
1. Develop, iterate, and automate insightful reports and summaries to drive long-term profitable growth and productivity increases.
2. Navigate multiple systems to dive deep and triangulate revenue, headcount, productivity, OpEx, and investment growth.
3. Develop scalable processes to support short and long-term headcount coverage expansion
4. Work with WW AWS Finance team to support annual planning (OP1/OP2) and support GCR business planning process.
5. Ad hoc cross-functional analysis;

title: Automation Engineering Apprentice - West Midlands (48-month fixed term contract)
descriptionHtml:
Ever wondered what it's like to orchestrate a symphony of robots? Picture yourself at the controls of one of the world's most sophisticated automated networks - where thousands of robots work in perfect harmony, artificial intelligence makes split-second decisions, and breakthrough technology comes to life. This isn't science fiction. This is Amazon, and it could be your everyday workspace as an Automation Apprentice.

Our fulfilment centres are like living, breathing cities of automation: hundreds of autonomous robots collaborating to fulfil customer orders, AI and machine-learning systems making real-time decisions, conveyor systems spanning miles, robotic arms handling packages with incredible precision, and automated storage and retrieval systems redefining what efficiency looks like. As an Automation Apprentice within our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team, you'll be hands-on with technology most people only read about, working alongside industry pioneers. This isn't just maintenance - it's being part of a team that innovates, improves, and reimagines automation technology every single day, with the chance to see your own ideas come to life in real-world applications.

Are you the person who took things apart to see how they worked? Maybe you built a PC, fixed everyone's tech, loved robotics club or Lego Technic, tinkered with a car or bike, or found physics, electronics or design and technology just clicked. Or maybe you've spent a few years in a hands-on role and want to step up into cutting-edge automation. You don't need to be an engineer already - what matters is curiosity about how things work, a logical, problem-solving mind, and the patience to figure out why something's gone wrong and put it right. If that sounds like you, this could be the start of something extraordinary.

A day in the life can involve:
- Supporting maintenance and fault-finding on automated systems and robotics
- Using diagnostic tools to keep conveyors and sortation equipment running smoothly
- Planning preventative maintenance and safety checks
- Collaborating with engineers to develop new process improvements and energy-efficient solutions

Throughout your apprenticeship, you'll gain both theoretical knowledge and hands-on experience across:
- Advanced robotics systems, controls, and industrial automation programming
- Smart sensor technology and IoT integration
- Predictive maintenance and performance optimisation through data analytics
- Safety systems for human-robot collaboration
- Machine learning applications and wider Industry 4.0 technologies

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship, you'll learn by doing, putting newfound knowledge into practice every day. Our first-class coaching, tailored development opportunities, and challenging, rewarding work will empower you to reach new heights. If you're a curious learner eager to grow, this is your chance to unlock your full potential and build the future you envision.

Within this 48-month programme, you'll work towards the Level 6 Control Technical Support Apprenticeship, combining practical, on-the-job experience with industry-recognised study. Your first 12 months will be a full-time residential programme, based either at one of our external training provider facilities or at our own world-class Amazon training centres - reflecting our significant investment in developing state-of-the-art facilities for the next generation of engineers. If you live outside a commutable distance, accommodation will be provided during term time for these first 12 months, and travel expenses will be supported. In later years, your on-the-job training will work towards a BSc in Controls and Automation Engineering and an HNC/D in Electrical/Controls Engineering.

This role supports our 24/7 operation, so you'll work shifts covering days, nights and weekends - patterns that reflect the real-world schedules of the engineers who keep Amazon operating around the clock.

You'll join a diverse and passionate team of engineers dedicated to driving results and pushing creative boundaries. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups - including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employees, and underrepresented minorities - foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. These groups provide community, mentorship, and a platform for your voice to be heard. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a well-rounded professional.

The robots are waiting - are you ready to take control? Turn your passion for technology into an extraordinary career at the forefront of engineering innovation. Apply now and be part of the team writing the future of automation.

Basic qualifications

- To qualify for this programme, you must:
- Be 18 years or over before the start date (September 2027)
- Have the right to live and work in England at the point of enrolment (June 2027). If you are on a visa, this must enable you to legally work and reside in England for the entire duration of the programme from enrolment.
- Have lived in the UK or in the European Economic Area (EEA) for the last 3 years prior to the start date
- Not be registered to study on a UK government funded course ending August 2027 or later
- Be prepared to travel for external/mandatory training as part of the apprenticeship
- 5 GCSEs at grade 4-9 (A-C) or above (or equivalent) including Maths and English.
- Three A levels (or equivalent) at C (grade 4) or above in either Mathematics, IT, Physics, or an Engineering related subject, OR have completed a BTEC level 3 engineering qualification of 180 credits which must include further mathematics
- Please note, if you have received educational qualifications outside of the UK then we will require a Statement of Comparability to confirm your eligibility for the scheme. Please ensure you obtain one during the application process, through UK ENIC: https://www.enic.org.uk/
- Previous qualifications will be reviewed for funding eligibility and offers are subject to funding approval
- PLEASE NOTE: This position is a 48 month fixed-term contract. You must NOT already have a qualification in a similar subject at the same or higher level than this apprenticeship.
- This Apprenticeship assumes the candidate has some or little knowledge/experience of the occupation

Preferred qualifications

- A genuine interest in robotics, automation or engineering - whether that's through a hobby, a project, a club, or simply a habit of taking things apart to understand how they work
- A foundation in a STEM subject such as physics, electronics, design and technology, maths or computing (through school, college, self-study or a previous role)
- Confidence with basic diagnostic or problem-solving approaches - the instinct to work out why something has gone wrong, not just that it has
- Familiarity with digital tools, coding or programming concepts, or a willingness to build these skills
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across a busy, fast-paced operation
- A safety-first mindset and the reliability to work shift patterns, including days, nights and weekends
