title: RME Mechatronics Apprentice – West Midlands Locations (36-month fixed term contract)
descriptionHtml:
Fascinated by the mechanics behind automated systems? Want to master both electrical and mechanical engineering while working with cutting-edge technology? Amazon is the perfect place to launch your career in Mechatronics Maintenance.

As one of the world's most advanced technology-driven companies, we're powered by automation, robotics, and continuous innovation - from robotic arms to complex conveyor networks and smart sensor technology that keep millions of customer orders moving. This apprenticeship gives you the chance to become a multi-skilled maintenance technician across both electrical and mechanical disciplines, with hands-on experience on industry-leading equipment, some of which only exists at Amazon.

Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team is fundamental to our operations - they keep vital machinery running around the clock. As an RME Mechatronics Apprentice, you'll help maintain a wide range of equipment while upholding Health and Safety best practice, keeping your colleagues safe, preventing downtime, and improving the availability and quality of our equipment.

You'll thrive here if you stay calm when things go wrong and get a real kick out of fixing them. You're hands-on, curious about how machines work, and you understand that keeping production moving is what it's all about. And you don't need to be a qualified engineer to start - what matters most is a practical, problem-solving mindset and a hunger to learn.

A day in the life can involve:

- Carrying out proactive and preventative maintenance
- Carrying out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse
- Using the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness
- Making modifications and upgrades to existing equipment
- Upholding health and safety policies and practices
- Working on continuous improvement projects, and suggesting long-term improvements

Throughout your apprenticeship, you'll build a broad, in-demand engineering skillset, including:

- Fault diagnosis and preventative maintenance
- Mechanical device maintenance, and fluid power systems assembly and testing
- Electrical equipment wiring and testing
- Hydraulics and pneumatics
- Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) operations
- CAD design and 3D printing

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship, you'll learn by doing, putting newfound knowledge into practice every day. Our first-class coaching, tailored development opportunities, and challenging, rewarding work will empower you to reach new heights. If you're a curious learner eager to grow, this is your chance to unlock your full potential and build the future you envision.

Throughout the apprenticeship you'll work towards an Advanced Apprenticeship in Engineering (Mechatronics Maintenance), combining practical, on-the-job experience with industry-recognised study. Your first 12 months will be a full-time residential programme, based either at one of our external training provider facilities or at our own world-class Amazon training centres - reflecting our significant investment in developing state-of-the-art facilities for the next generation of engineers. If you live outside a commutable distance, accommodation will be provided during term time for these first 12 months, and travel expenses will be supported.

Please note: some of our training sites aren't accessible by public transport, so you'll need to be able to arrange reliable travel to and from site. Access to a car can make this easier but isn't essential.

In later years, you'll combine day or block-release study for your qualification in Engineering or Mechatronics with on-the-job training at one of our Fulfilment Centres, Sortation Centres, or Delivery Stations, learning directly from experienced technicians and engineers and gaining exposure to real engineering projects.

This role supports our 24/7 operation, so you'll work shifts covering days, nights and weekends - patterns that reflect the real-world schedules of the engineers who keep Amazon operating around the clock.

This apprenticeship trains you for a variety of maintenance roles - mechatronic maintenance technician, maintenance engineer, mechanical fitter, and electrical engineer - with plenty of opportunities for progression both within RME and more widely across Amazon. This could be the start of an exciting and rewarding career.

You'll join a diverse and passionate team of engineers dedicated to driving results and pushing creative boundaries. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups - including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employees, and underrepresented minorities - foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. These groups provide community, mentorship, and a platform for your voice to be heard. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a well-rounded professional.

Join us and be part of the team that keeps Amazon moving. Apply now and shape the future of technology with us.

As part of the recruitment and enrolment process for this apprenticeship, candidates must provide proof of all required qualifications. Original certificates or certified copies must be submitted - this is a mandatory requirement to secure the position. The deadline for providing qualification certificates for the RME Mechatronics programme is 16 July 2027. Applications without verified qualifications by this date will automatically be unsuccessful, and failure to provide proof by the deadline will result in the withdrawal of any conditional offer, meaning you will not be able to commence the programme. Previous qualifications will be reviewed for funding eligibility, and offers may be withdrawn for applicants who do not meet the funding criteria.

- Not be registered to study on a UK government funded course ending August 2027 or later

- Have a minimum of 3 GCSEs at Grade 4 (C) or above (or equivalent), including Maths, English, and a Science or Technology subject.

- A practical, hands-on approach and enjoyment of taking things apart to understand and fix them

- Good attention to detail and an awareness of health and safety

title: Associate Corporate Counsel, Amazon Leo (Satellites / Communications)
descriptionHtml:

We are looking for a talented lawyer to join the Amazon Legal team supporting Amazon Leo. You will be embedded with the Leo business, with a focus on supporting commercial customer and partner deals across EMEA.

We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic about technology, enjoys being continually challenged, and demonstrates sound judgment even in ambiguous situations.

Legal support will include structuring, drafting, and negotiating a range of agreements (e.g., agreements to sell services and customer terminals), and counseling the business team on legal issues related to Leo’s customer and partner contracts. The successful candidate will develop strategies for handling legal issues in creative, business-centric ways and build processes that address risk and allow the business flexibility and freedom to move quickly.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end-to-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes.

FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. They design cohesive implementations for well-understood problems, making design trade-offs with appropriate guidance. They take on projects where the business problem is understood but implementations are not fully fleshed out, balancing constraints and limiting short-term workarounds. They coach others on producing high-quality code and train new team members.


Key job responsibilities
• Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30 – 50% travel.
• Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.
• Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations.
• Mentor and uplift. Actively mentors and trains new team members on how systems are constructed, operated, and fit into the bigger picture. Coach others on producing high-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others.
• Accelerate customer adoption. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption within your customer engagement. Codify reusable patterns and accelerators that benefit future customer deployments and feed back into AWS services. Make enhancements that improve your team's software and processes.


About the team
ABOUT AWS:
 
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
 
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. 

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- 2+ years of experience working in an Agile, startup, or rapidly scaling environment
- Experience communicating technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Experience with agentic and spec-driven development (developing AI agents a plus)
- Experience with AI tools: eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering

title: Program Security Officer, US ADC Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security team is looking for a Program Security Officer to run the facility program-security operations for a U.S. Government program building a classified AI Factory. We are a hands-on team that keeps cleared people safe, badged, and productive. In this role you administer indoctrinations, debriefings, and non-disclosure execution, manage badging, access determinations, and visit certifications, maintain the access rosters and program-security records, and support incident inquiries and reporting to our Government counterparts. You will work daily with personnel security, physical security, and the CPSO to keep the program's security posture tight and its people mission-ready. If you like being the trusted operator at the center of a classified program, this role is for you.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
• Administer indoctrinations, debriefings, and NDA execution for cleared personnel.
• Manage badging, access determinations, and visit certifications for the facility.
• Maintain access rosters and program-security records and support self-inspections.
• Support incident inquiries and reporting to the Government PSO.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- 3+ years of program or personnel security experience.
- Knowledge of the NISPOM, ICD 704, and SCI program-security requirements.
- Experience with badging/access and security recordkeeping.
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of TS/SCI with Polygraph

Preferred qualifications

- Experience as a PSO on an U.S. Government/IC program.
- Familiarity with the NSCM and ND 100-series.

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Amazon, Selection Monitoring
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Selection Monitoring team is responsible for making the biggest catalog on the planet even bigger. Our systems process billions of products to algorithmically find products not already sold on Amazon and programmatically add them to the Amazon catalog. We apply parallel processing, machine learning and deep learning algorithms to evaluate products and brands in order to identify and prioritize products and brands to be added to Amazon’s catalog. The datasets produced by our team are used by teams across Amazon to improve: product information, search and discoverability, pricing, and delivery experience. Our work involves building state-of-the-art Information Retrieval (IR) systems to mine the web and automatically create structured entities from un-structure/semi-structured data. We constantly stretch the boundaries of large scale distributed systems, Elastic Computing, Big Data, and SOA technologies to tackle challenges at Amazon’s global scale.

Come join us in our journey to make everything – and yes, we do mean *everything* – that anyone wants to buy, available on Amazon!

We are looking for SDEs with strong technical knowledge, established background in engineering large scale software systems, and passion for solving challenging problems. The role demands a high-performing and flexible candidate who can take responsibility for success of the system and drive solutions from design to coding, testing, and deployment, to achieve results in a fast paced environment.

Key job responsibilities
Work with senior Engineers to drive the technical and architectural vision of Selection Monitoring’s External E-commerce source discovery and enrichment.

Design, build and launch scalable, fault-tolerant, and highly available services and AI Agents that can solve complex problems in entity resolution, deduplication, classification, enrichments and 3rd party data integrations to automatically discovery, catalog, and refresh meta information and signals for millions of eCommerce websites worldwide.

Build and launch efficient storage solutions for managing large-scale datasets, ensuring optimal performance for both write-heavy ingestion and read-heavy analytical workloads.

Lead and mentor junior engineers, drive best practices around system design, coding standards, testability, operational excellence, and security for GenAI-integrated systems.

Drive operational excellence initiatives and continuously improve quality bar for software delivered by the team.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: サイトメンテナンスシニアテクニシャン
descriptionHtml:
このポジションの勤務地は、名古屋市中村区のデリバリーステーションです。

アマゾンジャパンでは、全国で25拠点以上のフルフィルメントセンター（FC）、51拠点以上のデリバリーステーション（DS）が稼働し、数千の機械、数万の従業員が、正しい商品を正しい人、正しい場所、正しい時間に届けるために、調和を保ちながら働いています。私たちReliability & Maintenance Engineering – Maintenance (RME-M) は、グローバルなAmazonの倉庫・デリバリーネットワークの技術を維持し、最適化しています。
　
JCFS (Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions) とは、AmazonのFulfillment Solutionを追求するオペレーション技術統括本部です。アマゾンジャパンオペレーション業務の中核部門としてオペレーションの各部門を効率的に連携することでお客様に貢献します。JCFS RME-Mは、全国に展開されているAmazonサイトにおける物流設備の保全・保守・改善を行い、お客様に満足いただけるように努めています。DSは、FCから出荷された商品を配送する地域ごとに仕分けをする、お客様に最も近い配送拠点です。
　
今回募集する職種であるサイトメンテナンスシニアテクニシャンは、DSに導入される物流設備の保全と保守、および設備の安全性や生産性を向上させるための改善を担当いただくポジションです。
　
サイトメンテナンスシニアテクニシャンの具体的な業務は以下となります。
１．DSに導入されている物流設備の保全作業
２．物流設備で発生したエラーや故障などに対応する保守作業
３．物流設備の安全性、生産性、稼働率等を向上させるための改善作業
４．新規に開発された各種設備・装置の稼働状態の監視と開発担当へのフィードバック
５．上記１～３に必要な整備用具の管理
６．上記の作業とDSでのオペレーションを安全に行うための施策の実施
　
これらの業務を確実に実行することによりDSにおけるオペレーションをサポートし、Amazonの発展に貢献していただきます。

■マテハン設備（一般的な搬送ローラーコンベア）
■オートソーター設備（商品を搬送しながら自動で仕分けし搬出するコンベア）

title: サイトメンテナンスシニアテクニシャン
descriptionHtml:
このポジションの勤務地は、神奈川県川崎市にある物流拠点（フルフィルメントセンター）になります。

Amazonの入荷・出荷のプロセスを行うFCには、世界最先端の自動化物流設備が導入されています。コンベア、ロボット、自動仕分けシステムなど、最新テクノロジーを活用し、商品の入出荷を効率的に行っています。このような先進的な環境で、次世代の物流技術に携わることができます。

RME（Reliability and Maintenance Engineering）部門は、日々物流設備の保全と保守、改善を行い、お客様に満足いただけるように努めております。 今回、RME部門が募集する職種はFCに導入されている物流設備の保全と保守、および設備の安全性や生産性を向上させるための改善を担当いただく「サイトメンテナンスシニアテクニシャン」というポジションになります。

本ポジションは物流設備の保全経験者だけでなく、異業界・異職種からのキャリアチェンジをお考えの方も広く募集しています。これまでのエンジニアとしての経験を活かしながら、次のステージへと成長できる環境をご用意しております。入社後は体系的な教育プログラムに加え、豊富な経験を持つ先輩社員によるさぽーとにより、確かな技術力と自信を着実に身につけていただけます。

RMEにて技術力と現場感を身に着けることで将来的なキャリア選択肢は大きく広がります。マネジメント職や技術スペシャリストへのキャリアアップはもちろん、社内公募制度を通じて設備導入、設計、開発など、幅広いフィールドでの活躍も可能です。

【More Information】
■メンテナンス部門について
　・メンテナンスエンジニア特設サイト
　・社員インタビュー/堺FC勤務の社員T.S.さん
　・社員インタビュー/堺FC勤務の社員E.M.さん
■勤務地について
　・フルフィルメントセンター (FC)
　・勤務地：川崎FC

Amazon は多様かつインクルーシブな職場づくりを目指しています。Amazonは男女雇用機会均等法を順守しています。人種、 出身国、性別、性的指向、障がい、年齢、その他の属性によって差別することなく、平等に採用選考の機会を提供しています。障がいをお持ちの方は、以下をご覧ください。https://www.amazon.jobs/disability/jp
オペレーション部門のDEIの取り組み

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。

Key job responsibilities
【具体的な業務内容】
下記業務をチームで対応いただきます。
■60%：日常点検・異常対応…稼働監視/巡回による設備点検/異常対応、故障復旧/オーバーホール、部品修繕
■20%：メンテナンス業務…予防保全/定期保全/状態保全/事後保全
■10%：安全対策…設備・作業環境の安全対策/5S活動
■5%：カイゼン活動…機械、電気、制御（PLC）と広い範囲でカイゼンや改造を実施
■5%：その他…メンテナンス計画/デザインレビュー
　
【取り扱う設備の一例（FCによって異なる）】
■Amazon Robotics（商品棚を持ち上げて移動させるロボット）
■荷合わせシステム（同じお客様が注文された商品を一つにまとめる設備）
■パッキング設備（荷合わせした商品をまとめて梱包する設備）
■仕分け設備（宛先ラベルの印刷と貼り付けを行い、配送方面毎に仕分けを行う設備）

A day in the life
【教育・研修】
・入社後は、体系化された教育プログラムに沿って、安全ルール、保全作業、専門的な技術習得（機械・電気・制御）を進めていただきます。同時に所属拠点ではOJTを通して実務を習得いただきます。まずは物流設備の軽微なエラー対応や保全・保守の補佐業務を担当いただき、バディー制度により先輩社員がサポートをいたしますので、不明点の確認や相談がしやすい環境となります。その後は今までのキャリアの中で培ってきたスキルを応用し、改善や安全対策、効率化施策を手掛けることで幅広い領域で活かしていただくことができます。
　
【働き方】
本ポジションは、シフト勤務になり「3交代・早番専属・夜勤専属」のシフトパターンがあります。
シフトパターンは希望を考慮の上、決定させていただきますが、将来的なシフト勤務形態の変更の可能性もございます。
＜シフト例＞※シフトは拠点によって異なります。
　・3交代 　6:00-15:00, 14:30-23:30, 23:00-8:00
　・早番専属　6:00-15:00
　・夜勤専属　23:00-8:00
シフトは1か月以上前に事前に周知される為、休暇の計画が立てやすく、チームで調整することで休暇が取得しやすい環境です。
退勤時間には次の班が出勤し引継ぎを行う為、残業時間が少なく、急な呼び出しも発生しません。
公共交通機関が運行しない時間帯でも交代勤務に出社できるようお願いいたします。
（自家用車・自転車は可（入社前に要申請・許可制）、バイク・タクシーは不可）

Basic qualifications

- 機械や電気機器の保全や保守、または生産技術・設備導入や立ち上げを1年以上ご経験された方
- PCを使用した作業のご経験のある方。（エクセル、ワード、Outlook）
- ビジネスレベルの日本語力（メールの読み書き、報告、連絡、相談ができる）

Preferred qualifications

- 物流設備の保守保全、もしくはフィールドエンジニアの経験
- 機械部品の取扱経験・知識（モーター・エアシリンダー・動力伝達機構・バルブなど）
- 電気部品の取扱経験・知識（インバーター・光学センサー・BCR・温度センサーなど）
- 制御機器の取扱経験・知識（PLC・サーボアンプ・タッチパネル・調節計など）
- 機械工学、もしくは電気工学の基礎知識 （工業高校または専門学校卒業程度）
- 労働安全衛生基礎知識　（製造工場・生産設備での安全知識）
- 英語でのコミュニケーション能力
- オーナーシップ：自ら課題を見つけ、責任を持って解決できる。
- 探究心と向上心：いままで経験がない業務においても新しい知識を学ぶことに意欲的で、何事にも前向きに取組むことができる。
- チームワーク：リスペクトを持ってメンバーと協働でき、報連相ができる。
- 機敏性と柔軟性：変化する状況や環境に機敏、且つ柔軟に対応できる。

title: Sr. Program Manager, Global Engineering Services, Startup
descriptionHtml:
Pourquoi Amazon ? Amazon a été désigné comme l'un des meilleurs lieux de travail dans le Corporate Equality Index de la Human Rights Campaign et dans le classement Top Companies de LinkedIn ; a été reconnu dans le Equity, Inclusion, and Empowerment Index de la NAACP ainsi que dans le Disability Equality Index ; et a reçu le 2019 American Foundation for the Blind Helen Keller Achievement Award. Découvrez davantage de nos récompenses et distinctions ici. La culture d'inclusion d'Amazon est renforcée par nos 16 Principes de Leadership, qui rappellent aux membres de l'équipe de rechercher des perspectives diverses, d'apprendre et de faire preuve de curiosité, et de gagner la confiance. Le poste Souhaitez-vous rejoindre une équipe où vous gérerez l'expansion, l'aménagement et le lancement des opérations de Centres de Distribution (FC) à la pointe de la technologie, qui sont à la base du succès d'Amazon et soutiennent nos clients dans un environnement dynamique et en pleine croissance ?

Avec, en prime, la possibilité de voyager et de travailler dans plusieurs pays et cultures ? Le poste peut être basé n'importe où dans l'UE, avec 50 % du temps consacré à des déplacements liés aux projets, que ce soit au niveau national ou vers d'autres pays de la région EMEA.

En tant que Responsable de Programme Senior expérimenté(e), vous êtes chargé(e) de veiller à ce que les FC soient construits dans les délais et dans le respect du budget, en coordonnant le travail de différentes équipes et parties prenantes. Vous soutiendrez l'expansion continue du réseau de distribution européen d'Amazon, serez responsable de la réussite globale des projets en dirigeant et en influençant des équipes de partenaires commerciaux et de parties prenantes techniques au sein d'une organisation matricielle pour l'exécution des projets sur site. De plus, vous piloterez la stratégie commerciale à long terme grâce à la standardisation au sein de notre réseau. Les candidat(e)s retenu(e)s seront naturellement proactifs/proactives, disposeront de bases solides en Gestion de Projet et auront de l'expérience dans la gestion de grands projets avec des calendriers accélérés. Vous êtes capable de diriger et d'encadrer des ingénieurs de projet, des spécialistes techniques et des chefs de projet dans la coordination des risques et des opportunités en termes de délais, de coûts et de qualité. Vous appréciez d'interagir avec, de piloter et de soutenir à la fois des équipes transverses, des experts du domaine et des individus à tous les niveaux, aussi bien à l'intérieur qu'à l'extérieur des lignes hiérarchiques de l'organisation.


Key job responsibilities
• Gérer des projets CAPEX au sein d'une organisation pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle pour nos opérations de distribution clients
• Prise en charge de bout en bout des livrables des projets d'entrepôt
• Planification intégrée des projets, planification des ressources, analyse du chemin critique et optimisation du calendrier de l'ensemble des activités commerciales, techniques, financières et programmatiques sur plusieurs projets
• À l'aise dans différents rôles et capable de communiquer et de travailler efficacement avec des experts en Construction, Ingénierie, Opérations, Finance, Achats, Transport ou Droit des contrats
• Coordonner de multiples calendriers interdépendants de flux de matériaux et d'installation des fournisseurs
• Travailler aux côtés des fournisseurs et des services achats pour gérer les bons de commande
• Maintenir une cadence régulière avec les équipes internes et les fournisseurs pour planifier et suivre les livrables
• Suivi et communication continus de l'état d'avancement des projets, remontée ciblée et opportune des risques et problèmes potentiels auprès de plusieurs équipes et des parties prenantes du projet
• Travailler de manière indépendante et autonome dans un environnement dynamique et en évolution rapide





A day in the life
Vous planifierez et exécuterez le business case qui permet de livrer des centres de distribution opérationnels. Votre journée pourrait inclure des échanges avec tous les niveaux de l'organisation pour convenir d'une stratégie, vous rendre sur le site et prendre en charge son développement, d'un terrain nu (greenfield) jusqu'à un FC pleinement fonctionnel, planifier et gérer les ressources pour exécuter les activités que vous aurez détaillées dans un calendrier de bout en bout. Vous prendrez des décisions au nom de l'entreprise et verrez leurs résultats se concrétiser grâce à la coordination des parties prenantes, internes comme externes, pour enfin célébrer le lancement réussi de l'installation… le Jour Un pour nous tous !

About the team
L'équipe EU Startup est composée d'un groupe talentueux de chefs de projet et de programme qui pilotent la coordination de toutes les activités nécessaires à la construction, en toute sécurité, de FC hautement complexes conformes aux standards du réseau sur l'ensemble du marché de l'UE. Notre équipe accorde une grande importance à l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée et nous nous consacrons au développement et au soutien de nos nouveaux membres. Cela permet aux Chefs de Projet/Programme de respecter des délais exigeants et des budgets frugaux pour livrer rapidement des projets de construction neuve, d'expansion et de rénovation découlant des besoins en capacité, en stock, en automatisation et en durabilité, afin d'améliorer l'expérience client, de réduire les coûts et d'optimiser le réseau de distribution d'Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Diplôme de licence (Bachelor) en management, administration des affaires, économie, ingénierie ou marketing
- Expérience de travail transverse avec des équipes techniques et non techniques
- Expérience en gestion de comptes, gestion de projet/programme ou achats
- Expérience dans l'élaboration et la mise en œuvre de standards, de politiques et de programmes, ou équivalent
- Expérience de la prise en charge de la stratégie de programme, de la livraison de bout en bout et de la communication des résultats à la direction senior
- Parler, écrire et lire couramment l'anglais au niveau C1 ou supérieur
- Management, coaching et développement de managers, d'équipes et de ressources de projet
- Gestion de projets d'infrastructure
- Maîtrise des produits Microsoft Office : Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint et MS Project
- Expérience de base avec un logiciel de CAO (par ex. AutoCAD, Solid Works ou autre)

Preferred qualifications

- Expérience de la communication avec un large éventail de parties prenantes, y compris des collègues et la direction, ou expérience de la gestion d'équipes
- Expérience de la réalisation de tâches complexes rapidement avec peu ou pas d'accompagnement et capacité à réagir avec l'urgence appropriée aux situations nécessitant un traitement rapide, ou expérience de la gestion d'équipes
- Expérience dans un environnement logistique/opérationnel
- Certification Project Management Professional (PMP) ou équivalente
- Expérience dans des tâches ou environnements commerciaux, ou expérience avec les produits et applications Microsoft Office
- Parler, écrire et lire couramment le français et l'anglais au niveau C1 ou supérieur
- Expérience dans l'e-commerce, le retail ou la publicité,

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Area Manager, Sort Center
descriptionHtml:
このポジションの勤務地は、東京都品川区八潮にある物流拠点です。

Amazonでは、地球上で最もお客様を大事にする企業になることを目指しています。これに向けてモチベーションにあふれ、聡明かつ実行力の高い人材が必要となります。Amazonの著しい成長を支えているのが、自社で保有している高品質な輸送ネットワークです。将来の物流業界の変化及び貨物量の増加を見据え、慣習に捉われない新たな輸送網・サービスを構築しています。

その輸送ネットワーク上の重要拠点であるソートセンター(SC)の工程管理・運営管理を担う、エネルギッシュで情熱にあふれた シニア工程管理マネジャー（Sr. Area Manager）を募集いたします。

※ソートセンターとは
アマゾンの自社輸送網において、全国にある大規模倉庫（FC）と、お荷物の最終集約地である配送拠点（DS）の中継地となる拠点です。お客様への配送スピードを担保しながらより効率的に輸送できるよう、荷物の仕分けを行っています。

title: Architecte Solutions, Media & Entertainment
descriptionHtml:
Nous recherchons des Architectes Solutions pour accompagner les clients français d’Amazon Web Services (AWS) dans le secteur des media et du divertissement (Media, Gaming, Sport, AdTech). Alliant connaissance métier, compréhension technique, et capacités relationnelles, vous participerez à la conception d’architectures cloud aidant les clients à innover. Devenir Architecte Solutions, c’est accéder au meilleur de la technologie, rejoindre une équipe soudée, travailler au succès des entreprises françaises et développer sa carrière dans un contexte où l'intelligence artificielle redéfinit les possibilités des entreprises et de leur transformation numérique.

Nous cherchons des bâtisseuses et bâtisseurs venant de tous horizons. Les qualités principales recherchées sont la curiosité, l’envie d’apprendre, le travail en équipe, et le goût de la relation client. Les Architectes Solutions viennent de nombreux domaines et types d’entreprises. L’étendue des missions et des opportunités proposées permet à différents profils d’utiliser leurs forces et de bénéficier des ressources mises à disposition pour développer d’autres domaines de compétence.

Key job responsibilities
Ce poste est au sein de l’organisation française AWS, et se concentre sur les clients grands comptes AWS en France.

Auprès des clients, vous :
- Établissez un réseau de contacts pour les accompagner efficacement et les rendre autonomes
- Animez des sessions d’échange sur les meilleures pratiques
- Facilitez des ateliers et des revues d’architecture

- Construisez avec les équipes du client : prototypes, preuves de concept et co-développement dans leurs environnements, pour passer de la théorie à la démonstration ("Show, don’t tell")
- Accompagnez l’ensemble des phases des projets, de la conception à l’opération
- Guidez la montée en compétence, sur le plan technologique, gouvernance


Au sein d’AWS, vous :
- Contribuez, au sein de l’équipe de compte, à la définition de la stratégie commerciale et technologique
- Assurez la coordination entre les différentes équipes AWS pour représenter au mieux les intérêts de vos clients
- Partagez votre expérience dans les communautés sur les domaines technologiques ou industriels
- Participez à des programmes internes sur des sujets technologiques, organisationnels, de recrutement

Au sein des communautés externes, vous :
- Présentez votre expérience, les enjeux et les solutions appropriées dans des présentations ou des vidéos
- Contribuez à la création de contenus tels que des billets de blog, des livres-blancs, des articles
- Participez aux programmes AWS auprès des communautés et des clients


A day in the life
Vous aidez vos clients à être compétitifs, sécurisés, et durables. Membre d’une équipe de compte, composée de profils métiers, commerciaux, consultants ou support, votre mission est d’établir un lien de confiance technologique avec vos clients. Vous travaillez à tout niveau de l’organisation, dont équipes de direction. Vous analysez les besoins et opportunités, et accompagnez vos clients sur l’utilisation optimale des technologies cloud. Selon le contexte, vous ne vous limitez pas au conseil : vous construisez aux côtés des équipes d'ingénierie du client, dans des cycles courts et cadrés, pour démontrer la proposition de valeur. Vous aidez les équipes AWS à comprendre les besoins de vos clients et à les intégrer dans leurs plans. Vous partagez votre expérience avec d’autres équipes dans le monde entier et êtes actifs dans la communauté publique AWS.

En tant qu'Architecte Solutions chez AWS, vous agissez pour la révolution de l'intelligence artificielle. Vous concevez les architectures cloud qui permettront à nos clients d'exploiter les dernières innovations de l'IA générative et agentique, et vous aiderez les entreprises françaises à tirer le meilleur parti des capacités de l'IA dans leurs activités. Cette position vous offrira l'opportunité de développer une expertise pointue, de créer des architectures et solutions de référence, et de jouer un rôle déterminant dans la transformation numérique de nos clients.


About the team
Depuis plus de 10 ans, AWS investit localement pour aider à la transformation numérique en France, à travers des infrastructures techniques et des équipes d’accompagnement client. Avec une attention constante sur l’apprentissage, l’excellence opérationnelle et le partage, nous travaillons quotidiennement avec nos clients. Des sociétés du CAC 40 aux nouveaux fleurons de l’industrie et de la French Tech, ainsi que les acteurs internationaux innovants, AWS est le moteur des entreprises accompagnant les Français à chaque instant.

Basic qualifications

- Capacité à communiquer efficacement dans des contextes divers et à différents niveaux, à orchestrer des équipes et travailler efficacement en interne et externe
- Expérience professionnelle dans ou avec des organisations importantes, en implémentation ou gestion de projets IT complexes
- Expérience en infrastructure informatique, opération système, ou développement
- Capacité à apprendre et appliquer de nouvelles technologies rapidement
- Français courant pour les interactions client, anglais professionnel (parlé, écrit) pour les échanges internes

Preferred qualifications

- Formation technique : Informatique, Ingénierie, Mathématiques ou équivalent
- Connaissance ou expérience de migration ou transformation vers le cloud AWS et/ou des offres Cloud Public ou Hybride, en entreprise
- Goût et pratique de la construction hands-on (prototypes/POCs), y compris avec des outils de développement agentique

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

title: Systems Development Engineer II, US Amazon Dedicated Cloud Security Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Security is looking for a driven Systems Development Engineer to build and maintain the automation that enables security assurance at scale. You will work among a larger team to prototype and productize Generative AI-enabled security tooling, continuous-monitoring systems, and evidence pipelines that sustain a valid Authorization to Operate (ATO).

As a SysDev, you will own the health, security, and automation of this critical capability, producing infrastructure as code and robust operational monitoring that scales with our growing infrastructure and minimizes manual effort. You will build extensible tooling that delights internal customers, and make sure the entire deployment process is performant, automated, and well tested to keep development iteration fast and unhindered by operational misses.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build security assurance automation: continuous-monitoring systems and evidence pipelines that sustain the ATO.



- Turn prototypes into production, including producing infrastructure as code (IaC) and automated deployment and configuration management.



- Create operational monitoring and alerting that scales with the infrastructure.



- Automate routine tasks so the team stays quick and agile, and keep the deployment process performant, automated, and well tested.



- Partner with internal customers to understand operational challenges and deliver solutions, often requiring deep technical expertise.

A day in the life
On a typical day, you dive into the security assurance evidence pipeline: you'll work within a Scrum to automate a control-evidence collection step that engineers were doing by hand, then push it through CI/CD so it is tested and repeatable. You extend a continuous-monitoring check, wire its output into the organization's alerting. Midday, you meet with internal customers to understand security assurance pain points and scope tooling to solve it. By afternoon, you are inspecting health metrics, and finding operational bottlenecks to remove.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 1+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 4+ years of administrative experience in networking, storage systems, operating systems and hands-on systems engineering experience
- Bachelor's degree, or CSSLP (Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional)
- Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of TS/SCI with Polygraph.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS platforms, services, and design patterns
- Experience in AI-assisted or agentic coding practices

title: Area Manager, FC Operations
descriptionHtml:
Il team Operations è il cuore pulsante di Amazon. Svolge un ruolo fondamentale per il nostro business, perché ci permette di evadere e spedire gli ordini in modo efficiente, così che i nostri clienti li ricevano nei tempi previsti. Nel ruolo di Area Manager, dovrai garantire la regolare operatività del tuo sito logistico, per riuscire a soddisfare le richieste dei clienti. Sarai a capo di un team che contribuisce a garantire la sicurezza, l’efficienza e l’alta qualità dei nostri processi e ti occuperai di una serie di progetti su tutta la nostra rete con lo scopo di incrementare la produttività.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale applicabile per questo ruolo è il CCNL per i dipendenti del settore Logistica, Trasporto Merci e Spedizione. La posizione è classificata al livello 1 o superiore, in base alle competenze, alle capacità e all'esperienza del candidato.

Key job responsibilities
- Creare, portare avanti e promuovere una cultura incentrata sulla sicurezza e sul benessere.
- Analizzare e implementare cambiamenti per mantenere qualità e produttività a livelli costantemente elevati.
- Supervisionare progetti di miglioramento dei processi, ottimizzare la produttività e incrementare la qualità del servizio ai clienti all’interno della tua area di responsabilità.
- Analizzare le prestazioni dei turni rispetto agli obiettivi aziendali e mettere in atto azioni per migliorare la nostra eccellenza operativa.
- Lavorare in collaborazione con i colleghi manager per standardizzare le prassi adottate nei turni.

A day in the life
Lavorerai su turni presso uno dei nostri siti logistici, garantendo la massima produttività possibile. Il tuo obiettivo principale sarà promuovere una cultura della sicurezza e il rispetto degli standard di qualità e di performance durante i turni. Dovrai inoltre supervisionare le attività di miglioramento dei processi nella tua area e agevolarne l’implementazione. La tipica giornata di lavoro è molto varia: dovrai occuparti di attività di routine di gestione del team, avrai responsabilità quotidiane volte al miglioramento dei processi e iniziative contingenti di gestione operativa su più ampia scala. Dovrai anche fungere da esempio e da guida per i nuovi manager.

About the team
Il team Customer Fulfilment, o CF, è il nucleo originario di Amazon. Tutto è partito da un piccolo gruppo di librai, per poi diventare un team sofisticato dalla presenza globale, che gestisce oltre 1,5 milioni di ordini al giorno. Questo team è alla base della nostra attività ed è grazie al suo impegno che l’azienda ha saputo diversificarsi, ampliando la propria presenza geografica e l’offerta di servizi. Grazie alle nuove tecnologie, siamo sempre alla ricerca di modi per offrire una gamma di prodotti più ampia e migliore, con consegne tempestive a costi contenuti.
Il team CF è il primo anello della catena che ci permette di consegnare i prodotti con la velocità che ci contraddistingue. Opera all’interno dei Fulfilment Centre, aree chiave della frenetica rete operativa di Amazon e che a volte vengono definiti “First Mile”, primo miglio, perché è proprio lì che la maggior parte dei pacchi Amazon inizia il suo viaggio. Il team aiuta a gestire un inventario dinamico e agevola consegne tempestive 24 ore su 24.
Nei Fulfilment Centre operano le figure più disparate, quindi le opportunità abbondano e c’è bisogno di competenze eterogenee. C’è chi gestisce fisicamente i prodotti e chi si occupa di analizzare i dati per aiutare il personale a prendere decisioni oculate.

Basic qualifications

- Laurea.
- Vasta esperienza nella gestione di persone.
- Vasta esperienza nella comunicazione con un’ampia gamma di stakeholder, tra cui colleghi e manager.
- Vasta esperienza nell’utilizzo di dati o evidenze storiche per influenzare le decisioni aziendali.
- Conoscenza avanzata della lingua inglese e della lingua italiana, sia parlate che scritte.

Preferred qualifications

- Le qualifiche preferenziali non sono requisiti obbligatori per candidarsi a una posizione in Amazon. Se possiedi tutte le qualifiche richieste di cui sopra, non esitare a inviarci la tua candidatura: saremo felici di esaminarla!
- Esperienza con le metodologie Lean, Six Sigma e Kaizen.
- Esperienza lavorativa nel settore logistico.
- Buona padronanza del pacchetto MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) ad uso professionale.

title: Data Center Facility Manager, Data Center Community
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical technical leader who ensures the heartbeat of our global infrastructure remains strong and resilient. In this pivotal role, you'll be the guardian of our data center operations, driving reliability and performance while optimizing operational efficiency across complex technical environments.

Data Center Facility Manger role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


Key job responsibilities
- Oversee all aspects of the data center's critical physical infrastructure. Ensure that all work performed within the space is done to high quality and without impact to internal/external customers
- Manage teams of 24x7 engineering technicians in all facets of their career
- Engage in improvement projects, often requiring reaching out to a variety of support teams, and drive them from conception to completion
- Coordinates daily with a multitude of third party vendors ensuring adherence to contracted SLAs
- Effectively and efficiently manage the operations budget and expenditures
- Routinely operate as the afterhours on-call Data Center Facility Manager for the data centers in the region. This will include responding to any issues within the data centers and managing the investigation, mitigation, and recovery of the issue(s)

A day in the life
As the Facility Manager, your role demonstrates a strong commitment to prioritizing the development and well-being of team members, as well as fostering diversity and inclusion. You will oversee all facets of the data center's critical infrastructure with a focus on continuous availability and optimal performance, while upholding high-quality standards and minimizing any impact on internal and external customers. Additionally, you will play a crucial role in process optimization, staff management, setting performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives, all while ensuring a supportive and inclusive work environment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of in a managerial/supervisory role with 5 or more direct reports experience
- 3+ years of in industrial electrical or mechanical systems experience
- 3+ years of administrative experience including Microsoft Office products experience

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of the electrical and mechanical systems involved in critical data center operations including systems such as feeders, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, ATS units, PDU units, chillers, pumps, air handling units, and CRAC units
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Engineering Technology, or 5+ years of working in a data center or other mission critical environment with an emphasis on building and equipment operation experience
- Experience communicating technical details verbally and in writing
- Experience conducting behavioral interviews and hiring
- Can work in an environment that involves walking, stooping, bending, and climbing to access equipment

descriptionHtml:

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle. title: Senior Cloud Hardware Engineer, Accelerator Servers
descriptionHtml:
AWS operates the world's largest fleet of GPU-accelerated servers powering AI/ML training and inference at cloud scale. Our team defines the server architectures, drives the hardware designs, and owns the fleet quality for these platforms — from component selection through datacenter operations. If you want to shape the physical hardware that frontier models train on, this is the role.

We are seeking a Cloud Hardware Development Engineer to define server architectures based on workload demand, translate them into detailed component specifications, and drive validation from PCBA bring-up through rack integration. You will lead ODM design partners through development and production, triage hardware issues across manufacturing and datacenters, and own fleet quality metrics post-launch.

What You Will Do
You will define the hardware that runs the world's largest AI training workloads. Your designs span thermal, mechanical, power, and signal integrity across GPU-accelerated platforms. You will drive validation from first silicon through fleet-scale deployment, triage failures correlating across PCIe, power delivery, memory, and accelerator interconnects, and feed root cause findings back into design improvements. When a new server platform launches at a large scale, the architecture, component choices, and quality gates are yours.

Why You Will Love It
The world's most advanced frontier models train on the hardware you design. You will see your architecture decisions scale to a large fleet of servers. The team is deeply technical and high-trust — you own platforms end to end from architecture definition through fleet operations.


The Ideal Candidate
You think across the full hardware stack — from silicon packaging and power delivery to rack-level thermal and mechanical design. You are as comfortable reviewing a schematic as you are analyzing fleet failure data. You drive quality through data, not assumption, and you hold design partners to the same standard you hold yourself. You mentor and develop junior engineers, contribute to hiring, and share your expertise to make the team stronger.


Key job responsibilities
Architecture & Design
* Define server architectures based on workload demand and customer requirements, translating them into detailed designs and component specifications that enable high-performance AI training and inference at scale
* Work with interdisciplinary teams of component, firmware, test, qualification, and integration engineers to deliver cohesive designs
* Drive design reviews with ODM/JDM partners covering schematic, layout, BOM, and manufacturing DFx (Design for Test, Design for Manufacturing)

Validation & Bring-up
* Define and execute validation strategies from PCBA bring-up through server and rack integration — covering power sequencing, signal integrity, thermal characterization, and accelerator interconnect performance
* Own hardware debug during EVT/DVT/PVT builds, correlating failures across PCIe, power rails, memory channels, and GPU subsystems
* Triage hardware issues at both ODM facilities and datacenters, conduct root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions

Fleet Quality & Continuous Improvement
* Own fleet quality metrics post-launch: server-level annualized failure rates and component-level failure modes
* Monitor operational telemetry to identify systemic issues and drive design or process changes for current and future platforms
* Partner with test and automation teams to improve manufacturing yield and reduce test dwell times

Cross-Team Collaboration
* Work with EC2 architecture teams to align on instance definitions, workload requirements, and platform trade-offs
* Drive ODM/JDM design partners through development milestones and production ramp
* Collaborate with firmware, software, and operations teams to ensure designs are debuggable, serviceable, and automation-ready

May require occasional (<10%) regional and international travel to Design and Manufacturing Partner sites.


A day in the life
You start the day reviewing thermal and power validation data from an EVT build at your ODM partner. Mid-morning, you join a design review to close signal integrity findings on a high-speed accelerator interconnect. In the afternoon, you triage a fleet quality signal — correlating component-level failure data with manufacturing lot information to identify a systemic issue. You end the day aligning with architecture teams on requirements for the next-generation platform.

About the team
The Hardware Engineering AI/ML UltraServer platform team is a group of engineers and technical program managers directly responsible for launching GPU-accelerated servers into the AWS fleet. Located in Seattle, Austin, and Cupertino, we collaborate with global development teams and ODM partners to deliver next-generation AI/ML infrastructure deployed in datacenters worldwide. We move fast with small, empowered teams delivering end-to-end — from server conception through fleet-scale operations.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
- 5+ years of hardware design and development experience for server, compute, or large-scale infrastructure platforms
- Experience in one or more server technologies: thermal/mechanical design, power delivery, high-speed signal integrity, or accelerator subsystems
- Experience developing functional specifications, design verification plans, and validation test procedures
- Experience leading hardware development through full product lifecycle (concept through production ramp)

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of experience working with ODMs through the product development and manufacturing lifecycle (EVT, DVT, PVT)
- In-depth expertise in high-speed bus design, signal integrity analysis, or power delivery for GPU/accelerator platforms
- 5+ years of experience with hardware bring-up, debug, and root cause analysis across PCIe, NVMe, memory, and accelerator interconnects
- Experience owning fleet quality metrics and driving design improvements based on operational failure data
- Experience with thermal/mechanical design for high-power-density compute platforms (liquid cooling, air cooling, or hybrid)
- Experience working in large-scale datacenter or cloud environments
- Track record of defining engineering standards and design best practices adopted across teams or partner organizations

title: Executive Assistant II , Prime Video Content & Partner Lifecycle
descriptionHtml:
There's Amazon. Then there's Prime Video. And then there's you — the Executive Assistant — standing confidently at the intersection of all of it, armed with a calendar, a can-do attitude, and the institutional knowledge of roughly three full-time employees.

The EA role in Prime Video & Studios is unlike most support roles at Amazon. It lives at a fascinating (and occasionally chaotic) crossroads: part entertainment company, part tech organization, part global studio operation. Your leader might be in a greenlight meeting one afternoon and a cloud infrastructure review the next. You need to understand both worlds — and somehow make them coexist on the same calendar.

Key job responsibilities
• Anticipate needs before they become asks — know the business calendar cold: launch windows, content review seasons, OP1/OP2 cycles, and AWS re:Invent prep.
• Build time blocks for deep work, travel buffers, and biobreaks (yes, even SVPs need lunch — they just forget to schedule it).
• Maintain a forward view of the calendar: 2 weeks detailed, 3 months at a glance.
• Prime Video runs globally — LA, Seattle, London, Mumbai, and beyond. Time zones are not a suggestion; they are a daily puzzle.
• Establish preferred meeting windows with peer EAs in other regions to reduce the 6am/9pm scheduling pain.
• Keep a world clock handy. Your brain will thank you.

A day in the life
• Triage and prioritize — Flag urgent items, pre-read docs attached to upcoming meetings, and identify any conflicts or double-bookings that crept in overnight.
• Prep the daily brief — Some VPs like a morning rundown: key meetings, decisions needed, docs to review, and any "heads up" items (reorgs, escalations, launch milestones).
• Back-to-back meeting management — In PV, your leader is likely in content reviews, tech syncs, partner discussions, and leadership meetings.
• Coordinate with other EAs — PV has a large EA community. You partner with EAs supporting SVPs, Directors, and other leaders to schedule 1:1s, staff meetings, and business reviews.

About the team
Prime Video Content & Partner Lifecycle is a uniquely cross-functional, globally distributed organization. Here's what makes it tick:

Vision: "All content, from all partners, for everyone."

Mission: "We create and publish content on-time that's meaningful, accurate, and accessible to every customer globally."

Prime Video Content & Partner Lifecycle spans 7 major program teams across Seattle, Culver City, London, Tokyo, Bangalore, Chennai, and San Jose.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of executive assistant experience
- Experience with executive level calendar management
- Experience with domestic or international travel coordination
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in a fast-paced, high-tech company
- Experience leading process improvements
- Experience designing processes to maximize efficiency

title: ISV Go-To-Market & Sales Partner Development Manager, APO Germany & Europe Central
descriptionHtml:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) drives revenue, adoption, and growth across our largest and fastest-growing customers, from small and mid-market businesses to global enterprises. Our primary growth engine is the AWS Partner Network, managed by the AWS Partner Organization (APO).

Generative AI is changing how enterprises buy and build software. The partners at the center of that shift, frontier model providers and the data platforms that feed them, are among the fastest-growing businesses on AWS. As the ISV Go-To-Market (GTM) & Sales Partner Development Manager (PDM) for Data & AI in APO Germany & Europe Central, you will own AWS's joint go-to-market and sales motion with these partners across Germany, Switzerland, Austria and Central & Eastern Europe.

This is a partner-assigned, revenue-accountable role. You represent your partners inside AWS and AWS inside your partners. You are measured on what you sell together: Launched Annualized Recurring Revenue (ARR), AWS Marketplace Total Contract Value (TCV), and partner-originated pipeline. Your portfolio covers two groups: leading large language model (LLM) providers available through Amazon Bedrock and AWS Marketplace, and strategic Data, Analytics & AI ISVs.

You will work across partner executives, AWS sales leadership, GenAI specialists and Consulting/SI partners, and you will be expected to set direction yourself. We are looking for someone commercially sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to think long-term about customers and partners while still delivering results this quarter.

Key job responsibilities
As ISV GTM & Sales PDM, reporting to the APO Germany & Europe Central leader, you will:

- Own LLM provider go-to-market. Build and run the regional joint plan with frontier model providers. That includes the operating cadence and co-sell of engagement between the provider's regional team and AWS sales & specialists.
- Sell with the field. Work opportunities with AWS Account Managers from identification through close. Activate partners on shared opportunities, drive ACE co-sell, and clear blockers through to launch.
- Run tri-party co-sell. Design and run Power-of-3 motions (model provider or ISV + Consulting/SI partner + AWS) on named enterprise accounts, from account selection and executive alignment to launched ARR.
- Build plays that move workloads onto Amazon Bedrock, then expand them into agentic, process-level transformation engagements.
- Grow the Data & AI ISV portfolio. Own the regional strategy for strategic Data, Analytics & AI ISVs: joint business plans, top-to-top sales alignment, localized sales plays, and field enablement (Better Together, ACE co-sell, AWS Marketplace, MEDDPICC).
- Drive AWS Marketplace transactions. Use private offers, Channel Partner Private Offers (CPPO) and alignment with customer commit agreements to deliver your category's Marketplace TCV target.
- Own the category business. Maintain the category baseline, forecast and path to plan. Write the monthly and quarterly business reviews and contribute to the annual operating plan.

A day in the life
Your week might start with a pipeline review with a model provider's DACH leadership and the AWS GenAI specialist team, deciding which named enterprise accounts are ready for a joint executive session. By midweek you might be on a deal call with an AWS Account Manager and a data platform partner, structuring a Marketplace private offer against the customer's commit. Then you might work with a global SI's AI practice lead to shape a tri-party offer, and bring in the right sales director to unblock a Bedrock migration opportunity that has stalled in qualification. You might end the week updating your category forecast and writing the narrative for the monthly business review.

Success means launched ARR, Marketplace TCV and partner-originated pipeline that land on plan, and a joint go-to-market model with your partners that keeps working when you are not in the room.

About the team
APO Germany & Europe Central covers Germany, Switzerland, Austria and Central & Eastern Europe. The ISV GTM & Sales team covers Technology Partners by category (Data & AI, DevSecOps, and Horizontal Business Applications). We work with Consulting Partner PDMs, the EMEA Tech Partner organization and AWS sales to bring ISV and GenAI partners to customers.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

title: Business Analyst Apprentice - 42-month fixed term contract
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about solving problems and uncovering the insights that drive smarter decisions? Do you thrive on investigating how things work and finding better ways to do them? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join Amazon as a Business Analyst Apprentice.

In this role, you'll play a pivotal part in aligning business objectives with technology solutions, working alongside seasoned professionals to turn complex information into insight that shapes real decisions. You'll dive deep into the world of business analysis, mastering the techniques and tools to analyse data, document processes, and gather the requirements that keep experiences running for millions of customers. The problems you solve will help drive improvement across the business.

Throughout your apprenticeship you'll learn to analyse business processes, systems and data, engage effectively with diverse stakeholders, and interpret intricate data to extract valuable insights. You'll develop a keen understanding of requirements gathering, documentation and reporting, and the problem-solving approaches that help identify and address challenges within an organisation.

But it's not just about technical skills - you'll also hone your communication, critical thinking and collaboration abilities, enabling you to work effectively with cross-functional teams and present your findings to stakeholders.

A day in the life can involve:

- Collaborating with various stakeholders to understand and document business requirements

- Analysing data and processes to identify areas for improvement

- Assisting in the development and implementation of solutions to enhance business performance

- Creating detailed reports and documentation to communicate your findings and recommendations

- Participating in project meetings and contributing to the successful execution of business projects

- Keeping abreast of industry trends and best practice in business analysis

Our teams work at the intersection of people, process and technology, partnering with customers, business users, suppliers, product owners, software developers, testers and senior leaders. We move fast, fail fast, and fix faster - so you'll be encouraged to bring your ideas, test them, and learn as you go. We foster a culture of continuous learning, knowledge-sharing, and mentorship, ensuring that you have the support and resources to grow and excel in your career.

We welcome individuals from all backgrounds who enjoy problem-solving and critical thinking, as you'll investigate complex business challenges and find innovative solutions to improve them. You'll need a meticulous, detail-oriented approach to your work, and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams to communicate your findings to a variety of stakeholders. You'll be a curious person with a passion for staying up to date with the latest tools and best practice in business analysis, as well as a flexible attitude and the ability to perform under pressure while prioritising tasks.

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship, you'll have the opportunity to learn by doing, putting newfound knowledge into practice every day. Our first-class coaching, tailored development opportunities, and challenging, rewarding work will empower you to reach new heights. If you're a curious, ambitious learner eager to grow, this is your chance to unlock your full potential and build the future you envision.

You'll gain a vast range of useful experiences and skills while working towards the BSc (Hons) Digital and Technology Solutions (Business Analysis pathway). As a working student, your focus is to complete your studies in your 20% off-the-job time by learning and developing the skills, knowledge, and behaviours to work towards successful graduation. You'll be set objectives and goals by your training provider and manager to support your studies.

You'll build your skills over a 42-month period, starting in September. These skills will help you develop personally and professionally. Your apprenticeship will be made up of classroom/virtual-based training to cover knowledge, on-the-job training at your Amazon base location, online learning, as well as mentoring from our experienced team members.

We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups – including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employees, and underrepresented minorities – foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. These groups provide community, mentorship, and a platform for your voice to be heard. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Your career isn't a straight path - it's a journey you build as you go. A universe of opportunity awaits, and your next adventure starts here.

Basic qualifications

- To qualify for this programme, you must:
- Be 18 years or over before the start date (September 2027)
- Have the right to live and work in England at the point of enrolment (June 2027). If you are on a visa, this must enable you to legally work and reside in England for the entire duration of the programme from enrolment.
- Have lived in the UK or in the European Economic Area (EEA) for the last 3 years prior to the start date
- Not be registered to study on a UK government funded course ending August 2027 or later
- Be prepared to travel for external/mandatory training as part of the apprenticeship
- Hold 5 GCSEs at grade 4-9 (A-C) or above (or equivalent) including Maths and English. As well as ONE of the following: A-Levels (Grades ABB at A-Level, or International Baccalaureate (IB), or 34 points overall, including 6,6,5 from three Higher Level subjects. Alternatively, 32 points overall including 6,5,5 from three Higher Level subjects including Mathematics or Computer Science.), BTEC (BTEC Computing D*DD (extended diploma), or BTEC Information Technology D*DD (extended diploma), or BTEC Business D*DD (extended diploma)), T-Level (T Level in Digital Business Services(Distinction), T Level in Digital Production, Design and Development (Distinction) , T Level in Digital Support Services (Distinction) or Access HE (Access to Higher Education Diploma in Computing. The minimum academic requirement is to achieve 60 credits overall, with 45 credits at Level 3, of which 30 credits must be at Distinction and 15 credits at Merit or higher. Applications are considered on a case by case basis. Due to the high volume of applications, we do not make offers of study purely on the basis of meeting grade requirements. GCSE Mathematics at grade B/5 is required in addition to the Access qualification.")
- Please note, if you have received educational qualifications outside of the UK then we will require a Statement of Comparability to confirm your eligibility for the scheme. Please ensure you obtain one during the application process, through UK ENIC: https://www.enic.org.uk/
- Previous qualifications will be reviewed for funding eligibility and offers are subject to funding approval
- PLEASE NOTE: This position is a 42 month fixed-term contract. You must NOT already have a qualification in a similar subject at the same or higher level than this apprenticeship.
- This Apprenticeship assumes the candidate has some or little knowledge/experience of the occupation

Preferred qualifications

- A natural curiosity for getting to the bottom of problems - the kind of person who asks "why?" and enjoys piecing information together to find an answer
- Comfort working with numbers and information, with an interest in spotting patterns and drawing sensible conclusions from them
- Great at communicating with different people - able to explain ideas clearly and adapt your style for different audiences
- Well-organised and methodical, with an eye for detail and the ability to balance study alongside work

The Central Deployment Operations team under RME Central (RP3) is seeking an experienced and highly organized Program Manager to lead the deployment of software and hardware across Amazon's fulfillment and logistics network. You will translate technical requirements into executable deployment plans, coordinate vendors and internal stakeholders, manage schedule and execution risks, and establish repeatable processes that enable technologies to scale across a large and geographically distributed portfolio.

The successful candidate will have experience delivering complex technical or infrastructure projects and operating effectively in environments with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and evolving technical requirements. This role requires a self-starter who can independently manage multiple projects, identify and resolve execution barriers, and influence stakeholders across organizational boundaries, with the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar technologies sufficiently to lead their successful deployment.
